text_zh: 師云。仰山昔甞問僧甚處來。僧云。幽州來。仰 云。我恰要幽州信。幽州米作麼價。僧云。某來 時無端穿市中過。踏折他橋梁。仰便休。仰山 小釋迦。接人非止一路。此箇公案正是學人 入門之勢。下手得力處。山問幽州僧。汝還思 彼中麼。當時被他道不思。又作麼生。仰山必 然別有長處。僧却云。常思。實語當懺悔。山云。 能思是心。所思是境。境則千差。能思底心有 多𤳖麼。雲門曾道。仰山為慈悲之故。有落草 之談。果然僧也靈利。道。某甲到這裏總不見 有。今時人萬一不到這境界。若到即點胸擔 板。不知途路之樂終不到家。仰山曾行山下 路來。故別指一條活路。仰山昔年僧堂前三 昧次。夜半不見山河大地寺宇人物以至己 身。全同空界。明晨舉似大溈。溈曰。我在百 丈時得此境。乃是融通妄想銷明之功。汝向 後說法有人過者。無有是處。萬松道。非仰山 不證。非溈山不識。楞嚴經云。若動念盡。浮想 銷除。於覺明心。如去塵垢。一倫生死首尾圓 照。名想陰盡。是人則能超煩惱濁。觀其所由。 融通妄想。以為其本。此又見溈仰父子妙契 佛心也。仰山一日呈解云。若教某自看。到這 裏無圓位。亦無可斷。溈曰。據汝見處猶是法 在。亦未離心境。仰曰。既無圓位。何處更有心 境。溈曰。適來汝作恁麼解是否。仰云是。溈 云。若恁麼具足是心境法。爭得道無。仰山見 這僧有這箇在。依理判斷道。信位即是。人位 未是。別本云。信位即得。行位即未多。舉金剛 三昧經。信位。思位。修位。行位。捨位。今言信 位人位。未必全同。竹庵珪和尚道。向開口合 口處。分這邊那邊。有言無言處。分信位人位。 此又別一家也。溈山問仰山。寂子速道。莫入 陰界。仰云。慧寂信亦不立。溈云。子信了不 立。不信不立。仰云。只是慧寂更信阿誰。溈云。 若恁麼則是定性聲聞也。仰云。慧寂佛亦不 見。清居皓昇禪師。牧牛圖至第六章云。信位 漸熟。邪境覺疎。雖辨淨穢。如劍利泥。猶存鼻 索。未可憑信。故白黑相半。頌曰。野牧雖云 久。牽繩手漸離。行持非暗昧。進習不依隨。淨 地于于樂。長鞭每每持。青山香草細。一味日 充飢。至十二章。人位本空。身心無著。得失淨 盡。玄玄道路。邈無分別。向上一句。擬議即 墮。頌曰。妄起勞看牧。牛非人亦非。正中妄想 像。向上有玄微。大海纖塵起。洪鑪片雪飛。相 逢求解會。不墮汝心機。萬松道。仰山信亦不 立。清居人位本空。若向二師話中。揀得出。信 位人位。昭然可見。所謂退步就己萬不失一 也。僧云。和尚莫別有指示否。爛泥裏有刺。仰 云。別有別無即不中。有即雪上加霜。無即死 在句下。所以指一玄。教伊自看。湧泉空處為 座萬行為衣。有以。坐謂安禪靜慮。衣謂衲帔 蒙頭。有以。坐謂開堂陞座。衣謂法服嚴身。皆 有理在。且道。向後自看。看箇什麼。問取天 童。頌云。
text_en: said, I happen to want news from Youzhou. What is the price of rice in Youzhou? The monk said, When I came, for no reason I passed through the market and stepped on and broke their bridge. Yangshan then let it rest. Yangshan, the Little Shakyamuni, received people by more than one road. This koan is precisely where learners gain the momentum to enter the gate, the place where they get strength in applying themselves. Yangshan asked the Youzhou monk, Do you still think of that place? If at that time he had said I do not think, then what? Yangshan would surely have had another strength there. But the monk instead said, I always think. Honest speech deserves repentance. Yangshan said, The one that thinks is mind; what is thought of is object. Objects differ in a thousand ways. Does the thinking mind have many forms too? Yunmen once said, Out of compassion, Yangshan spoke in a way that stoops into the weeds. Truly, that monk was sharp as well, saying, When I get here, I altogether do not see any. People nowadays, if they have not reached this state, then fine; but if they do, they immediately thump their chests and carry a board, not knowing that delight in the road never reaches home in the end. Yangshan had once walked the road below the mountain, so he pointed out another living road. In years past, before the monks' hall, while in samadhi, at midnight Yangshan no longer saw mountains, rivers, the great earth, monasteries, people, and things, and even his own body—everything was wholly like empty space. Next morning he told Guishan. Gui said, When I was with Bai- zhang I attained this state too. It is the effect of dissolving and clearing through false thoughts. If later you teach Dharma and someone passes beyond this, that would be impossible. Wansong said, Were it not Yangshan, he would not have realized it; were it not Guishan, he would not have recognized it. The Shurangama Sutra says: When stirring thoughts are exhausted and floating imaginings are dispelled, then in the enlightened luminous mind it is like removing dust and grime; one whole round of birth and death, beginning and end, is perfectly illumined. This is called the exhaustion of the aggregate of conception. Such a person can transcend the turbidity of affliction. Looking at what it comes from, the root is the interpenetration of false thoughts. Here again one sees the wondrous accord of the father and son, Gui and Yang, with the Buddha-mind. One day Yangshan presented his understanding, saying, If you have me look for myself, when I arrive here there is no complete stage, nor anything to cut off. Gui said, According to the place of your seeing, there is still Dharma present; you have also not yet left mind and object. Yang said, Since there is no complete stage, where is there still mind and object? Gui said, Just now, was that not the understanding you made? Yang said, Yes. Gui said, If so, that fully constitutes the dharma of mind and object. How can you say there is none? Yangshan saw that this monk had this in him, and according to principle judged: At the stage of faith, yes; at the stage of person, not yet. Another edition says: At the stage of faith, attained; at the stage of practice, not yet much. In the Vajra Samadhi Sutra there are the stages of faith, contemplation, cultivation, practice, and relinquishment. Here speaking of faith- stage and person-stage may not be exactly the same. Master Zhugan Gui said, At the place of opening and closing the mouth, he divides this side and that side; at the place of speech and no speech, he divides faith-stage and person-stage. This too is another family's way. Guishan asked Yangshan, Ji, speak quickly—do not fall into the realm of the skandhas. Yang said, Huiji does not establish even faith. Gui said, You trust and yet do not establish; not trusting and not establishing—what then? Yang said, Huiji simply has no one else to trust. Gui said, If so, then you are a fixed-nature shravaka. Yang said, Huiji does not even see Buddha. Chan Master Haosheng of Qingju, in the Oxherding Pictures at chapter six, says: At the stage of faith it gradually ripens, and false states are felt as remote. Though one discerns pure and defiled, like a sword cutting mud, there still remains the nose- rope; it is not yet something to rely on with confidence. Therefore black and white are half and half. The verse says: Though the wild herding may be said to be long, the hand holding the rope gradually loosens. Conduct and maintenance are not dark or confused; advancing practice does not depend on following along. In the pure field there is broad delight; the long whip is still often held. Green mountains and fine fragrant grass—one flavor day by to fill hunger. In the twelfth chapter, the human position is originally empty; body and mind are unattached; gain and loss are utterly exhausted. The profoundly mysterious road is far beyond discrimination. As for the upward phrase, the moment one contrives or deliberates one at once falls. The verse says: Delusion arises and vainly toils to watch and herd; the ox is not, the person is also not. In the very midst, delusive imaginings form images. Above, there is subtle mystery. In the great sea, a tiny speck of dust arises; in the vast furnace, a flake of snow flies. When meeting, if you seek understanding and interpretation, do not fall into your calculating mind. Wansong says: Yangshan said faith also does not stand. Qingju said the human position is originally empty. If, within these two masters’ words, you can pick it out, then the position of faith and the human position will be plainly visible. This is what is called stepping back and returning to oneself, ten thousand times not losing a single one of them. A monk said: Master, is there not some other instruction? There is a thorn in rotten mud. Yang said: To say there is another or there is not another already misses the mark. If there is, that is adding frost on top of snow; if there is not, then one dies beneath the words. Therefore he pointed to one mystery and told him to see for himself. Yongquan said: Empty space is the seat, the ten thousand practices are the robe. Some take seat to mean settling in Chan and quieting thought, and robe to mean patchwork cloak covering the head. Some take seat to mean opening the hall and ascending the seat, and robe to mean Dharma robes adorning the body. All of these have reason in them. But tell me: later, see for yourself. See what? Ask Tiantong. Tiantong. The verse says:

With nothing outside, it contains all; unobstructed, it is open and expansive; gatewalls stand sheer upon sheer, Great, nothing is not encompassed. Fine, nothing is not entered. Better not stick your head out.

text_en: said: If you understand, you understand wrapped right before your eyes; if you do not understand, it is still wrapped right before your eyes. This is the meaning of nothing outside and containing all. Mountains, rivers, towers, pavilions, people, beasts, and all things, one and many without obstruction. Person and object interpenetrate; this is unobstructed and open. National Teacher Shao said: On the peak of Penetrating Mystery peak, it is not the human world. Outside mind there is no dharma. Before the eyes are green mountains. The peak of Penetrating Mystery is the object thought of; not the human world is the mind that thinks. Outside mind there is no dharma, so altogether nothing is seen as existent. Before the eyes are green mountains. With this single phrase, this monk and National Teacher Shao are separated by the faith position and human position, by one mystery and three mysteries, so that indeed gatewalls stand sheer, and locks and bars are layered deep; in the end they are hard to meet. He further praises: this monk’s understanding is like a drunk guest and a slumped farmer. What Yangshan points to is like the wondrous-winged bird and the roaming dragon. In the Lotus Sutra it says: Suppose a man goes to a close friend’s house, gets drunk, and lies down. At that time the close friend has official business and must leave, so he ties a priceless jewel into the man’s garment. The man lies there drunk and knows nothing at all. Xiaozhou said: I once heard that one full meal makes one forget a hundred hungers; today this mountain monk’s own body is just so. Zhaozhou, with one full meal, forgot a hundred hungers, fit to receive the wondrous offerings of humans and gods. This monk, full from eating, is a slumped farmer; even a drop of water is hard for him to digest. Clear-eyed people, discern this well. In Sanskrit, Garuda, here called the Wondrous-Winged Bird, beats the wind and parts the sea, directly seizing and swallowing dragons. Confu cius asked Lao Dan about rites, and afterward said that seeing Laozi was like seeing a dragon. A roaming dragon appears and vanishes amid cloud and mist, not like those hidden in hibernation. This verse is still not the human position; it only attains one mystery. Later, see for yourself. Why tell him to move his body and change his step? If there is only a road one can go up, then even higher people can travel it.

text_zh: 師云。祖燈諸錄皆云。夾山未見舡子時。已出 世。住潤州京口竹林。而不著嗣法師名。獨佛 果擊節云。傳明初嗣石樓。即汾州石樓也。傳 明即夾山諡號。澧州洛浦山元安禪師。久參 臨濟。為侍者。濟甞曰。臨濟門下一隻箭。誰敢 當鋒。一日辭濟。濟問。何往。曰南方去。濟拄 杖一劃云。過得這箇便去。浦乃喝。濟便打。浦 作禮而去。游歷罷至夾山頂上。卓庵經一年。 夾山知遣侍僧。馳書到。浦接得便坐却。再展 手索。僧無語。浦便打云。歸去舉似和尚。僧迴 舉之。山云。這僧看書三日內必來。不看書不 可救也。浦三日後來。不禮拜當面而立。山云。 鷄棲鳳巢。非其同類出去。各負撥草瞻風眼。 浦見夾山遣遣却是留。既來豈可空迴。又見 門庭峻硬各不相下。便軟計就他道。自遠趨 風乞師一接。山別有一副鑪韛。道。目前無闍 梨。此間無老僧。山知久參必行臨濟正令。然 後別用超宗越格鉆鎚。浦果然便喝。爾且道。 只這箇更別有。山云。住住且莫草草怱怱。未 要著忙。雲月是同。溪山各異。一般麵草由人 做造。截斷天下人舌頭。即不無。只有千尺寒 松。爭教無舌人解語。更須要抽條石笋。山曾 有語。論門庭施設入理深談。浦門庭施設也。 山入理深談也。浦貪觀白浪失却手橈。卒搆 不上。山也好。却將臨濟正令。為他生澁鑰匙 投舊鎖。浦家常釅醋曾喫知酸。於是伏膺。興 化云。但知成佛愁甚麼眾生。萬松道。爭奈獨 樹不成林。雪竇云。這僧可悲可痛。鈍滯他臨 濟。萬松道。養子不及父。家門一世衰。他既雲 月是同。我亦溪山各異。萬松道。南山秋色氣 勢相高。說甚無舌人不解語。萬松道。猶是通 事舍人。坐具劈口摵。萬松道。被他接住爛毆 一頓。又作麼生。夾山是箇知方漢。必然明窓 下安排。萬松道。不如還他本分草料。五祖戒 云。更說道理。看便出去。萬松道。蛇蝎性靈 生便毒。大陽延云。也要和尚證明。萬松道。芝 蘭氣味老終香。師復云。藥山一宗實難紹舉。 雲巖掃地塵埃亘天。洛浦伏膺。稱冤不已。好 在無舌解語。無手行拳。直饒棒喝交馳。只得 傍提一半。扶持此道。分付天童。頌云。
text_en: into the world and lived at Bamboo Grove in Jingkou, Runzhou, but they do not record the name of his Dharma heir. Only Foguo Foguo clapped in praise and said: Chuanming at first inherited from Shilou that is Shilou of Fenzhou. Chuan ming is Jiashan’s posthumous title. Chan Master Yuan’an of Luopu Mountain in Lizhou long studied under Linji and served as his attendant. Linji once said: Under Linji there is a single arrow who dares face its point? One day he took leave of Linji. Linji asked: Where are you going? He said: To the south. Linji drew his staff and made one stroke, saying: If you can get past this, then go. Pu then shouted; Linji immediately struck him. Pu He made his bows and departed. After finishing his travels, he came to the summit of Mount Jia and set up a hut there for a year. Jia-shan, knowing of this, sent an attendant monk with a letter in haste. When Pu received it, he just sat there, then held out his hand again asking for more. The monk had no reply. Pu struck him and said, Go back and report this to master. The monk returned and told him. Shan said, If this monk reads the letter, he will surely come within three days. If he does not read it, he cannot be saved. Three days later Pu came. He did not bow, but stood face to face. Shan said, A chicken roosts in a phoenix nest; if it is not of the same kind, get out. Each of us bears eyes that part the grass and watch the wind. Pu saw that although Jia-shan sent him away, it was really to keep him. Since he had come, how could he return empty-handed? He also saw that their styles at the gate were both steep and hard, neither yielding. So he used a soft tactic and went along with him, saying, From afar I have hastened after the wind, begging the master for one reception. Shan had another whole set of bellows and furnace. He said, Before my eyes there is no acharya; in this place there is no old monk. Shan knew that a long-practiced one would surely use Linji’s proper command, and then he used a hammer and tongs beyond the school and beyond convention. Pu indeed immediately gave a shout. Tell me then, besides this, was there yet something else? Shan said, Stop, stop, do not be hasty and rushed. No need to hurry. Clouds and moon are the same; streams and mountains differ. The same flour and grass are made by people into whatever they make. To cut off the tongues of everyone under heaven is not impossible. But with only a thousand-foot cold pine, how can you make a tongueless man speak? You still need to draw out a stone shoot. Shan once had a saying: speaking of the gate and its devices, and deep discourse entering principle. Pu was gate and devices; Shan was deep discourse entering principle. Pu, greedy to watch the white waves, lost his oar in hand and in the end could not make it fit. Shan was good too, yet he took Linji’s proper command and used it as a raw, stiff key to fit an old lock. Pu had long eaten strong household vinegar and knew its sourness, so he submitted. Xinghua said, Just know how to become Buddha; why worry about sentient beings? Wansong said, But how can a single tree make a forest? Xuedou said, This monk is pitiable and lamentable; he dulled and bogged down Linji. Wansong said, A foster son does not equal the father; the family gate declines in one generation. Since he said clouds and moon are the same, I too say streams and mountains differ. Wansong said, The autumn colors of South Mountain rise in force; their vigor towers. Why speak of the tongueless man not being able to speak? Wansong said, He is still only a functionary handling affairs. His sitting mat struck him across the mouth. Wansong said, Caught by him, he got a rotten beating all at once. Then what? Jia-shan was a man who knew the square and rule; surely beneath the bright window he had arranged it all beforehand. Wansong said, Better return him his proper fodder. Wuzu Jie said, If you speak more reason, see, I will leave at once. Wansong said, The nature and spirit of snakes and scorpions are poisonous at birth. Dayang Yan said, Still, master must certify it. Wansong said, The fragrance of iris and orchid grows old yet remains fragrant. The master again said, Yaoshan’s lineage is truly hard to continue and uphold. Yunyan swept the ground, and dust filled the sky. Luopu submitted, yet kept crying injustice without end. Fortunately the tongueless can speak and the handless can throw punches. Even if blows and shouts race back and forth, one can only raise it from the side by half. To support this Way, he entrusted it to Tiantong, who versified:
Shaking head and swishing tail, the red-tailed scaled fish, utterly without reliance, knows how to turn its body. The mouth covets fragrant bait, the body hangs in the net.

text_zh: 搖頭擺尾赤梢鱗口貪香餌身掛網羅　徹底無依解轉身 今目拽在網底截斷舌頭饒有術君方掃雪尋松子　拽迴鼻孔 妙通神我已開棒得茯苓夜明簾外兮風月如晝不借三光 勢枯木巖前兮花卉常春潛消一色功　無舌人無 舌人鼻孔裏應諾正令全提一句親暗裏抽橫骨　獨步寰 中明了了真光不耀任從天下樂欣欣紜紜自彼於我何為
text_en: Now the eyes are dragged to the bottom of the net. Cutting off tongues is indeed a skill, but to tug back the nostrils You are just sweeping snow looking for pine nuts. wondrously reaches the divine. I have already split the stick and gotten poria. Outside the night-bright curtain, wind and moon are like day; Not borrowing the three lights. Force. before the dead-tree cliff, flowers and grasses are forever spring. The tongueless man, the tongueless Secretly dissolving the work of one color. man, Assenting from inside the nostrils. with the whole proper command fully raised, one intimate phrase, strides alone through the world, In the dark, pulling out the crossbone. bright and utterly clear within. True light does not shine forth. Let all under heaven rejoice in delight as they please. The bustle is over there; what is it to me?
The master said: When Luopu took leave of Linji, Linji said, Under the gate of Linji there is a red-

text_zh: 師云。洛浦辭臨濟。濟云。臨濟門下。有箇赤 梢鯉魚。搖頭擺尾。向南方去也。徹底無依 解轉身。乃濟下事。非轉位轉功全同也。臨濟 廣錄云。唯有聽法無依道人。是諸佛之母。所 以佛從無依生。若悟無依佛亦無得。若如是 見得者。是真正見解。萬松道。若是洛浦轉身 不得。如何解喝夾山。若道轉得身。為甚末後 無語。試定當看。天童許他具眼有術。夾山亦 不無他截斷天下人舌頭。善能據令。只爭教 無舌人解語。撩天鼻孔。輕輕拽迴。佛果見夾 山念呪語相似。乃著語云。那裏得這一落索 來。萬松道。只這便是。夾山教無舌人解語也。 佛果無這一落索也。只能截斷天下人舌頭。 直饒別有轉身吐氣處。未必是無舌人語。且 道。如何是此人境界。頌道。夜明簾外兮風月 如晝。枯木巖前兮花卉長春。此是無舌人受 用也。漢明帝起光明殿。以珠璣為簾箔。金戺 玉階。晝夜長明。同安察云。枯木巖前差路多。 洞山云。直須枯木上摻些花子。此頌棒頭喝 下不無孤峻。得到百尺竿頭。更須進一步了。 始得無舌人解語也。是知。無舌人出底語。方 是正令全提一句親切也。到這裏眼高四海。 獨步寰中。後來洛浦云。任從天下人樂欣欣。 我獨不肯。直饒天下人。甘心被他截斷舌頭。 夾山道。向上更有一竅在。如何是向上竅。無 舌人解語。即向爾道。
text_en: tailed carp, shaking its head and swishing its tail, heading south. Utterly without reliance, it knows how to turn its body. This is Linji’s own matter; it is not entirely the same as shifting position and shifting function. In the Linji Record it says: Only the person of no reliance who hears the Dharma is the mother of all Buddhas. Therefore Buddhas arise from no reliance. If one awakens to no reliance, Buddha too is not attained. If one thus sees, that is true and proper understanding. Wansong said, If Luopu could not turn his body, how could he shout at Jia-shan? If you say he did turn his body, why then at the end was he speechless? Try and judge it. Tiantong grants him eyes and skill, and Jia-shan too was not without that power to cut off the tongues of all under heaven, skillfully standing on the command. The only issue was making the tongueless man speak. He teased the nostrils of heaven and lightly tugged them back. Foguo, seeing Jia- shan’s words seeming like muttered incantations, added a comment saying, Where did you get this whole bundle of clutter? Wansong said, This itself is it: Jia-shan teaching the tongueless man to speak. Foguo lacked this bundle; he could only cut off the tongues of all under heaven. Even if there is another place to turn the body and exhale breath, it may not yet be the speech of a tongueless man. Tell me then, what is this person’s realm? The verse says: Outside the night-bright curtain, wind and moon are like day; before the dead-tree cliff, flowers ever spring. This is the tongueless man’s use and enjoyment. Emperor Ming of Han built the Hall of Brightness, using pearls and gems for curtains, with golden thresholds and jade steps, bright day and night. Tong’an Cha said, Before the dead-tree cliff there are many branching roads. Dongshan said, You must sprinkle some flower seeds on the dead tree. This verse says that at the tip of the staff and beneath the shout there is indeed a lonely steepness, but having reached the top of a hundred-foot pole, one must still take one more step. Only then does the tongueless man speak. Thus we know: words coming from the tongueless man are precisely the full raising of the proper command, one intimate and cutting phrase. Here one’s eyes tower over the four seas, striding alone through the world. Later Luopu said, Let everyone under heaven rejoice as they like. I alone do not consent. Even if all under heaven willingly let him cut off their tongues, Jia-shan said, Above this there is yet another opening. What is that higher opening? The tongueless man speaking, that is what I tell you.

text_en: 36. Master Ma Is Unwell Addressing the assembly, he said: To investigate apart from mind, thought, and consciousness, there is this. To study beyond the road of ordinary and holy,

text_zh: 示眾云。離心意識參。有這箇在。出凡聖路學。 已太高生。紅爐迸出鐵蒺䔧。舌劍脣槍難下 口。不犯鋒鋩。試請舉看。

text_zh: 舉。馬大師不安未必似維摩院主問。和尚近日尊 位如何常住事忙少得問候大師云。日面佛月面佛莫是轉筋 霍亂麼。

The master said: The ancients, even while ill, still did Buddha-work. Nanyue Huisi, when a grave illness suddenly

text_zh: 師云。古人病中猶為佛事。南嶽思大病障忽 生。便就病作一則因緣。參云。病從業生。業從 妄生。妄從心生。心本無生。病從何有。作是念 已。忽然平復。萬松道。從如來禪。得安樂處。 西京奉聖深禪師。有尼總持作略。病起作頌 云。氣絕絕情緒。舉意無意路。瞬目尚無力常 年不出戶。雖是祖師禪。大似布袋裏老鴉。芙 蓉楷和尚道。只此一頌自然紹得吾宗。萬松 道。雖然已是太多。不妨更有事在。馬大師又 不然。院主不敢直問病體增損。微取覆和尚 近日尊位如何。是他不說如來禪祖師禪。只 道箇日面佛月面佛。且道。他意作麼生。佛果 云。如今多有人道。馬大師接院主。有般底努 眼云。在這裏。左右眼是日面佛月面佛。有底 道。點平胃散來。有甚麼巴鼻。壽禪師道。無一 名不播如來之號。無一物不闡遮那之形。萬 松道。佛名經中有此二佛名。大師意旨畢竟 如何。不見道。馬駒踏殺天下人。天覺頌云。什 邡駒子氣生獰。蹴踏毘盧頂上行。正患脾疼 指頭痛。病來猶有巧心情。萬松道。本性難 移。山河易改。此頌馬祖雖病假中。亦以本分 事為人。我輩色身強健。切莫辜負馬祖怠慢 天童。頌云。
text_en: arose, made from that illness a case of causation, contemplating thus: Illness arises from karma; karma arises from delusion; delusion arises from mind. Mind is originally unborn. From where then does illness come? Having thought thus, he suddenly recovered. Wansong said, From Tathagata Zen he found a place of peace and ease. Chan Master Shen of Fengsheng in the Western Capital had a nun, Zongchi, of notable capacity. When illness came she composed a verse, saying: Breath cut off, all feelings spent; raise an intention and there is no road for intention. Even blinking lacks strength; all year I do not leave the door. Though this is Patriarchs’ Zen, it is much like an old crow in a cloth sack. Furong Kai master said, This single verse naturally inherits our school. Wansong said, Even so, it is already too much; still, there is yet more to it. Master Ma, however, was not like that. The Yuanzhu did not dare directly ask whether the illness was better or worse; he tactfully asked master how his honored condition had been recently. He did not speak of Tathagata Zen or Patriarchs’ Zen, but only said, Sun-Faced Buddha, Moon-Faced Buddha. Tell me, what was his meaning? Foguo said, Nowadays many people say Master Ma answered the Yuanzhu. Some strain their eyes and say, Here it is: the left and right eyes are Sun-Faced Buddha and Moon-Faced Buddha. Some say, Bring some stomach-settling powder. What handle is there in that? Chan Master Shou said, There is not one name that does not broadcast the Tathagata’s title; there is not one thing that does not reveal Vairocana’s form. Wan- song said, In the Sutra of Buddha Names there are indeed these two Buddha names. But Master Ma’s intent, after all, what was it? Have you not heard: Ma’s colt tramples the people of the world to death. Tianjue’s verse says: The colt of Shifang, fierce in spirit from birth, kicks and tramples as it walks upon Vairocana’s crown. Just when the spleen aches and the fingers hurt, when illness comes there is still a deft state of mind. Wansong said, Original nature is hard to change; mountains and rivers are easier altered. This verse says that though Mazu was in sick leave, he still used the fundamental matter to help people. Our own physical bodies are strong and healthy; by no means should we fail Mazu and treat Tiantong carelessly. The verse says:
Sun-face, moon-face, stars streaming, lightning curling; a mirror faces forms and has no partiality. Look at it and you go blind at once. Already past Silla.

text_zh: 日面月面覷著即瞎　星流電卷已過新羅　鏡對像而無私 一點難謾珠在盤而自轉拏捉不住　君不見。鉆鎚前百 鍊之金瓶盆釵釧券盂盤刀尺下一機之絹衾被衣冠襟領袖
text_en: A single point is hard to conceal. A pearl in a tray turns of itself. Do you not see? Before hammer and tongs, the hundred- It cannot be seized or caught. refined gold; Bottles, basins, hairpins, bracelets, bowls, and trays. beneath knife and shears, the one-bolt silk. Quilts and covers, robes and caps, lapels, collars, and sleeves.
The master said: These two Buddhas, Sun-Faced and Moon-Faced, are like stars streaming and lightning curling, leaving no room for deliberation.

text_zh: 師云。此日面月面二佛。如星流電卷不容擬 議。昔秦宮以玉為鏡。照群僚。肝膽臟腑皆現。 又狐狸為人。鏡中唯現本形。此無私隱也。物 類相感志。閬風浦出珠。置器中自轉。謂之走 珠。此頌馬祖心如古鏡。機似走珠。不留影迹 也。百鍊之金。在作家鉆鎚。一機之絹。在工 巧刀尺。僧問雲巖。大保任底人與那箇。是一 是二。巖云。一機之絹。是一段。是兩段。洞山 代云。如人接木。此乃境與神會。智與理冥。天 水同秋。君臣道合。絹得刀尺。則裁剪由人。金 得鉆鎚。則鍛鍊在己。且道衲僧分上成得箇 甚麼邊事。日面佛月面佛。
text_en: Long ago, the Qin palace used jade as mirrors. When the officials were reflected, their liver, gall, and organs all appeared. And when foxes transformed into people, in the mirror only their true form appeared. This is concealment without partiality. Things of like kind respond to each other. At Langfeng Ford a pearl emerged; placed in a vessel, it turned by itself. This is called a rolling pearl. This verse praises Mazu’s mind as an ancient mirror, his function like a rolling pearl, leaving no trace or shadow. Hundred-refined gold belongs under the hammer and tongs of a master craftsman; one-bolt silk belongs under the skillful knife and shears. A monk asked Yunyan, The person of great assurance and that one, are they one or two? Yan said, One-bolt silk. Is it one piece or two pieces? Dongshan answered in his stead, Like a person grafting wood. This is where circumstance and spirit meet, wisdom and principle merge in darkness. Heaven and water share one autumn; ruler and minister are in accord with the Way. If silk gets knife and shears, cutting is left to the person; if gold gets hammer and tongs, tempering lies in oneself. Tell me, on the patch-robed monk’s side, what thing is accomplished? What sort of matter is it? Sun-Faced Buddha, Moon-Faced Buddha.

text_en: 37. Weishan on Karmic Consciousness Addressing the assembly, he said: Drive off the plowman’s ox and yank back its nose-ring; snatch food from a hungry man.

text_en: Clamp his throat tight. Is there anyone who can lay on such a poisonous hand?

Yang said, If a monk comes, I immediately call out, Monk so-and-so. When he turns his A blow behind the head, and he does not know where it came from. head, I then say, What is it? If he starts to deliberate, I tell him, Not only is karmic consciousness vast and dim, it also has no basis to rely on. Up through the crown-gate go the three souls. While the stove is hot, give another blow. The soles of the feet are pierced through to the seven spirits. Wei said, Excellent. Seized alive and captured living. Bitter words come from true concern.
The master cited: A monk asked Yun’an, The Huayan Treatise says that the afflictions of fundamental ignorance

text_zh: 師舉。僧問雲庵。華嚴論。以無明住地煩惱。便 為一切諸佛不動智。理極深玄絕難曉達。庵 曰。此最分明易可了解。時有童子。方掃除。呼 之迴首。庵指曰。不是不動智。仰山召僧迴首。 正是這箇時節。雲庵却問。如何是汝佛性。童 左右視惘然而去。庵曰。不是住地煩惱。若能 了之。即今成佛。童子惘然與擬議不別。無明 住地煩惱。業識茫茫亦同。雲庵仰山勘僧驗 人。剋的如此。萬松見處即不然。童子與僧徹 底皆不動智。雲庵仰嶠。從頭業識茫茫。若人 辨得親見天童。頌云。
text_en: are precisely the unmoving wisdom of all Buddhas. The principle is extremely deep and mysterious, very hard to understand. An said, This is the clearest and easiest to understand. At that time a boy was sweeping. He called to him, and the boy turned his head. An pointed and said, Is this not unmoving wisdom? When Yangshan called the monk and he turned his head, it was exactly this moment. Yet Yun’an then asked, What is your Buddha-nature? The boy looked left and right in confusion and went away. An said, Is this not the affliction abiding at the ground? If one can understand it, one becomes Buddha right now. The boy’s confusion is no different from deliberation. Fundamental ignorance, ground-abiding affliction, and karmic consciousness vast and dim are the same. Yun’an and Yangshan examined monks and tested people, exact like this. Wansong’s own view is otherwise: the boy and the monk, through and through, are both unmoving wisdom. Yun’an and Yangqiao, from the very start, are karmic consciousness vast and dim. If a person can discern this, he meets Tiantong face to face. The verse says:
Called once, he turns his head. Do you know me or not? Dim through gauze, the moon again becomes a hook. Truly plain as day; how hard is it to spot the thief?

text_zh: 一喚迴頭識我不真白拈賊有甚難見　依俙蘿月又成鉤 藏身露影千金之子纔流落𫺬風雖破骨骼猶存　漠漠窮途有 許愁小器不大量
text_en: Hiding the body, exposing the shadow. The son of a thousand in gold has only just fallen into exile; on the vast and desolate poor road there is Though the wind shatters it, the frame still remains. such sorrow. A small vessel lacks great capacity.
The master cited: Baizhang ascended the hall. As the assembly was gathering, he struck with his staff all at once, then

text_zh: 師舉。百丈上堂。眾方集。以拄杖一時打下。復 召大眾。眾迴首。丈云。是甚麼。諸方目為百丈 下堂句。也好參詳。王荊公曰。我得雪峯一句 語。作宰相。人固請益。公曰。這老子常向人道 是甚麼。此一句頌召僧迴首。并是甚麼。識我 不者。不字甫鳩切。弗也。意問識我也無。仰山 用無義手。打不防家。這僧若石火光中瞥地。 可謂鬧市裏識取天子也。忽若擬議不來。則 依俙蘿月又成鉤也。黃蘗上堂眾方集。以拄 杖一時打下。復召大眾。眾迴首。蘗云。月似彎 弓少雨多風。頌意用此。石室善道。與仰山玩 月。仰問。月尖時圓相甚麼處去。圓時尖相又 甚麼處去。室云。尖時圓相隱。圓時尖相在。雲 巖云。尖時圓相在。圓時尖相無。道吾云。尖時 亦不尖。圓時亦不圓。成鉤尖相也。駱賓王詩。 既能圓似鏡。何用曲如鉤。華嚴宗名祕密隱 顯俱成門。又教中說十地菩薩見性。如隔羅 縠觀月。若作羅月亦可。然李白詩。有蘿月挂 朝鏡。松風鳴夜絃。蘿字義長。天童以朦朧新 月。隱映煙蘿。雖不圓明。已露圭角。頌出這僧 半明半暗。若存若亡處。萬松大似鹽鐵判官。 良以天童。深細針線。若不絲頭不斷。難成織 錦之文。密師伯與洞山行。次見白兔過。密 曰。俊哉。山曰。作麼生。密云。如白衣拜相。山 云。老老大大作這箇語話。密云。爾又作麼生。 山云。積代簪纓暫時落薄。司馬相如上林賦。 千金之子坐不垂堂。阮籍常坐以柴車。逢窮 途輒慟哭而迴。萬松道。若能就路還家。便得 轉身歸父。不見道。一念迴光便同本得。既然 如是。為甚麼。諸佛不動智。到一切眾生分上。 喚作業識茫茫。早知燈是火。飯熟已多時。
text_en: called the great assembly. The assembly turned their heads. Zhang said, What is it? Various places call this Baizhang’s down-from-the-hall line; it is worth studying. Wang Jinggong said, I gained one phrase from Xuefeng and became prime minister. People pressed him for more, and he said, That old fellow always tells people, What is it? This line of the verse praises calling the monk and his turning his head, together with What is it? Know me or not? The word not here is read as fu, meaning not. The intent is, Do you know me or not? Yangshan used the hand of no meaning and struck an unguarded household. If this monk had, in the flash of flint-fire, caught it at once, it could be called recognizing the Son of Heaven in a bustling market. But if he starts deliberating and cannot come forth, then the dim moon through gauze again becomes a hook. Huangbo ascended the hall as the assembly gathered, and with his staff struck all at once, then again called the assembly. The assembly turned their heads. Bo said, The moon is like a bent bow, little rain and much wind. The verse’s meaning uses this. Stone Chamber Shandao, together with Yangshan, was admiring the moon. Yang asked, When the moon is pointed, where does its round form go? When it is round, where does the pointed form Where does it go? Shishi said, When pointed, the round aspect is hidden; when round, the pointed aspect remains. Yun yan said, When pointed, the round aspect is present; when round, the pointed aspect is absent. Daowu said, When pointed, it is also not pointed; when round, it is also not round. Made into a hook, it is a pointed form. In Luo Binwang's poem: Since it can be round like a mirror, what use is being curved like a hook? The Huayan school calls this the gate where hidden and manifest are both accomplished together in secret. The teachings also say the bodhisattvas of the ten stages see nature as though through gauze, like viewing the moon through thin silk. If one reads it as vine-moon, that also works. And in Li Bai's poem there is, a vine-moon hangs on the morning mirror; pine wind sounds on the night strings. The meaning of vine is rich. Tiantong uses the dim new moon, half veiled by misty vines. Though not full and bright, it already shows its edges. The verse brings out this monk's half-bright, half-dark state, as if present, as if absent. Wansong is very much like an official judge of salt and iron. Truly, Tiantong's stitching is deep and fine. If the thread-end does not remain unbroken, it is hard to weave the pattern of brocade. Elder Mi was walking with Dongshan, and they saw a white rabbit pass by. Mi said, Splendid! Shan said, How so? Mi said, Like a commoner appointed minister. Shan said, So old and yet you speak like this. Mi said, Then how would you put it? Shan said, A house of generations in caps and ornaments, temporarily fallen into poverty. In Sima Xiangru's Shanglin Fu: The son of wealth does not sit beneath a crumbling hall. Ruan Ji often rode a firewood cart, and when he met a dead end on the road, he would weep bitterly and return. Wansong says, If one can return home right on the road, then one gains turning the body and going back to the father. Have you not heard: with one thought turning the light around, one is at once the same as original attainment. Since it is so, why is it that the unmoving wisdom of all buddhas, when it comes to the share of all beings, is called vast and dim karmic consciousness? Had you known earlier that the lamp was fire, the rice would have been cooked long ago.

text_zh: 38 臨濟真人
text_en: 38 Linji's True Person Instruction to the assembly: Taking a thief for your son, recognizing a servant as your heir, how could a broken wooden ladle be your ancestors'

text_zh: 示眾云。以賊為子。認奴作郎。破木杓豈是先 祖髑髏。驢鞍鞽亦非阿爺下頷。裂土分茅時 如何辨主。
text_en: skull? A donkey saddle is not your father's jaw either. When land is divided and fiefs bestowed, how do you distinguish the true master?
Citation. Linji addressed the assembly, saying: There is one true person of no rank who always The foundation is set and the footing fixed.

text_zh: 舉。臨濟示眾云。有一無位真人安基定脚了也常 向汝等面門出入背後底聻初心未證據者看看 還具眼麼時有僧問。如何是無位真人還解語麼濟下 禪床擒住爾更諱這僧擬議鈍滯他真人濟托開云。無 位真人。是甚乾屎橛大似持鉢不得。
text_en: goes in and out through the gate of your face. Those who have not yet verified it, look, look. What about the one behind your back? At that time a monk asked, What is the true person of no rank? Ji got down from Do you yet have eyes? Do you yet understand speech? the meditation seat, seized the monk. As the monk hesitated, Ji pushed him away and said, The true person of no And you still evade it. You blunt and obstruct that true person. rank, what kind of dried shit-stick is that? It is just like being unable to hold the bowl.
The master said: In Linji's fuller discourse he says, Within the field of the five-skandha body there is a true person of no rank.

text_zh: 師舉。臨濟廣語道。五蘊身田內。有無位真人。 堂堂顯露。無絲髮許間隔。何不識取。心法無 形。通貫十方。既言通貫十方。不止在五蘊身 田面門出入。初心未證據者看看。萬松道。無 位真人。看眾僧。眾僧看真人。時有僧問。如何 是無位真人。諸方喚作和聲送事。爭奈騎驢 者。不見坐下。濟下禪床擒住。且道。真人在那 頭。好與一掌。這僧擬議。真人不在。可惜許。 濟托開云。無位真人。是甚乾屎橛。當面諱 却。雪峯云。臨濟大似白拈賊。萬松道。敗也。 雪竇云。夫善竊者鬼神莫知。既被雪峯覷破。 臨濟不是好手。復召大眾。雪竇今日換爾諸 人眼睛了也。爾若不信。各自歸寮舍。摸索 看。萬松道。雪竇和眉毛失却。要解賊手中作 賊。問取天童始得。頌云。
text_en: Openly and plainly revealed, without even a hair's breadth of separation. Why not recognize it? The mind-dharma has no form; it penetrates throughout the ten directions. Since it is said to penetrate the ten directions, it is not limited to the five-skandha body or to coming and going through the face-gate. Those who have not verified it, look. Wansong says: The true person of no rank looks at the monks; the monks look at the true person. Then a monk asked, What is the true person of no rank? Various places call this harmonizing the voice and carrying things along. But how can the rider of the donkey fail to see the one sitting below? Linji got down from the seat and seized him. Tell me, where was the true person then? He deserved a slap. The monk hesitated, and the true person was no longer there. What a pity. Linji shoved him away and said, The true person of no rank, what dried shit-stick is that? Right before his face it was hidden, yet he turned away. Xuefeng said, Linji is very much like a bare-handed thief. Wansong says, He is exposed. Xuedou said, A truly skilled thief is unknown even to ghosts and spirits. Since Xuefeng saw through him, Linji was not a good hand. Then he called to the assembly again: Today Xuedou has changed all your eyes for you. If you do not believe it, each go back to your quarters and feel around and see. Wansong says, Xuedou lost his eyebrows too. If you would learn to play thief in the thief's own hands, you must ask Tiantong. The verse says:
Delusion and awakening turn back upon each other, subtle transmission yet simple; spring splits a hundred flowers, and with one Not separated by even a hair. Already stained by dust and smoke.

text_zh: 迷悟相返不隔絲毫　妙傳而簡已犯風煙　春坼百花兮一 吹放去較危力迴九牛兮一挽收來太速　無奈泥沙撥不 開我眼本正分明塞斷甘泉眼因師故邪　忽然突出肆橫 流掀倒禪床怪不得。
text_en: blow Letting it go is more perilous. strength turns nine oxen, and with one pull; yet there is no help for mud and sand that cannot be Pulling it back is too hasty. cleared My eye was originally straight. Clearly blocking off the sweet spring's source, then suddenly bursting forth and wildly Because of the teacher, it turned crooked. flowing. If he overturns the Chan seat, no wonder. The master added: Dangerous. He throws down his staff and says, I let this move pass.

text_zh: 師復云。險擲下拄杖云放過一著
text_en: The master said: The Complete Enlightenment Sutra says, It is like a confused man who changes places in the four directions, though the directions themselves

text_zh: 師云。圓覺云。猶如迷人四方易處。其實方本 不移。悟時亦只依舊。宗鏡云。從來迷悟似迷。 今日悟迷非悟。此真妙傳而簡。惠而不費。薦 得則赤肉團。便是無位真人。不薦則真人依 舊面門出入。這僧也有。只是拈不出。用不行。 却與真人。作奴傳言。送語問消問息。勞他臨 濟降尊就卑覿體全用。這僧既措手不及。臨 濟亦抽身不顧。見得匙抄不上。便道。無位真 人是甚乾屎橛。此能放能收。呼得聚。喝得散。 終不繫綴死在句下與人胸次作病。天台云。 吹一吹即世界成。喝一喝即世界壞。更道。當 吹時便喝。當喝時便吹。列子公儀子以力聞。 周宣王備禮聘之。既至。懦夫也。王問。卿力 何如。對曰。臣能折春蟲之股。堪秋蟬之翼。王 作色曰。吾力能裂犀兕之革。曳九牛之尾。猶 憾其弱。爾如是而以力聞何也。對曰。臣之名 不以負其力者。以能用其力者也。此頌臨濟 收放力用。法眼開井。被沙塞却泉眼。問僧。泉 眼不通沙塞。道眼不通。被甚麼物礙。僧無對。 自代云。被眼礙。且道。是這僧塞斷泉眼。臨 濟塞斷泉眼。忽然突出時如何。師拈拄杖下 座。大眾一時走散。
text_en: never moved. At awakening too, it is just as before. The Mirror of the School says, From the start delusion and awakening were like delusion; today awakening to delusion is not awakening. This is truly subtle transmission and simplicity, beneficent without cost. If one realizes it, then this lump of red flesh is precisely the true person of no rank. If one does not realize it, the true person still goes in and out through the face-gate as before. This monk also had it; he simply could not bring it forth or use it. Instead he made himself the true person's servant, passing messages, delivering words, asking this and that, troubling Linji to lower himself and meet him directly, using the whole body. Since the monk could not respond in time, Linji also withdrew and did not look back. Seeing the spoon could not ladle it up, he then said, The true person of no rank, what dried shit-stick is that? Here he could release and gather, call and they assembled, shout and they scattered. He never tied things down dead under a phrase and made a sickness in people's chests. Tiantai says: Blow once and a world is formed; shout once and a world is destroyed. It further says: When it is time to blow, then shout; when it is time to shout, then blow. In Liezi, Gongyizi was famed for strength. King Xuan of Zhou invited him with full ceremony. When he arrived, he looked timid. The king asked, Your strength, what is it like? He replied, I can break the leg of a spring insect and bear the wing of an autumn cicada. The king changed color and said, My strength can tear rhinoceros hide and drag the tails of nine oxen, and I still regret that it is weak. How is it that you are famed for strength being as you are? He replied, My reputation does not come from bearing strength, but from being able to use strength. This verse praises Linji's power in gathering and releasing. Fayan opened a well, but sand blocked the spring-source. He asked a monk, The spring-source is blocked by sand and does not flow. If the eye of the Way does not penetrate, by what thing is it obstructed? The monk had no reply. He answered for him: Obstructed by the eye. Tell me then, was it this monk who blocked the spring-source, or was Linji the one who blocked the spring-source? When it suddenly bursts forth, what then? The master lifted his staff and came down from the seat. The whole assembly scattered at once.

text_zh: 39 趙州洗鉢
text_en: 39 Zhaozhou Washes the Bowl Instruction to the assembly: When food comes, open your mouth; when sleep comes, close your eyes. At the place of washing your face, if you pick up your nose,

text_zh: 示眾云。飯來張口。睡來合眼。洗面處拾得鼻 孔󱖘鞋時。摸著脚跟。那時蹉却話頭。把火夜 深別覓。如何得相應去。
text_en: and when putting on shoes, touch your heel, yet at that moment you miss the word-head, then carrying fire at night and searching elsewhere in the dark, how will you ever come into accord?

Citation. A monk asked Zhaozhou, A student has just entered the monastery and asks for instruction. Zhou said, Have you eaten your gruel yet? The monk said, I have eaten. Zhou said, Go wash your bowl. The monastery grove

text_zh: 舉。僧問趙州。學人乍入叢林乞。師指示叢林 於爾亦不惡州云。喫粥了也未渾金璞玉僧云。喫了久慣衲僧 不如上座州云。洗鉢盂去不得左猜。
text_en: is not bad for you either. Solid gold, uncut jade. Long accustomed to patch-robed monks. Not equal to the senior monk. Do not guess sideways.
The master said: Fishing for a dragon with a straight hook is already not skillful. When the lacquer bucket is still three inches from the hook, it is already

text_zh: 師云。直鉤釣龍。已是不快。漆桶離鉤三寸。已 輪舡子夾山占斷。不道時人無分。大都貪餌 吞鉤。看。他趙州亦不拗折釣竿。亦不蹋翻舡 子。石橋上閑坐。略彴邊度時。自有上岸來入 手底。本錄中。有其僧因此契悟。可謂竿頭絲 線從君弄。不犯清波意自殊。趙州任公。得志 於前。更看。天童鳴桹於後頌云。
text_en: the boatman and Jiashan cutting it off. It is not that people today have no share in it; mostly they just greedily take the bait and swallow the hook. Look, Zhaozhou neither snapped the fishing rod nor overturned the boat; he sat at ease on the stone bridge, and when passing by the little footbridge, there were naturally those who came ashore and fell into his hands. In the original record, that monk is said to have awakened on this account. It can be said the thread on the rod-tip was yours to play with; without disturbing the clear waves, the meaning was naturally distinct. Zhaozhou, like Ren Gong, found success in front; now watch Tiantong beat the oar behind in the verse:
After the gruel, he orders him to wash the bowl; suddenly the ground of mind accords of itself. Such a swift opening is hard to meet. Not only today.

text_zh: 粥罷令教洗鉢盂快便難逢　豁然心地自相符非但今日 而今參飽叢林客依舊喫粥了洗鉢盂去　且道。其間有悟 無一人傳虛萬人傳實
text_en: Now, you monastery guests stuffed full of meditation, say then, within this is there awakening As always, after eating porridge, wash your bowl and go. or not? One person passes on hearsay, ten thousand pass it on as fact.
The master said: Lingyun saw peach blossoms and awakened to the Way, then presented a verse to Weishan. Shan said,

text_zh: 師舉。靈雲見桃花悟道。呈頌於溈山。山云。 從緣入者永無退失。玄沙聞云。諦當甚諦當。 敢保老兄未徹在。雲聞云。和尚徹也未。沙云。 恁麼始得。天童頌這僧契悟心地相符。這僧 乍入叢林。稱大悟大徹。飽叢林禪客。且道。有 悟無悟。此謂之徵問。雪竇云。本無迷悟數如 麻。獨許靈雲是作家。玄沙道未徹。雪竇獨許 作家。徐六擔板。各見一邊。且道。洗鉢盂。僧 有悟也無。太平本是將軍致。不許將軍見太 平。
text_en: One who enters from conditions will never retreat or lose it. Xuansha heard this and said, Truly right, very truly right. Yet I dare guarantee our elder brother has not fully penetrated. Lingyun heard and said, Has master fully penetrated or not? Sha said, Only thus is it so. Tiantong's verse praises this monk's awakening, the mind-ground mutually matching. This monk, newly entering the monastery, is called greatly awakened, greatly penetrated. You well-fed Chan guests of the monastery, tell me: is there awakening or no awakening? This is called a probing question. Xuedou said, Originally there is no fixed count of delusion and awakening as many as hemp; only Lingyun is allowed to be a master hand. Xuansha said not yet through, yet Xuedou alone approved him as a master hand. Xu Liu carrying a plank, each sees only one side. Tell me, in washing the bowl, did the monk awaken or not? Peace is originally brought by the general, but the general is not permitted to see the peace he brought.

text_zh: 40 雲門白黑
text_en: 40 Yunmen White and Black Instruction to the assembly: Where the pivot-wheel turns, even the eye of wisdom is still confused. When the jeweled mirror opens, not a mote of dust

text_zh: 示眾云。機輪轉處。智眼猶迷。寶鑑開時。纖塵 不度。開拳不落地。應物善知時。兩刃相逢時 如何迴互。
text_en: passes through. When the fist opens, it does not fall to the ground. When responding to things and knowing the right time, when two blades meet, how do they turn and interpenetrate?
Citation. Yunmen asked Qianfeng, Please, Master, answer a saying. Feng said, Even old monk has not yet arrived. Empty-headed, submerged to the crown.

text_zh: 舉。雲門問乾峯。請師答話空頭沒頂𩕳峯云。到 老僧也未早箇答汝了也門云。恁麼則某甲在遲也 讓則有餘峯云。恁麼那恁麼那切忌恁麼會門云。將謂 侯白。更有侯黑好手手中無好手。
text_en: Men said, Then I am late. I already answered you long ago. Feng said, So then, so then. Men said, I had thought Yielding leaves more than enough. Above all, do not understand it this way. there was only Hou Bai, but there is also a Hou Hei. In the hands of a master, there is no masterly hand.
The master said: King Milinda asked the venerable Nagasena, I am about to put a question; can the master answer?

text_zh: 師云。彌闌王問那先尊者。我將申問。師能答 否。先云。請王致問。王曰。我已問竟。先云。我 已答竟。王曰。師何所答。先云。王何所問。王 曰。我無所問。先云。我無所答。此猶可尋究。 雲門問處。如晴空激電。乾峯答處。如旱地奔 雷。及乎雙放雙收。却見有頭有尾。此所以非 衲僧不知。非作家不見。天童和尚深入此門。 頌云。
text_en: Nagasena said, Please let the king ask. The king said, I have already asked. Nagasena said, I have already answered. The king said, What did the master answer? Nagasena said, What did the king ask? The king said, I asked nothing. Nagasena said, I answered nothing. This can still be investigated. Yunmen's question was like lightning flashing in a clear sky. Qianfeng's answer was like thunder running over dry ground. When it comes to both releasing and both gathering, then one sees head and tail. Therefore it is not something ordinary patch-robed monks can know; unless one is a master hand, one cannot see it. Master Tiantong penetrated deeply into this gate. The verse says:
Bowstring and nock answering each other, net-jewels facing one another; a hundred shots, and every arrow High and low are answered alike. Left and right both meet the source.

text_zh: 弦筈相𠾑高低普應　網珠相對左右逢原　發百中而箭箭 不虛對揚有準攝眾景而光光無礙獨耀無私　得言句之 總持出語成章住游戲之三昧舉動合拍　妙其間也宛轉 偏圓如珠走盤必如是也縱橫自在看取令行時
text_en: does not miss. In exchange and expression, there is a standard. Gathering all scenes, every light is unobstructed; obtaining the dharani of words and phrases, Alone it shines, without partiality. total retention. When words come out, they form patterns. Abiding in the samadhi of play, wondrous within it, turning and shifting, Every motion matches the beat. partial and complete. Like pearls rolling on a tray. It must be thus, free in every direction. Watch when the command is carried out.
The master said: Once missed on the string, it must still be released. This verse praises the sharpness of Yunmen's question,

text_zh: 師云。失在弦上。不可不發。此頌雲門問處機 鋒不可觸。網珠相對。此頌乾峯答處賓主交 參問在答處。答在問處。百發百中。頌雲門某 甲在遲。智覺道。如人射地無有不中之理。交 光相羅。事事無礙。頌乾峯恁麼那。華嚴疏。帝 釋殿貫珠成網。光影互現。重重無盡。此頌公 案大意。不必句句配屬膠柱調絃也。雲門道。 將謂侯白。更有侯黑。隋朝有侯白字君素。滑 稽辯給之士也。大將軍楊素見知。撰旌異記。 人神報應甚詳。亦可尚也。唐朝有李白。能詩。 後有李赤效之。甚不類也。人傳為笑。今言侯 黑。亦其類也。有本云。我早侯白。伊更侯黑。 言更甚也。總持有三。多字一字無字。總持一 切法門。三昧正定也。天童偏圓猶事理。也觀 國師云。理圓。言偏。言生。理喪。天台止觀云。 圓伊三點。非如點水之縱。亦非列火之橫。又 竪窮三際名高。橫遍十方名廣。故法華云。其 車高廣。天童傍通教海。洞貫義天。雲門乾峯。 立無字碑。天童歌詠入無言詩。可謂。楊脩見 幼婦。一覽便知妙。
text_en: whose edge cannot be touched. Net-jewels facing one another praises Qianfeng's answer, where host and guest interweave. The question is in the answer; the answer is in the question. A hundred shots, a hundred hits, praising Yunmen's I am late. Zhijue said, If a man shoots at the earth, there is no principle by which he can miss. Interlaced lights net each other, and every thing is unobstructed. This praises Qianfeng's so then. In the Huayan commentary, Indra's palace is strung with pearls into a net; lights and reflections appear in one another, layer upon layer without end. This verse gives the general meaning of the koan; there is no need to force every line to match point by point. Yunmen said, I had thought there was Hou Bai, but there is also Hou Hei. In the Sui dynasty there was Hou Bai, styled Junsu, a witty and eloquent man. The great general Yang Su recognized him. He compiled the Jingyi Ji. Its accounts of human and spirit retribution are very detailed and worthy. In the Tang there was Li Bai, skilled in poetry. Later there was Li Chi who imitated him, but was nothing like him, and people laughed. So now to say Hou Hei is of that kind too. Some editions say, I was already Hou Bai, and he is even more Hou Hei. Meaning, even more so. Dharani has three kinds: many-word, one-word, and no-word. Dharani is to retain all dharma-gates. Samadhi is right concentration. Tiantong's partial and complete still refer to phenomena and principle. Guoshi said, Principle is complete; words are partial. When words arise, principle is lost. Tiantai's Calming and Contemplation says: The three dots of the rounded syllable are not vertical like drops of water, nor horizontal like a row of fire. Also, to extend vertically through the three times is called lofty; to spread horizontally through the ten directions is called vast. Therefore the Lotus says, its carriage is lofty and broad. Tiantong ranges through the ocean of teaching and penetrates the sky of meaning. Yunmen and Qianfeng set up a wordless stele; Tiantong sings and chants it into a poem without words. It may be said, as Yang Xiu saw the young wife, one glance and he knew the subtlety.

text_zh: 41 洛浦臨終
text_en: 41 Luopu at the End Instruction to the assembly: At times one is loyal and sincere, knocking in bitterness, with injustice hard to voice. At times calamity reaches him,

text_zh: 示眾云。有時忠誠。扣已苦屈難申。有時殃及。 向人承當不下。臨行賤折倒。末後最慇懃。泪 出痛腸。更難隱諱。還有冷眼者麼。
text_en: and before others he cannot bear it. On the verge of departure he collapses cheaply; at the very end he is most earnest, tears coming from the painful bowels, harder still to conceal. Is there anyone here with a cool eye?
Citation. As Luopu was nearing death, he addressed the assembly, saying: Now there is one matter. I ask all of you.

text_zh: 舉。洛浦臨終示眾云。今有一事。問爾諸人。 猶自說兵機這箇若是即頭上安頭恁麼也不得若不是 即斬頭覓活不恁麼也不得時首座云。青山常舉足。 白日不挑燈語得分明出轉難浦云。是甚麼時節。作 這箇說話失錢遭罪有彥從上座。出云。去此二途。 請師不問易開終始口難保歲寒心浦云。未在更道詩到重吟始見功 從云。某甲道不盡不教人見轉風流浦云。我不管爾 道盡道不盡放沒底未不得不休從云。某甲無侍者祇 對和尚影草隨身至晚喚從上座。爾今日祇對甚 有來由只管習粘頭合體得先師道。目前無法。意 在目前斫却月中桂清光應更多他不是目前法。非耳目之 所到月落來相見那句是賓那句是主切忌話作兩橛若揀 得出。分付鉢袋子把棒喚狗從云。不會正合分付浦云。 汝合會將成九仞之山從云。實不會不進一簣之土浦喝云。苦 哉苦哉賺殺一舡人僧問。和尚尊意如何失火處拾膚炭浦 云。慈舟不棹清波上。劍峽徒勞放木鵝弄巧成拙。
text_en: If this is so, then it is putting a head on top of a head; if it is not so, Still talking of military stratagems. Like this will not do. Just when cutting off the head to seek life, the head monk said, Green mountains are always lifting their feet. Not like this will not do either. In broad daylight one does not carry a lamp. Luopu said, What time is this, to make Speak it clearly, and it becomes even harder to get out. such a statement? There was Senior Monk Yancong, who stepped out and said, Leaving aside these two paths, Lose money and incur punishment. I ask the master not to question them. Luopu said, Not there yet. Speak further. Easy to open one’s mouth at the start and finish; hard to keep one’s resolve through winter’s cold. Only when a poem is chanted again and again does its skill appear. Cong said, I cannot finish speaking it. Luopu said, I do not care whether you Not letting others see it makes it all the more elegant. finish speaking or not. Cong said, I have no attendant, I only Let it go to the bottomless depth—there is no choice but to stop. respond directly to master. By evening he called Senior Monk Cong: What was your response today Shadow and grass follow the body. based on? It must accord with and embody the former master's saying: Before the eyes there is no dharma; the meaning He just keeps practicing sticking his head in. is in what is before the eyes, yet it is not a dharma before the eyes; it is not reached by ear and eye. Chop down the cassia in the moon; the clear light should be even greater. Which phrase is guest, and which phrase is host? If you can distinguish them, When the moon sets, we meet. Strictly avoid splitting it into two pieces. I will entrust you with the robe and bowl. Cong said, I do not understand. Luopu said, Take up a stick and call the dog. Exactly fits the charge. You ought to understand. Cong said, I truly do not understand. Luopu shouted, Bitter! A mountain of nine rèn is about to be completed, yet you do not add even one basket of earth. Bitter indeed, bitter indeed! A monk asked, What is the venerable meaning of master? Luopu You swindle a whole boatload of people to death. Picking up bits of charcoal where there was a fire. said, The compassionate boat is not rowed upon clear waves; at Sword Gorge, it is vainly laboring to release the wooden goose. Trying to be clever and ending up clumsy.
The master said: At Luopu's death, his grandmotherly concern was too urgent. The head monk poured everything out, yet was instead

text_zh: 師云。洛浦臨終。婆心太切。首座盡情吐露。返 責非時。彥從不出脣皮。許伊合會。直得再三 撈漉。可憐一向沈埋。克賓甘罰饡飯錢。瞎驢 故滅正法眼。玄覺云。且道。從上座實不會。為 復怕鉢袋子沾著伊。故燈錄收從。入法嗣之 列。浦甞示眾云。直須旨外明宗。莫向言中取 則。僧問行不思議處如何。浦云。青山常舉足。 白日不移輪。以斯驗之。首座從公皎然可見。 洛浦分上還有人收後也無。百年之後却有 天童。頌云。
text_en: reproved for untimeliness. Yancong did not let it pass his lips, and was acknowledged as one who should understand. He was pressed again and again, dredged and fished for it. Pitifully, he remained buried all along. Kebin willingly paid the penalty of meal money; the blind donkey thus extinguished the true Dharma eye. Xuanzhao said: Tell me, did Senior Monk Cong truly not understand, or was he afraid the robe and bowl would stick to him? Therefore the Lamp Record includes Cong among the line of Dharma heirs. Luopu once instructed the assembly, One must clarify the school outside the intent; do not from words seek rules. A monk asked, What is it like to act in the inconceivable place? Luopu said, Green mountains are always lifting their feet. In broad daylight the sun-wheel does not move. Judged by this, the head monk and Master Cong are clearly seen. On Luopu's side, was there anyone to gather up what came later, or not? A hundred years later there was indeed Tiantong, who composed a verse, saying:
With cloud for bait and moon for hook, he fishes the clear ford; old in years, solitary in heart, he has not yet caught Without entering startling waves, it is hard to find a fish to your liking.

text_zh: 餌雲鉤月釣清津不入驚人浪難逢稱意魚　年老心孤未得 鱗氣急作麼一曲離騷歸去後在甚麼處　汨羅江上獨醒 人洛浦猶在
text_en: a scaled one. Why the panic? After one song of the Li Sao and going back, on the Miluo River he alone remained awake, Where is it? that lone awakened man. Luopu is still here.
The master said: The ancients took the long rainbow as rod, the new moon as hook, and broken clouds as bait.

text_zh: 師云。古人以長虹為竿。新月為鉤。斷雲為餌。 清津可以棹慈舟。劍峽先須放木鵞。杭州五 雲和尚坐禪箴云。㳂流劍閣無滯木鵞。蓋劍 水嶮隘迅流。如二舡相觸必碎。故先斫木浮 下。謂之木鵝。諸方異說難憑。莫若禪箴為良 證也。年老心孤未得鱗。不知者。以謂洛浦無 嗣。浦凡得一十一人。烏牙青峯等皆白眉老 作。莫莫庵訥和尚詩。今古利名酒。沈醉皆豪 英。憔悴澤畔者。未足為獨醒。屈原字平。仕楚 懷王。為三閭大夫。靳尚所譖。貶長沙。獨行江 畔。謂漁父曰。舉世皆醉。唯我獨醒。舉世皆 濁。唯我獨清。沈汨羅江而卒。江在潭州羅縣。 文選離騷經。屈原所作。洛浦臨終。彥從鈍滯。 下釣未分文入手。抗衡終水米無交。還會麼。 不得封侯。也是閑。
text_en: At the clear ford one may row the compassionate boat; at Sword Gorge one must first release the wooden goose. Hangzhou's Wuyun master's Meditation Admonition says: At the flowing Sword Pavilion no wooden goose may linger. For the sword- waters are dangerous, narrow, and swift; if two boats collide they must shatter. Therefore one first cuts wood and lets it float downstream; this is called a wooden goose. Various explanations in the monasteries are hard to trust; the Meditation Admonition is the best evidence. Old in years, solitary in heart, not yet catching a fish: those who do not know take this to mean Luopu had no heirs. Luopu in fact had eleven heirs; Wuya, Qingfeng, and the rest were all white-browed elders, accomplished men. Monk Ne of Momo Hermitage wrote: In all ages, profit, fame, and wine make heroes drunkenly sink; the haggard one by the marsh is not enough to count as solely awake. Qu Yuan, styled Ping, served the Chu King Huai as Grandee of Sanlü. Slandered by Jin Shang, he was banished to Changsha. Walking alone by the riverbank, he said to the fisherman: All the world is drunk; only I alone am awake. All the world is muddy; only I alone am clear. He drowned himself in the Miluo River and died. That river is in Luo County of Tanzhou. The Wenxuan includes the Li Sao, composed by Qu Yuan. At Luopu's death, Yancong was dull and sluggish. Casting the line below, he got not a coin in hand; matching himself against it, in the end there was no exchange even of water and rice. Do you understand? Not being enfeoffed as a marquis is also leisure.

text_zh: 42 南陽淨瓶
text_en: 42. Nanyang's Pure Vase He instructed the assembly: Washing bowls and filling the vase are all Dharma-gate Buddha-work. Carrying firewood and hauling water

text_zh: 示眾云。洗鉢添瓶。盡是法門佛事。般柴運水。 無非妙用神通。為甚麼不解放光動地。
text_en: are nothing but marvelous function and spiritual power. Why then can you not emit light and shake the earth?
He cited: A monk asked National Teacher Zhong of Nanyang, What is the original-body Vairocana?

text_zh: 舉。僧問南陽忠國師。如何是本身盧舍那 汝豈是替名國師云。與我過淨瓶來莫忘了話頭僧將淨 瓶到莫得錯認國師云。却安舊處著重宣此義僧復問。 如何是本身盧舍那甚處去來國師云。古佛過去 久矣離此不遠。
text_en: The National Teacher said, Bring me the pure vase. The monk brought the pure Are you merely standing in for the name? Do not forget the word-head. vase to him. The National Teacher said, Put it back in its old place. The monk again asked, Do not mistake it. Proclaim this meaning again. What is the original-body Vairocana? The National Teacher said, The ancient Buddha passed away From where do you come and go? long ago. Not far from here.
The master cited: Shishuang asked Daowu, What is Bodhi before the eyes? Wu called to a novice.

text_zh: 師舉。石霜問道吾。如何是觸目菩提。吾喚沙 彌。彌應喏。吾云。添淨瓶水著。良久却問石 霜。汝適來問甚麼。霜擬舉。吾便歸方丈。霜 乃有省。道吾先用隔身句。後用拋身勢。若不 傷鋒犯手。石霜有省。國師慈悲之故。有落草 之談。只是知恩者少。天童所以採汲華水也。 頌云。
text_en: The novice answered, Yes. Wu said, Add water to the pure vase. After a while he asked Shishuang, What was your question just now? As Shishuang was about to repeat it, Wu returned to his room. Shishuang then had an awakening. Daowu first used a phrase that separated the body, then a gesture that cast off the body. If he had not wounded the point and risked his hands, Shishuang would not have awakened. Because of the National Teacher's compassion, there was talk of entering the weeds, but few know gratitude. This is why Tiantong drew and gathered the flower-water. The verse says:
Birds move through the sky, fish dwell in the water; in rivers and lakes they forget one another. Bumping and striking into it. Using left, using right. This side, that side.

text_zh: 鳥之行空築著磕著　魚之在水左使右使　江湖相忘這邊那邊 雲天得志無可不可　擬心一絲只在此山中　對面千里雲深 不知處知恩報恩念茲在茲　人間幾幾一子親得
text_en: In cloud and sky they fulfill their will; if the mind intends by a single thread, face to face becomes a thousand miles. Neither permissible nor impermissible. It is only in this mountain. The clouds are deep, so the place is unknown. To know grace and repay grace, how many in the human world are there? Mindful of it here, present in it here. One son personally attains it.
The master said: The more secure the place birds trust in the sky and fish trust in the water, the more fitting their life.

text_zh: 師云。鳥之行空。魚之在水。所託愈安。其生愈 適。莊子泉涸魚相與處于陸。相呴以濕。相濡 以沫。不如相忘于江湖。白兆通慧珪禪師道。 譬如空中飛鳥。不知空是家鄉。水底游魚忘 却水。為性命。圭峯云。魚不識水。人不識風。 迷不識性。悟不識空。尋常本身盧舍那。滿淨 覺者。現相人中。纔起問時。忽然影現。忘恩失 行。背親向疎。果能除却靈床。始解子承父業。 且道。如何是父業。拈來無不是。用處莫生疑。
text_en: Zhuangzi says: When the spring dries up, fish stay together on land, breathing moisture on one another and wetting one another with froth; better to forget one another in rivers and lakes. Chan Master Gui of Baizhao Tonghui said, It is like birds flying in the sky, not knowing the sky is their homeland; fish swimming in the water forget that water is their life. Guifeng said, Fish do not know water; people do not know wind. In delusion one does not know nature; in awakening one does not know emptiness. The ordinary original-body Vairocana, completely pure and awakened, appears among people. As soon as a question is raised, its shadow suddenly appears. Forgetting grace, one loses conduct, turning from kin toward strangers. If one can truly remove the spirit-bed, then one begins to understand the son inheriting the father's trade. Tell me, what is the father's trade? Pick it up and none of it is not it; in use, do not give rise to doubt.

text_zh: 43 羅山起滅
text_en: 43. Luoshan on Arising and Ceasing He instructed the assembly: One pellet of the elixir turns iron into gold. One word of ultimate principle turns the ordinary

text_zh: 示眾云。還丹一粒。點鐵成金。至理一言。轉凡 成聖。若知金鐵無二。凡聖本同。果然一點。也 用不著。且道。是那一點。
text_en: into the sage. If you know gold and iron are not two, and ordinary and sage are originally the same, then truly even one point is of no use. Tell me, what is that one point?
He cited: Luoshan asked Yantou, What about when arising and ceasing do not stop? Scraping gold and rubbing the back of a clay man.

text_zh: 舉。羅山問巖頭。起滅不停時如何金刪與泥人揩背 頭咄云星落雲散是誰起滅識得不為冤。
text_en: Yantou barked, Who is it that arises and ceases? Stars fall, clouds scatter. If you recognize it, there is no injustice.
Chan Master Daoxian of Luoshan in Shenzhou first asked Shishuang, When arising and ceasing do not stop,

text_zh: 神州羅山道閑禪師。先問石霜。起滅不停時 如何。霜云。直須寒灰枯木去。一念萬年去。 函蓋相應去。純清絕點去。師不契。往問巖頭。 頭喝云。是誰起滅。山於此有省。蓋巖頭只貴 見地明白。石霜置枯木堂。要伊親到一迴始 得。不見。瑞巖問巖頭。如何是本常理。頭云。 動也。巖云。動時如何。頭云。不見本常理。巖 佇思。頭云。肯即未脫根塵。不肯即永沈生死。 巖亦領悟。巖頭英靈倜儻。打發學人。剋的精 敏不減德山。後來出羅山法寶。氷寒於水。溈 山所謂。只貴子見處。不問子行履也。羅山問 處。天下人榜樣。而今初機。往往在這裏。作活 計。水上捺瓜相似。伏斷煩惱。智覺道。莫與心 為伴。無心心自安。若將心作伴。動即被心謾。 伴即伴妄心。無亦無妄心。祖師西來。直指人 心。見性成佛。豈是教爾普州人送賊。認奴作 郎來。羅山問處。迷真執妄。巖頭咄處。即妄即 真。若是萬松。咄了便休。真妄向上有事在。楞 嚴經。阿難言。如來見今徵心所在。而我以心 推窮尋逐。即能推者。我將為心。佛言。咄。阿 難此非汝心。阿難矍然避座合掌起立白佛。 此非我心。當名何等。佛告阿難。此是前塵。虛 妄相想。惑汝真性。由汝無始至于今生。認賊 為子。失汝元常。故受輪轉。此喝如金剛王寶 劍也。巖頭一喝。如踞地師子。全威大用不欺 之力。龐居士云。一群六箇賊。生生欺殺人。我 今識汝也。不與汝為隣。汝若不伏我。我即到 處。說教人盡識汝。使汝行路絕。爾若肯伏我。 我即不分別。共汝一處住。同證無生滅。巖頭 道。是誰起滅。雲巖提掃󰆠。這箇是第幾月同 參。天童貴伊善能點化。重說偈言。頌云。
text_en: what then? Shishuang said, You must become cold ashes and dead wood; let one thought be ten thousand years. Let box and lid match; let there be pure clarity without a speck. The master did not agree, and went to ask Yantou. Yantou shouted, Who is it that arises and ceases? At this Luoshan awakened. Yantou valued only clarity of insight. Shishuang set up the Hall of Dead Wood, wanting him personally to arrive there once before it would do. Do you not see? Ruiyan asked Yantou, What is the fundamental constant principle? Yantou said, It moves. Ruiyan said, When it moves, what then? Yantou said, Then you do not see the fundamental constant principle. Ruiyan stood thinking. Yantou said, If you assent, you have not yet escaped sense-roots and dusts; if you do not assent, you sink forever in birth and death. Ruiyan too understood. Yantou was bold and heroic in spirit; in dealing with students he was exact and keen, no less than Deshan. Later, Luoshan produced a Dharma jewel, ice colder than water. Guishan is the one who said, I value only your place of seeing, not your conduct. Luoshan's point of questioning is a model for people under heaven. But beginners nowadays often here make a living plan, like pressing a gourd under water. They suppress and cut off afflictions. Zhijue said, Do not take the mind as companion. In no-mind, mind settles itself. If you take mind as companion, whenever it moves you are deceived by mind. To companion is to companion the deluded mind; no-mind too has no deluded mind. The Patriarch came from the West to point directly to the human mind, see nature, and become Buddha. Was it to teach you, like the people of Puzhou, to escort the thief and take the servant for the master? In Luoshan's question there is delusion of the true and grasping at the false; in Yantou's bark, the false is itself the true. If it were Wansong, after the bark I would stop. Above true and false there is still business. In the Shurangama Sutra, Ananda said, The Tathagata is now probing where the mind is, and I use mind to infer, exhaust, seek, and pursue. That which can infer, I take to be mind. The Buddha said, Bah! An- anda, this is not your mind. Ananda was startled, left his seat, joined his palms, stood, and said to the Buddha, If this is not my mind, what should it be called? The Buddha told Ananda, This is external dust, a false and illusory conception-image, confounding your true nature. From beginningless time to this life, you have taken the thief for your son, lost your original constant nature, and so undergo transmigration. This shout is like the vajra king's precious sword. Yantou's single shout is like a lion crouching on the ground, complete in majesty and great function, not relying on borrowed power. Layman Pang said, A gang of six thieves, life after life they cheat and kill people. I now know you; I will not be your neighbor. If you do not submit to me, then wherever I go I will tell people to know you all, and cut off your roads. If you are willing to submit to me, I will then not discriminate; I will dwell with you in one place and together realize no birth and no death. Yantou said, Who is it that arises and ceases? Yunyan raised his whisk: Which month is this, sharing practice together? Tiantong valued his skill in apt transformation, and again spoke a verse, saying:
Chop through the old vine-tangles, smash the fox den and cave; the leopard wears the mist and It turns and grows branches and vines. Then it spits out more stubborn drool.

text_zh: 師云。截斷話頭。剗却問意。照用同時。人境俱 奪。巖頭有超師之作。楊子云。聖人虎別。其文 炳也。君子豹別。其文蔚也。辯人狸別。其文萃 也。狸變即豹。豹變即虎。南山玄豹。隱霧而變 文。漢劉向列女傳曰。陶答子治陶三年。名譽 不興。家富三倍。其妻抱兒而泣。姑怒以為不 祥。妻曰。妾聞。南山有玄豹。隱霧而七日不 食。欲以澤其衣毛。成其文章。至於犬豕。不擇 食。故肥。以肥取禍。朞年果被誅。任昉述異 記。漢惠帝七年夏。雷震南山。林木火然。地燋 黃。暴雨後得龍骨一具。羅山遭破家冤賊。陳 詞過狀。巖頭招安。已後變作得力兒郎。且道。 那箇是招安處。咄。起滅紛紛更是誰。
text_en: were taken away. Yantou produced work surpassing his teacher. Yangzi said, The sage changes like a tiger; its markings blaze forth. The gentleman changes like a leopard; its markings flourish. The clever man changes like a civet; its markings gather. When the civet changes, it becomes leopard; when the leopard changes, it becomes tiger. The dark leopard of South Mountain hides in mist and changes its markings. Liu Xiang's Biographies of Exemplary Women of Han says: Tao Dazi governed Tao for three years, yet his reputation did not rise, while his household wealth tripled. His wife held their child and wept. Her mother-in-law angrily took it as inauspicious. The wife said, I have heard that on South Mountain there is a dark leopard that hides in mist and for seven days does not eat, wishing thereby to moisten its fur and perfect its markings. As for dogs and pigs, they do not choose what they eat, and so grow fat; through that fatness they meet disaster. Within a year he was indeed executed. Ren Fang's Records of Strange Things says: In the summer of Emperor Hui of Han's seventh year, thunder struck South Mountain; the forest burned with fire, and the ground was scorched yellow. After a violent rain, a dragon skeleton was found. Luoshan encountered a household-ruining enemy-thief, presented his case and statement; Yantou accepted his surrender. Thereafter he became a capable lad. Tell me, what is the place where surrender was accepted? Bah! In all the confusion of arising and ceasing, who is it after all?

text_en: 44. Xingyang's Wondrous Wings He instructed the assembly: A lion strikes elephants; the wondrous-winged bird seizes dragons. Even among fliers and runners there is distinction of ruler and minister.

text_en: A patch-robed monk must preserve host and guest. As for one who offends heavenly majesty, how do you judge and decide?

text_zh: 師云。郢州興陽山清剖禪師。嗣大陽明安。凡 一十五人。皆先下世。後因浮山圓鑒。得投子 青和尚。陽乃十五之一。青公之兄也。這僧問 處。如牢度差與舍利弗。創給孤獨園。時鬪勝。 差現獰龍。欲傷弗。弗現妙翅鳥擭裂食之。龍 亦鱗蟲之長。奈何妙翅唯龍為食。娑竭梵語 此云海也。平原君。趙勝相趙惠文王及孝成 王家起重樓。臨民家。民有躄者。美人笑之。躄 者請美人之首。君諾而不行。賓客去半。君斬 囚人代之。賓固不至。遂臬美人首。懸御樓前 驗其真也。周歲賓集。此洞上家風不貴棒喝 親行。要假傍來通信。這僧罪不重科。方能迴 互。還知麼。蒲鞭示恥尤難犯。畫地為牢不忍 欺。官法如爐心似鐵。天童從此費鉆鎚。頌云。
text_en: fifteen heirs, and all passed away before him. Later, because of Fushan Yuanjian, he obtained Touzi Qing master; Xingyang was one of the fifteen, and Qing was his elder Dharma-brother. This monk's question is like when the dragon king's minister challenged Shariputra at the founding of Jetavana, contending for victory. The minister manifested a fierce dragon to harm Shariputra. Shariputra manifested a wondrous-winged bird, seized it, tore it, and ate it. The dragon too is chief among scaled creatures, but the wondrous-winged bird feeds only on dragons. Sagara is Sanskrit, and here means sea. Lord Pingyuan, Zhao Sheng, served as minister to King Huiwen of Zhao and King Xiaocheng. His household built a high tower overlooking common homes. There was a cripple among the people, and a beauty laughed at him. The cripple asked for the beauty's head. The lord promised but did not carry it out, and half his retainers left. The lord beheaded a condemned prisoner in her place, but the guests still did not return. So he finally cut off the beauty's head and hung it before the tower to prove it was real. After a year, the guests gathered again. In this Caodong house style, blows and shouts are not prized for direct use; in person. Yet he had to borrow another to convey the message. This monk’s offense is not treated as grave; only then can he turn and respond. Do you know? A cattail switch shows shame and is all the harder to violate; drawing the ground as a prison, one cannot bear to deceive. The law of the state is like a furnace, the heart like iron. From here Tiantong spends hammer and drill. The verse says:

Silken edicts descend; commands divide the realm. Within the borders, the Son of Heaven; beyond the frontier, Hear the imperial decree. Whoever disobeys is beheaded. The ruler presides over ten thousand realms.

text_zh: 師云。勅遍天下。王不流行。禮記緇衣子曰。王 言如絲。其出如綸。王言如綸。其出如綍。故大 人不倡游言也。娑竭出海。妙翅當權。號令既 分。君臣定位。馮唐曰。上古王者遣將也。跪而 推轂曰。閫以內者寡人制之。閫以外者將軍 制之。韋昭曰。此郭門之閫也。雷驚出蟄。頌此 僧探頭太過。不待驚蟄二月節。早起龍頭。 不知浮雲將隨龍而行。而為妙翅威風。遏絕 不覺頭撞也。有謂不因僧話墮。爭顯興陽機 鋒者。不待那知四字。極不穩順。機底聯綿。此 非機鋒之機。謂錦機之下。必有巧婦針線。雪 巖先師甞舉。穴細金針。纔露鼻。芒長玉線。妙 投關。此乃洞上血脈。非其中人。不易知也。當 印不當風。如印印空不彰文彩。蒼頡仰觀奎 宿圓曲之勢。俯察龜文鳥跡之象。博採眾美 合而為文。後自蝌蚪為二篆。周宣主太史籀 造大篆。秦相李斯造小篆。今之印篆。號曰方 填。旦道。興陽還刻劃也無。皓玉本無瑕。雕丈 喪君德。
text_en: words are like silk; when issued, they are like a cord. A king’s words are like a cord; when issued, they are like a great rope. Therefore a great man does not utter wandering talk. When Sagara emerges from the sea, the Garuda holds authority. Once commands have been divided, ruler and minister each take their place. Feng Tang said: When kings of high antiquity dispatched a general, they knelt and pushed the axle and said, Within the gate-threshold, I govern; beyond the threshold, the general governs. Wei Zhao said: This threshold is the outer city gate. Thunder startles the hibernating forth — the verse praises this monk for sticking out his head too far. He did not wait for the Jingzhe season in the second month, but raised the dragon’s head too early. Not knowing that drifting clouds follow the dragon as it moves, he was cut off by the Garuda’s mighty wind, and without realizing it, crashed headlong. Some say: If not for the monk’s falling into words, how could Xingyang’s sharp function have appeared? But the four words without waiting, who knew are extremely unstable in sequence. Continuity beneath the loom — this is not the ji of clever edge, but the loom of brocade: beneath it there must be a skillful woman’s needle and thread. Xueyan, my late teacher, once cited: The fine-eyed golden needle just shows its tip; the long-fibered jade thread subtly enters the pass. This is the very bloodline of Dongshan; unless one is one of them, it is not easy to know. As for the seal not facing the wind: if one stamps the empty sky, no patterned marks appear. Cangjie looked up and observed the Kui constellation’s rounded and curved forms; looking down he examined turtle markings and bird tracks. Broadly gathering many beauties, he combined them into writing. Later, from tadpole script came the two seal scripts. Under King Xuan of Zhou, Grand Historian Zhou made the large seal script; Qin minister Li Si made the small seal script. The seal script used for seals now is called square- filled. But tell me: did Xingyang still carve and incise, or not? Pure jade originally has no flaw; carve it by the foot and you lose the sovereign virtue.

text_en: 45. Four Sections from the Perfect Enlightenment Sutra Addressing the assembly, he said: A ready-made kōan rests only on what is present now. The proper family style does not seek

text_zh: 師云。圭峯科此一段。謂之妄心頓證。又名忘 心入覺。萬松下四箇不字。謂不起不滅不知 不辨。此四八三十二字。諸方皆為病。此處為 藥。且諸方病者。不起妄念。豈非焦芽敗種。不 滅妄心。豈非養病喪軀。不假了知。豈非暫時 不在如同死人。不辨真實。豈非顢頇佛性籠 桶真如。且道。如何是四藥。須是天童修合將 來。頌云。
text_en: mind. Wansong adds four nots: not-arising, not-extinguishing, not-knowing, not-discriminating. These four times eight, thirty-two characters, are everywhere else treated as illness; here they are medicine. As for the illnesses elsewhere: not arising deluded thought — is this not scorched sprouts and ruined seeds? Not extinguishing deluded mind — is this not nourishing sickness and losing the body? Not relying on discriminating knowing — is this not, for the time being, not being present, like a dead man? Not distinguishing reality — is this not muddling Buddha-nature into a bucket with thusness? Tell me then: what are the four medicines? It must be Tiantong who compounds and blends them and brings them forth. The verse says:
Lofty, hall-like, rugged and open — in the noisy place he sticks out his head. To probe further, one must speak the searching word. A nose that pokes the sky.
