text_en: heaven's wheel and earth's axle. The balance scale is in hand Hidden net, martial weft and civil warp; releasing and gathering. The full talent of generals and ministers Muzhou is still here Standing alone, moving everywhere; the pivot of mystery fires, like lightning striking the blue sky. Old Master Lao comes to life again Set your hand to it Not equal to it The eyes contain purple light; in broad daylight stars are seen. Shines through the four quarters of the world
The Way circles in emptiness, never filling: this is where neither man nor ox is seen, precisely when the moon is bright.

text_zh: 道環之虛靡盈。此人牛不見處。正是月明時。 慈覺道。誰知末後一著。却是未分以前。道環。 莊子樞始得其環中。以應無窮。天童借頌圓 相托呈勢。空印之字。雖十字改卍字。其實非 世間文字可執。道副對達磨。如某甲所見。不 執文字。不離文字。而為道用。大寧寬禪頭到 法昌。遇公作󱕋此相。寧便出作務。明日上堂。 法座前曰。昨日公案作麼生。寧作󱐝此相了。 復以脚攃却。昌曰。寬禪頭名不虛得。遂陞座 曰。忽地晴天霹靂聲。禹門三尺浪泙渹。幾多 頭角為龍去。鰕蟹依前努眼睛。此頌與天童 機發玄樞。青天激電同參。天輪地軸。武緯文 經。皆左右二匝。十字卍字血脈也。放開揑聚。 獨立周行。頌脩羅掌日。樓至擎拳圍卍字讚 善哉也。春秋題辭云。天之為體。中包乎地。日 月星辰屬焉。然天地有高下之形。四時有升 降之理。日月有運行之度。星辰有次舍之常。 乃至諸星運轉。纏度如輪。故為天輪也。河圖 括地象曰。地下有八柱。柱廣十萬里。有三千 六百軸。互相牽掣。名山大川孔穴相通。家語。 地東西為緯。南北為經。又文能經天。武能緯 地。無文無以懷遠。無武無以禦亂。睦州示眾 云。裂開也在我。揑聚也在我。僧問。如何是裂 開。州云。三九二十七。菩提涅槃。真如解脫。即 心即佛。我且恁麼道。汝又作麼生。僧云。某甲 不恁麼道。州云。盞子落地楪子成七片。僧云。 如何是揑聚。州斂手而坐。老子云。寂兮寥兮。 獨立而不改。周行而不殆。樞機之發。如電光． 石火。眼有神光。名為巖電。白日見星。此如暗 中樹影水底魚蹤。非肉眼能見。覺範寄靈源 云。暗中樹影平生意。水際魚蹤病後機。想見 瘦容無住著。倚藤閑看暮雲歸。還知仰山行 履處麼。皁上烏雞深夜繡。暗中一線實難通。
text_en: Cijue said, Who knew the very last move is actually before any division? Way-circle: Zhuangzi says, when the hinge first obtains its ring-center, it responds without end. Tiantong borrows this to praise the circle sign held up in presentation. The sky-seal's character: though the cross was changed into the swastika sign, in truth it is not a worldly character to be grasped. Daofu replied to Bodhidharma, As I see it, one does not cling to words, yet does not leave words, but uses them for the Way. Chan leader Kuan of Daning came to Fachang and met the elder making this sign. Kuan then went out to work. The next day, ascending the hall, before the Dharma seat he said, How about yesterday's case? Kuan made this sign and then again wiped it away with his foot. Chang said, Chan leader Kuan did not get his name in vain. Then he ascended the seat and said, Suddenly in a clear sky a thunderclap roars. At Yu Gate the three-foot waves crash. How many horned heads turn into dragons and go; shrimps and crabs still strain their eyes as before. This verse and Tiantong's pivot of mystery firing, blue-sky lightning, are of one company. Heaven's wheel and earth's axle, martial weft and civil warp, all are the two circles right and left, the bloodline of cross and swastika sign. Releasing and gathering: standing alone and moving everywhere praises the asura holding the sun, and Ruci raising fists encircling the swastika sign, praising Well done indeed. The Chunqiu title gloss says: Heaven in its substance envelops earth within; sun, moon, stars, and constellations belong to it. Yet heaven and earth have forms of high and low; the four seasons have rising and falling principles; sun and moon have measured courses; stars have fixed stations. Even all the stars revolve, their circuits like a wheel; therefore it is called heaven's wheel. The Hetu Guadi Xiang says: Beneath the earth are eight pillars, each one hundred thousand li wide. There are three thousand six hundred axles, pulling and restraining one another; famous mountains and great rivers, caves and openings, all connect. The Family Sayings says: East-west on earth is weft; north-south is warp. Also, civil order can warp heaven, martial power can weft earth. Without civil order there is no way to bring the distant near; without martial power there is no way to resist disorder. Muzhou instructed the assembly: Splitting open is in me; gathering up is also in me. A monk asked, What is splitting open? Zhou said, Three nines are twenty-seven: bodhi, nirvana, true suchness, liberation, the very mind is Buddha. I speak thus for now; how do you speak? The monk said, I would not speak thus. Zhou said, The cup falls to the ground and the dish breaks into seven pieces. The monk said, What is gathering up? Zhou drew in his hands and sat. Laozi says: Silent and still, standing alone and not changing; moving everywhere and not failing. The pivot's activation is like lightning or flint-fire. When the eye has spiritual light, it is called cliff-lightning. Seeing stars in daylight is like a tree's shadow in darkness or fish traces at the bottom of water, not something the flesh-eye can see. Jiaofan wrote to Lingyuan: Tree shadows in darkness are the intent of a lifetime; fish tracks at the water's edge are the function after illness. I imagine your gaunt form without attachments, leaning on a vine and idly watching evening clouds return. Do you yet know where Yangshan walked and stood? A black hen embroidered on black satin in the deep night; a single thread in the dark is truly hard to pass through.

text_zh: 78 雲門餬餅
text_en: 78. Yunmen's Flour Cake Instruction to the assembly: Bargaining with heaven for a price, grappling with earth in repayment, scheming a hundred ways and pursuing them all ends in one whole

text_zh: 示眾云。絻天索價。搏地相酬。百計經求。一場 懡㦬。還有知進退識休咎底麼。
text_en: muddle. Is there anyone who knows advance and retreat, and understands fortune and misfortune?
Raised: A monk asked Yunmen, What is speech that transcends Buddha and goes beyond the patriarchs? Yunmen said, Flour cake. This question is too lofty

text_en: Arise In one lift, forty-nine
The master said: Yunmen once ascended the hall and said, As soon as one word is raised, a thousand differences share one track. It includes and gathers

text_zh: 師云。雲門上堂云。一言纔舉。千差同轍。該括 微塵。猶是化門之說。若是衲僧合作麼生。若 將祖意佛意。這裏商量。曹溪一路平沈。還有 人道得麼。道得出來。僧問。如何是超佛越祖 之談。門云。餬餅。僧云。這箇有甚麼交涉。師 云。灼然有甚麼交涉。乃云。爾勿可作了。見人 道著祖師意。便問超佛越祖之談道理。爾且 喚甚麼作佛。喚甚麼作祖。則說超佛越祖之 談。便問箇出三界。爾把將三界來。有甚麼見 聞覺知礙著爾。有甚麼聲色法。與汝可了。了 箇甚麼椀。又有僧問。如何是超佛越祖之談。 門云。蒲州麻黃。益州附子。又曰。來來。我更 問爾諸人。橫擔拄杖道。我參禪學道。便覓箇 超佛越祖底道理。我且問爾。十二時中行住 坐臥。屙屎送尿。至於茆沆裏蟲子。市肆裏買 賣羊肉案頭。還有超佛越祖底道理麼。佛果 云。有者作一圓相。土上加泥。添枷帶鎖。萬松 道。若要敲枷打鎖鉆鎚。問取天童頌古。頌 云。
text_en: even dust motes, yet this is still talk of the gate of transformation. But what should a patchrobed monk do? If you bring patriarchal intent and Buddha intent to discuss here, the whole road to Caoxi sinks flat. Is there anyone who can say it? Speak, if you can. A monk asked, What is speech that transcends Buddha and goes beyond the patriarchs? Yunmen said, Flour cake. The monk said, What has this got to do with it? The master said, Obviously, what does it have to do with it? Then he said, Do not make this into something. When you hear people mention the patriarchs' meaning, you immediately ask about the principle of speech transcending Buddha and surpassing patriarchs. First just tell me, what do you call Buddha? What do you call patriarch? Then you talk of transcending Buddha and surpassing patriarchs. Then you ask about leaving the triple world. Bring me the triple world here. What seeing, hearing, awareness, or knowing is obstructing you? What sounds, forms, or dharmas are there for you to settle? Settle what bowl, exactly? Another monk asked, What is speech that transcends Buddha and goes beyond the patriarchs? Yunmen said, Ephedra from Puzhou, aconite from Yizhou. He also said, Come, come, let me further ask you all: you shoulder your staffs crosswise and say, I study Chan and learn the Way, then seek some principle of transcending Buddha and surpassing patriarchs. I ask you: throughout the twelve hours, walking, standing, sitting, lying down, shitting and pissing, even worms in the privy pit, buying and selling over the butcher's mutton block in the market, is there any principle there of transcending Buddha and surpassing patriarchs? Foguo said: Some make a circle sign here, adding mud on top of dirt, adding cangues and wearing shackles. Wansong said: If you want the hammer and chisel that break cangues and smash shackles, ask Tiantong's verse on the ancient case. The verse says:
Flour cake, he says, is speech beyond Buddhas and patriarchs; tasteless in the phrase, how will you investigate? The whole canon with all its commentaries cannot reach it

text_zh: 餬餅云超佛祖談一大藏教詮注不及　句中無味若為參 甚處下口衲僧一日如知飽始知餬餅醍醐毒藥　方見雲門面 不慚雲門無眼見人
text_en: Where can one open the mouth If one day a patchrobed monk knows what fullness is, only then will he see Yunmen's face Only then do you know flour cakes, ghee, and poison are one without shame. Yunmen has no eyes to see people
The master said: Chan Master Chu of Dongshan, pointing out the penetrating function, composed a verse saying: Dongshan is desolate and solitary, a

text_zh: 師云。洞山初禪師指通機頌云。洞山寥索一 無可有。無味之談塞斷人口。直饒巧饌千般。 爭奈飽人不愛。若是餓鬼相嚵噇底。橫咬竪 咬狗齧枯骨相似。直待嚼破舌頭。擲在一邊。 却與雲門相見。相見後如何。各各面皮厚三 寸。
text_en: There is nothing to grasp; tasteless talk chokes off people's mouths. Even if there are a thousand clever dishes, what can be done when the full do not care for them? But if they are hungry ghosts greedily gobbling, biting crosswise and lengthwise, it is like dogs gnawing dry bones. Only after they chew their tongues raw do they throw them aside. Then they may meet Yunmen. After meeting, what then? Each and every one has a face three inches thick.

text_zh: 79 長沙進步
text_en: 79. Changsha Advances a Step Addressing the assembly, he said: On the Golden Sand bank, Lady Ma-lang is a spirit of another sort. In a crystal bottle

text_zh: 示眾云。金沙灘頭馬郎婦。別是精神。瑠璃瓶 裏擣𩝐餻。誰敢轉動。不入驚人浪。難逢稱意 魚。寬行大步。一句作麼生。
text_en: pounding cakes inside, who dares stir it? If you do not enter startling waves, it is hard to meet a fish to your liking. Stride with broad steps; in one phrase, how is it?
Raised: Changsha had a monk ask Master Hui, How was it before seeing Nanquan?

text_zh: 舉。長沙令僧問會和尚。未見南泉時如何 早晨有粥會良久問著便屎臭氣僧云。見後如何更與挑剔會云。 不可別有也只向屎堆裏躂倒僧迴舉似沙走口送舌漢沙 云。百尺竿頭坐底人竿下底一場懡㦬雖然得入未 為真孤危不立道方高百尺竿頭須進步甚底大如箇割捨十方 世界是全身始信蒲團不是天僧云。百尺竿頭如何 進步果有這箇在沙云。朗州山澧州水築著磕著僧云。不 會可㬠聰明沙云。四海五湖王化裏一任𨁝跳。
text_en: Hui was silent for a long while. The monk said, How was it after seeing him? Hui said, In the morning there is porridge Ask about it and at once it stinks like shit And he even picks at it further It cannot be otherwise. The monk returned and reported this to Changsha. Changsha He just stumbles into the shit heap A fellow loose with mouth and tongue said, One sitting atop a hundred-foot pole, though he has gained entry, he has not yet Under the pole, one whole bout of vexation made it real. At the top of the hundred-foot pole, he must advance one more step; the ten directions When solitary peril is not set up, the Way is truly high What could be so great as this letting go world is the whole body. The monk said, How does one advance Only then believe the meditation cushion is not heaven at the top of the hundred-foot pole? Changsha said, The mountains of Langzhou, the waters of Lizhou. The monk said, I do not There truly is this here Bump into it and strike against it understand. Changsha said, Within the king's transforming rule are the four seas and five lakes. Clever indeed Jump as you please
Wansong said: Great Master Zhaoxian of Changsha in Hunan, personal name Jingcen. Juefan said: Among Chan masters,

text_zh: 師云。湖南長沙招賢大師。諱景岑。覺範云。禪 師大寂之孫。南泉之子。趙州之兄。當時衲子。 倔強如仰山者。猶下之。而呼以為岑大蟲。上 堂云。我若一向舉揚宗教。法堂裏草深一丈。 事不獲已。向汝諸人道。盡十方世界。是沙門 眼。盡十方世界。是沙門全身。盡十方世界。是 自己光明。盡十方世界。在自己光明中。盡十 方世界。無一人不是自己。我常向諸人道。三 世諸佛。共法界眾生。是摩訶般若光。光未發 時。汝等眾生。向甚麼處委。光未發時尚無佛 無眾生消息。何處得山河國土來。沙令僧問 會庵主。主乃南泉下不出世。潛符密證之徒。 燈錄列在末後無機緣語句中。然此話既在。 合作一傳。也不為分外。僧作專使。去見庵主。 傳長沙法旨云。庵主未見南泉時如何。會默 然。僧進云。見南泉後如何。會云。更不可別有 也。萬松道。一死不再活。僧迴舉似沙。沙述偈 云。百尺竿頭坐底人。雖然得入未為真。此與 巖頭道雪峯德山不會末後句。病痛一般。萬 松常向人道。大似箇人把祖父家門。產業并 眷屬自身。一契賣却。置得箇水晶瓶子。終日 隨形守護。如眼睛相似。莫教萬松見。定與揑 破。教伊撒手掉臂。作箇無忌諱快活漢。勝默 道。撒手懸崖下。分身萬象中。然後朗州山澧 州水。四海五湖王化裏。方可配天童水牯牛 拕犁拽䥯。頌云。
text_en: he was Mazu's grandson, Nanquan's son, and Zhaozhou's elder brother. At that time among patchrobed monks, even one as formidable as Yangshan ranked beneath him and called him Great Tiger Cen. Ascending the hall, he said: If I only keep expounding the school and teaching, grass will grow a yard deep in the Dharma hall. But with no choice, I tell you all: The entire world of the ten directions is the monk's eye. The entire world of the ten directions is the monk's whole body. The entire world of the ten directions is one's own radiance. The entire world of the ten directions is within one's own radiance. The entire world of the ten directions has not a single person who is not oneself. I often tell you all: The buddhas of the three times, together with beings of the dharma realm, are the light of great prajna. Before that light shines forth, where do you beings rely? Before the light shines forth, there is not yet even news of buddhas or beings. From where then come mountains, rivers, and lands? Changsha had a monk ask the hermit-master Hui. This hermit was one under Nanquan who did not appear in the world, one of hidden accord and secret realization. In the Lamp Record he is listed at the end among those with no recorded encounters or sayings. Yet since this story exists, making a biography for him would not be excessive. The monk acted as a special envoy and went to see the hermit-master, conveying Changsha's meaning: Hermit-master, how was it before seeing Nanquan? Hui remained silent. The monk pressed on: How was it after seeing Nanquan? Hui said, It cannot be any different at all. Wansong said: One death, no second life. The monk returned and reported to Changsha, and Changsha spoke a verse, saying: One sitting atop a hundred-foot pole, though he has entered, it is not yet real. This and Yantou saying Xuefeng and Deshan did not understand the final phrase are the same ailment. Wan- song often says to people: It is like someone taking the ancestral family gates, the estate, and even his kin and his own body, selling them all in one contract, and buying a crystal bottle, which all day long he guards wherever he goes, like his own eyes. If Wansong sees it, he will surely smash it for him, making him let go and swing his arms, becoming a carefree fellow with no taboos. Better than silently saying: Let go beneath the cliff, divide the body amid the myriad forms. Only then are the mountains of Langzhou and the waters of Lizhou and the four seas and five lakes within the king's transforming rule fit to match Tiantong's water buffalo dragging the plow. The verse says:
The jade man wakes from a dream at a single rooster's cry; with a turn of the eye, all modes of life are equally complete. Open the eyes and do not notice dawn Endless

When water arrives, the channel is formed In season, put strength into plowing and tilling; who fears the spring fields burying the shins The one who avoids it does not do it in mud? The one who does it does not avoid it
Wansong said: Tiantong attained the samadhi of transcending forms and briefly passed over the hermit-master's tight clutch on the pole,

text_zh: 師云。天童得超方三昧。略去庵主緊抱竿頭。 不敢轉動處。撥動若一向恁麼去。法堂上草 深一丈。優波毱多。有著身見者。求度於祖。祖 曰。求度之法。要信吾言。不違吾教。人曰。既 來投師。固當聞命。祖乃化一險崖。山聳喬木。 令其上樹。又於樹下。化作大坑深廣千肘。祖 令放脚。其人受教即放二脚。令放一手。便放 一手。令復放手。其人答言。若復放手便墮坑 死。祖曰。先約受教。云何違我。是時其人身愛 即滅。放手而墮。不見樹坑。即證道果。長沙 朗州山澧州水。謂之善用險崖之句。若非玉 人夢破別有生涯。爭得四海五湖斬新日月。 毛詩習習谷風。催之驚蟄。春分後一候。雷乃 發聲。漢書。李廣傳贊。桃李無言下自成蹊。宗 鏡云。既蘊德行。不言而信。若桃李之自成蹊 也。又朗州山澧州水。此語乃拕泥帶水邊事。 三聖在會下。令秀上座問沙。南泉遷化向甚 麼處去。沙云。石頭作沙彌時參見六祖。秀云。 不問石頭作沙彌時參見六祖。南泉遷化向 甚麼處去也。沙云。教汝尋思去。秀云和尚只 有千尺寒松。且無抽條石笋。沙不對。秀云。謝 師答話。沙亦不對。秀舉似三聖。聖曰。若實恁 麼猶勝臨濟七步。聖親上方丈云。和尚早來 答話。可謂光前絕後。沙不答。聖云。我從來 疑著這漢。佛印頌云。客見長沙陌路同。令人 依約探家風。須彌萬仞磨今古。折草量天枉 用功。古人把定處放得行竿頭進步。放行時 把得定壁立千仞。為甚麼如此自由自在。湖 南城裏好養民。米賤柴多足四隣。
text_en: the place where he dared not move. If you stir it and just keep going like that, grass in the Dharma hall grows a yard deep. Upagupta once had a man attached to body-view seek deliverance from the patriarch. The patriarch said: In seeking liberation, you must trust my words and not go against my instruction. The man said: Since I have come to rely on a teacher, of course I should obey. The patriarch then conjured a perilous cliff, with a tall tree rising on it, and had him climb the tree. Then beneath the tree he conjured a great pit, a thousand cubits deep and wide. The patriarch told him to let go his feet. The man obeyed and let go both feet. Told to let go one hand, he immediately let go one hand. Told to let go the other hand too, the man replied: If I let go again, I will fall into the pit and die. The patriarch said: You agreed first to obey; how can you now defy me? At that moment the man's attachment to the body vanished at once. He let go and fell, but saw no tree and no pit, and immediately realized the fruit of the Way. Changsha's Mountains of Langzhou, waters of Lizhou is called skillful use of the perilous-cliff phrase. If not for the jade man waking from the dream and having another mode of life, how could there be brand-new sun and moon across the four seas and five lakes? In the Mao Poems, the soft valley wind stirs the awakening from hibernation. In the first pentad after the spring equinox, thunder then sounds. In the Han History, in the appraisal of Li Guang: Peach and plum do not speak, yet beneath them a path forms itself. The Zong- jing says: Once virtue and conduct are stored within, trust arises without words, like peach and plum naturally making a path. Again, Mountains of Langzhou, waters of Lizhou: this saying is a matter of dragging mud and trailing water. When Sansheng was with him, he had Senior Monk Xiu ask Changsha: When Nanquan passed away, to what place did he go? Changsha said: Shitou, when a novice, went to see the Sixth Patriarch. Xiu said: I am not asking about Shitou as a novice seeing the Sixth Patriarch. When Nanquan passed away, where did he go? Changsha said: I am telling you to go ponder it. Xiu said: Master, you only have a thousand-foot cold pine, but no stone shoot putting out branches. Changsha did not reply. Xiu said, Thanks for the master's answer. Changsha still did not reply. Xiu reported this to Sansheng. Sansheng said: If it was really like that, it still surpasses Linji's seven steps. Sansheng personally went to the abbot's room and said: Master, your earlier answer may be called illuminating the past and cutting off the future. Changsha did not reply. Sansheng said: I have long suspected this fellow. Foyin's verse says: A traveler meets Changsha and they share the same road; it makes one dimly probe the family style. Sumeru, ten thousand fathoms, grinds past and present; breaking grass to measure the sky is vain effort. Where the ancients held fast, they could let go and move, advancing on the pole's tip; when letting go and moving, they could still hold fast, sheer as a wall a thousand fathoms high. Why are they so free and at ease? In Hu- nan city it is easy to nourish the people; rice is cheap and firewood plenty for all the neighbors.

text_zh: 80 龍牙過板
text_en: 80. Longya Brings the Board Addressing the assembly, he said: Great sound is rarefied; great vessels are completed late. Amid full bustle and a hundred clamors,

text_zh: 示眾云。大音希聲大器晚成。向盛忙百鬧裏。 佯呆待七古千年後。慢㤆。且道。是如何底 人。
text_en: feign dullness and wait seven times seven years, a thousand years after. Slow down. Tell me, what kind of person is this?
Raised: Longya asked Cuiwei, What is the Patriarch's meaning in coming from the West? Cuiwei said, Bring me the meditation board. Longya took the board and handed it to Each time it is brought up

text_zh: 舉。龍牙問翠微。如何是祖師西來意一迴拈出 一迴新微云。與我過禪板來著本圖利牙取禪板與 翠微兀兀𥊼𥊼微接得便打情知是牙云。打即任打。 要且無祖師西來意半肯半不肯又問臨濟。如何 是祖師西來意頑皮癩肉濟云。與我將蒲團來好本 多同牙取蒲團與臨濟將錯就錯濟接得便打順手骨挅牙 云。打即任打。要且無祖師意得恁軟頑牙後住 院。僧問。和尚當年問翠微臨濟祖意。二尊 宿明也未貧兒思舊債牙云。明即明矣。要且無 祖師意焦塼打著連底凍。
text_en: Each time it is new Acting from capital to seek profit Cuiwei. Cuiwei received it and immediately struck him. Longya said, Strike if you like, Dull and fixed Clearly knowing it is so but there still is no Patriarch's meaning in coming from the West. He also asked Linji, How Half approving, half not approving is the Patriarch's meaning in coming from the West? Linji said, Bring me the sitting cushion. Longya took the cushion and handed it to Linji; Linji received it and struck him, Tough skin and mangy flesh A good edition Mostly the same Make the mistake and follow through with it With a smooth hand, disjoint the bones and Longya said, Strike if you like, but there still is no Patriarch's meaning. Later, when Longya took up residence, So soft and stubborn a monk asked, When you formerly asked Cuiwei and Linji about the Patriarch's meaning, did those two venerable ones understand or not? Longya said, They understood indeed, but there still is no A poor boy broods over old debts Patriarch's meaning. A burnt brick strikes and even the bottom freezes
Wansong said: Chan Master Juidun of Longya Mountain in Hunan first studied with Cuiwei and Linji,

text_zh: 師云。湖南龍牙山居遯禪師。初參翠微臨濟。 後參德山洞山。一日問洞山。如何是祖師西 來意。山云。待洞水逆流則向爾道。師於此悟 入。佛果道。龍牙當時取禪板時。豈不知是打 他。住院後。僧問。和尚見二尊宿。是肯他不肯 他。牙云。肯即肯他。要且無祖師意。佛果道。 山僧即不然。肯即未肯。要且無祖師西來意。 佛日杲禪師頌。子卿不下單于拜。始末恒遵 漢帝儀。雪後始知松柏操。事難方見丈夫兒。 雪竇一向抑之。真如喆云。翠微臨濟可謂本 分宗師。龍牙一等是撥草瞻風。與他後人為 龜為鑑。舉住後僧問處。乃云。龍牙瞻前顧後。 應病與藥。大溈則不然。待問當初二尊宿明 不明。劈脊便棒。非唯扶豎翠微臨濟。亦乃不 辜他來問。萬松道。真如正是濟下鉆鎚。不能 放過。要見龍牙肘後神符。須是當派天童眼 目。頌云。
text_en: and later studied with Deshan and Dongshan. One day he asked Dongshan, What is the Patriarch's meaning in coming from the West? Dongshan said, When the stream of the cave flows backward, then I will tell you. At this the master awakened and entered. Foguo said: When Longya fetched the meditation board back then, how could he not know they would hit him? After he became abbot, a monk asked, Regarding those two venerable ones, did you approve of them or not? Longya said, I approved of them, yes, but still there is no Patriarch's meaning. Foguo said: This mountain monk is not so. If I approve, I still do not approve; but there still is no Patriarch's meaning in coming from the West. Chan Master Fori Gao's verse says: Su Wu did not bow to the Chanyu; from first to last he always followed the Han emperor's rites. Only after snow do you know the pine and cypress character; only in hard things do you see a true man. Xuedou consistently pressed Longya down. Zhenru Zhe said: Cuiwei and Linji may truly be called proper lineage masters. Longya's sort merely parts grass and peers at the wind, serving later people as a tortoise shell for divination. Citing the monk's question after Longya became abbot, he then said: Longya looked ahead and behind, matching illness with medicine. Great Wei would not be so. If asked whether those two venerable ones understood, he would strike straight across the back. Not only would this support Cuiwei and Linji, it also would not fail the one who came asking. Wansong said: Zhenru is exactly Linji's hammer-and-tongs style and cannot let it pass. To see the magic tally hidden behind Longya's elbow, you must use Tiantong's eye from the proper line. The verse says:
Cushion and meditation board faced Longya; why, at the moment, did he not act as a master? For a secure plan, one accepts the butcher's lot Bites people

text_zh: 蒲團禪板對龍牙計穩甘屠眷　何事當機不作家咬人 狗不露齒未意成褫明目下人無遠見　恐將流落在天涯 必有近憂虛空那挂劍不假鋒鉾事　星漢却浮槎別有向上一路 不萌草解藏香象佛眼覷不見　無底籃能著活蛇一般 拈弄與君殊今日江湖何障礙太平無忌諱　通方津渡有 舡車何處不風流
text_en: The dog does not bare its teeth Unintended, it became stripping beneath clear eyes; he feared it might spread abroad and drift to the ends of the earth. If a person has no foresight There must be troubles near at hand How could empty space hang a sword? Yet across the Milky Way a raft still floats. No need for spears and halberds There is another road that goes beyond Unsprouted grass can hide a fragrant elephant; a bottomless basket can hold a living snake. Even the Buddha eye cannot spy it The same But how I handle it for you is different In today's rivers and lakes, what obstruction is there? At the crossing for those who know the way there are In peace there are no taboos boats and carts. What place is not graceful and free
Wansong said: Longya's cushion and meditation board, with Cuiwei and Linji before the assembly telling him to bring them,

text_zh: 師云。龍牙蒲團禪板。翠微臨濟對眾教伊拈 來。為甚用不出。百丈舉野狐話了。黃蘗問。古 人錯答一轉語。墮野狐身五百生。轉轉不錯 合做甚麼。丈云。近前來向汝道。蘗近前先與 丈一掌。丈云。將謂狐須赤。更有赤須狐。此真 當機作家。龍牙非不作家。未意成褫明目下。 不欲當機雷奔電掃。一期峭峻。古詩一千里 色中秋月。十萬軍聲半夜潮。謂之寒乞。無含 蓄。僧問鏡清。學人未達其源。請師方便。清 云。是甚麼源。僧云。其源。清云。若是其源。爭 受方便。侍者問。適來是成褫伊。清云。無。者 又云。是不成褫伊。清云。無。者云。和尚尊意 如何。清云。一點水墨兩處成龍。成褫猶成就 結裹也。恐成流布敗辱門風。洞山囑曹山曰。 吾于雲巖先師處。親印寶鏡三昧。事窮的要。 今付授汝。汝善護持。無令斷絕。向去若遇真 法器。方可傳授。直須祕隱。不得形露。慮屬流 布難接後人。僧問同安察。如何是無干戈。安 云。虛空不挂劍。玉兔不被鱗。聞世傳。天河與 海通。海濱年年八月。有浮槎往來。不失信。博 望侯張騫。乃多齎糧食乘槎而去。怱怱不覺 晝夜。奄至一處。見城郭居室。室中多織女。 唯一丈夫。牽牛臨渚。不飲驚問。何人至此。騫 問。此是何處。曰。君可往蜀問嚴君平。乃如其 言。君平曰。某年月有客星。犯牛斗。因話錄。 漢書載。張騫窮河源。言奉使之遠。實無天河 之說。唯博物志說。有人齎糧乘槎。到天河。見 飲牛丈夫。問君平。客星犯牛斗。即此人也。此 頌龍牙當用時却放過。放過後別作主宰。僧 問曹山。不萌之草。為甚能藏香象。山云。闍梨 幸是作家。又問曹山作麼不萌草。無底籃。是 龍牙不用之大用。故香象非驢騾蹴蹋。活蛇 非死在句下。龍牙示眾云。參方人須透佛祖 始得。新豐和尚道。佛祖言教。如生冤家。始有 參學分。若透不得即被佛祖謾去。僧便問。佛 祖還有謾人之心也無。牙云。爾道江湖還有 礙人之意麼。又云。江湖雖無礙人之意。為時 人透不得。江湖成礙人去。不得道江湖不礙 人。龍牙透過祖意。如生冤家。所以道。明即明 矣。要且無祖師西來意。江湖豈能礙人。俗諺 云。自家不會浮。怨他河曲󱑷。一老宿云。自家 不會浮。怨他坑熱。
text_en: why could he not use them? After Baizhang had told the wild fox story, Huangbo asked: If an ancient made one wrong reply and fell into a fox body for five hundred lives, then if every reply were correct, what should happen? Baizhang said, Come closer and I will tell you. Huangbo stepped forward and first gave Baizhang a slap. Baizhang said, I thought only the fox's beard was red; here is another red-bearded fox. This is truly mastery in the moment. Longya was not lacking in mastery, but he did not intend to strip it bare beneath clear eyes. He did not want, at the critical moment, thunder rushing and lightning sweeping, all at once severe and precipitous. An old poem says: A thousand miles of color in the mid-autumn moon, the sound of a hundred thousand troops in the midnight tide. This is called a cold beggar, with nothing held back. A monk asked Jingqing, This student has not yet reached the source; please, Master, use an expedient. Jingqing said, What source? The monk said, The source. Jingqing said, If it is the source, how could it receive expedients? The attendant asked, Just now, did you strip it for him? Jingqing said, No. The attendant then said, Then did you fail to strip it for him? Jingqing said, No. The attendant said, What then is the venerable master's meaning? Jingqing said, A single dot of watery ink makes dragons in two places. Stripping it is still a kind of completing and wrapping up, and I fear that if it spreads around it will disgrace the family style. Dongshan entrusted Caoshan, saying: At my late teacher Yunyan's place, I personally received the seal of the Precious Mirror Samadhi, whose matter reaches the essential point. I now transmit it to you. Guard and uphold it well; do not let it be cut off. Later, if you meet a true vessel of Dharma, only then may you transmit it. It must be kept hidden and secret, not outwardly displayed, for I fear that if it is spread abroad, later people will be hard to receive. A monk asked Tong'an Cha, What is no weapons of war? Tong'an said, Empty space does not hang a sword; the jade rabbit is not covered in scales. It is said in worldly tradition that the heavenly river and the sea connect. On the seashore, every year in the eighth month, a floating raft comes and goes without fail. The learned Marquis Zhang Qian then brought ample provisions and rode the raft away. Hurried on, he did not notice day or night. Suddenly he arrived at a place and saw city walls and houses. In the houses were many weaving women. There was only one man, leading an ox by the water's edge. Startled, he asked, Who has come here? Zhang Qian asked, What place is this? He said, You may go to Shu and ask Yan Junping. He did as he was told, and Junping said, In such-and-such year and month there was a guest star that trespassed on Ox and Dipper. So the tale was recorded. The Han History records only that Zhang Qian traced the river source, speaking of the distance of his mission; in truth it has no heavenly river account. Only the Bowu zhi says a man carried provisions and rode a raft to the heavenly river, where he saw the man watering an ox, and when he asked Junping, the guest star offending Ox and Dipper was this very man. This praises how Longya, at the moment of use, let it pass, and after letting it pass, made a different mastery. A monk asked Caoshan, Why can unsprouted grass hide a fragrant elephant? Caoshan said, Reverend, lucky you are a master hand. He also asked Caoshan, What is unsprouted grass? A bottomless basket. This is Longya's great function of not using. Thus the fragrant elephant is not trampled by donkeys and mules, and the living snake does not die beneath words. Longya addressed the assembly: Those who travel and study must penetrate buddhas and patriarchs before they can do so. Master Xinfeng said, The words and teachings of buddhas and patriarchs are like living enemies; only then is there a share in study. If you cannot penetrate them, you are deceived by buddhas and patriarchs. A monk then asked, Do buddhas and patriarchs still have a mind to deceive people or not? Longya said, Tell me, in the rivers and lakes is there still an intention to obstruct people? It is also said: Though rivers and lakes have no intention to obstruct people, because people of the time cannot get through, the rivers and lakes become an obstruction to them. You cannot simply say rivers and lakes do not obstruct people. Longya penetrated the ancestral intent as if facing a sworn enemy. Therefore it is said: Clear is clear, indeed; yet in the end there is no meaning of the Patriarch coming from the West. How could rivers and lakes obstruct people? A common saying says: If you yourself cannot float, you blame the bends of the river. An old adept said: If you yourself cannot float, you blame the pit for being hot.

text_en: 81 Xuansha Arrives at the County Addressing the assembly, he said: Move, and shadows appear; awaken, and dust is born. Raised up, it is clear; set down,

text_zh: 示眾云。動即影現。覺即塵生。舉起分明。放下 穩密。本色道人相見。如何說話。
text_en: it is steady and hidden. When genuine people of the Way meet, how do they speak?

text_zh: 舉。玄沙到蒲田縣。百戲迎之。次日問小塘 長老。昨日許多喧鬧。向甚麼處去也又閙也小 塘提起袈裟角果然手忙脚亂沙云。𩕐挑沒交涉謝證據。
text_en: Yesterday there was so much noise and bustle. Where did it all go? Xiaotang Making a racket again lifted up the corner of his robe. Xuansha said: That is completely unrelated. Sure enough, hands and feet in a flurry Thanks for the proof
The teacher said: Chan Master Xuansha Zongyi of Fuzhou, personal name Shibei, wore straw sandals and cloth robes,

text_zh: 師云。福州玄沙宗一大師。諱師備。芒鞋布衲 菲食自怡。雪峯高其苦行。常以備頭陀呼之。 世傳。玄沙不出嶺。保壽不渡河。因蹶傷足指。 歎曰。是身非有。痛自何來。是身是苦。畢竟無 生休休。達磨不來東土。二祖不往西天。遂迴 復因閱楞嚴而發明。故應機捷敏與修多羅 合。至與雪峯徵詰亦當仁不讓。峯曰。備頭陀 再來人也。閩帥王審知。令公王延彬。皆以師 禮之。眾常八九百。沙到蒲田縣。百戲迎之。次 日問小塘長老。昨日許多喧鬧向甚處去也。 小塘提起袈裟角。也不妨緊峭。第一不得向 喧靜昨日今朝處著眼。蹉過當陽一段大事。 小塘不費心力。信手拈起袈裟。沙云。𩕐挑沒 交涉。小塘甚處是沒交涉處。玄沙是許不許。 大溈喆云。大溈即不然。或有問。但鳴指一下。 如有箇衲子出來。云𩕐挑沒交涉。却肯他。何 故大丈夫漢。捋虎鬚也是本分。且道。利害在 甚麼處。又云。小塘懷藏至寶。遇別者以增輝。 玄沙本分鉆鎚一擊。乃光流千古。法眼別云。 昨日有多少喧鬧。法燈云。今日更好笑。看他 二尊宿是當派下兒孫。覰破玄沙用底。一向 寬遮外羅却就裏。暗箭相射。天童具通方眼。 見伊家長裏短。徹底頌出。頌云。
text_en: ate plain food and was content. Xuefeng esteemed his ascetic practice highly and often called him Bei the dhutanga monk. It is said in the world: Xuansha did not go beyond the ridge; Baoshou did not cross the river. Once he stumbled and injured a toe. He sighed and said: This body is not truly existent, so whence comes pain? This body is suffering; ultimately there is no birth. Enough, enough. Bodhidharma never came to the East; the Second Patriarch never went to the West. Thus he turned back. Later, because of reading the Shurangama, he had an awakening. Therefore his responses to situations were swift and keen, and in accord with the sutras. Even when questioning and debating with Xuefeng, he would not yield. Xuefeng said: Head-Monk Bei is one who has come again. The Min commander Wang Shenzhi and Lord Wang Yanbin both treated the master with reverence. His assembly regularly numbered eight or nine hundred. When Xuansha came to Putian County, a hundred entertainments welcomed him. The next day he asked Elder Xiaotang: Yesterday there was so much bustle and noise; where did it all go? Xiaotang lifted up the corner of his robe. Not bad, sharp and steep. First of all, you must not fix your gaze on noise and stillness, on yesterday and today. If you do, you miss the great matter right before you. Xiaotang spent no effort of mind, just casually picked up his robe. Xuansha said: Picked up, it is unrelated. Where is this place of no relation for Xiaotang? Did Xuansha approve or not? Dawei Zhe said: Dawei is not like that. If someone asks, I simply snap my fingers once. If a patch-robed monk comes forth and says, Picked up, it is unrelated, then I would approve him. Why? Because for a great man, even stroking a tiger's whiskers is part of his proper work. But tell me, where do advantage and danger lie? In what place? He also said: Xiaotang harbors a supreme treasure; meeting a discerner only adds to its brilliance. Xuansha's fundamental hammer and chisel struck once, and its light flowed through a thousand ages. Fayan separately said: How much noise was there yesterday? Fadeng said: Today is even more laughable. Look at these two venerable ones, true descendants of that line, who saw through Xuansha's move. All along they spread a broad net outside while closing in within, shooting hidden arrows at each other. Tiantong had eyes that see all sides, and seeing all their long and short points, he sang it out to the bottom. The verse says:
In the night ravine a boat is hidden; on clear depths an oar is set. Dragons and fish do not yet know water is their Patch-robed monks are hard to fool Willing to fall into dead water

text_zh: 夜壑藏舟衲子難謾　澄源著棹肯墮死水　龍魚未知水為 命當局者迷折筋不妨聊一攪打草驚蛇　玄沙師小塘老 一狀領過函蓋箭鋒易開終始口　探竿影草難保歲寒心　潛縮也 老龜巢蓮藏身處沒蹤跡游戲也華鱗弄藻沒蹤跡處莫藏身
text_en: life. The one in the game is confused With a broken switch, no harm in stirring once for sport. Master Xuansha and old Xiaotang Beat the grass and startle the snake Receive it all under one charge Lid and box, arrow point, probing pole and shadowing grass; in hidden withdrawal too Easy to open the mouth at beginning and end Hard to keep a steadfast heart in winter cold an old turtle nests in the lotus. Where the body is hidden, no trace remains In play as well, bright-scaled fish sport among the waterweeds. Where no trace remains, do not hide the body
The teacher said: Xuansha asking about yesterday's bustle is like what the Great Master chapter of Zhuangzi says:

text_zh: 師云。玄沙問昨日喧鬧。如莊子大宗師篇云。 夫藏舟於壑。藏山於澤。謂之固矣。然夜半有 力者負之而趨。昧者不知也。藏小大有宜。猶 有所遯。若夫藏天下于天下。而不得所遯。是 恒物之大情也。天童以玄沙昨日今日置問。 藏舟密負以驗小塘。却來澄源湛水裏尚棹 孤舟。此玄中銘恐滯死水。玄沙句中眼活。要 人識動靜根源。臥龍球和尚曰。欲得省要却 是山河大地。與汝發明。其事既常。亦能究竟。 若從文殊門入者。一切有為土木瓦石助汝 發機。若從觀音門入者。一切音響。蝦䗫蚯蚓 助汝發機。若從普賢門入者。不動步而到。我 以此三門。方便示汝。如將一隻折筋攪大海 水。令彼魚龍知水為命。若常知動靜語默來 去根源。早不空過。此頌玄沙為人處。若是作 家。函蓋箭鋒。探竿影草。把定放行。看取提袈 裟與沒交涉。看是何道理。史記龜策。傳太史 公曰。余至江南。觀其行事。云龜千歲乃遊蓮 葉之上。此沒交涉。潛縮也不妨游戲。游戲也 不妨潛縮。今畫魚藻圖。藻水草也。隨波搖 漾自成文章。又藻水草有文者也。見論語。山 節藻梲。要識二老麼。有意氣時添意氣。不風 流處也風流。
text_en: If one hides a boat in a ravine and hides a mountain in a marsh, one calls it secure. Yet at midnight a strong man may carry it off and run, and the dim-witted do not know it. Hiding small and large things has its proper way, yet still there is somewhere for them to escape. But if one hides all under heaven within all under heaven, and there is nowhere to escape, that is the great truth of constant things. Tiantong used Xuansha's question of yesterday and today, secretly carrying off the hidden boat to test Xiaotang. Yet he still came back to row a lonely boat on clear and deep waters. In the Inscription of the Mystery, this fears stagnation in dead water. In Xuansha's phrase the eye is alive, wanting people to recognize the root-source of movement and stillness. Monk Wolong Qiu said: If you want to grasp the essence, it is precisely mountains, rivers, and the great earth that reveal it to you. Since this matter is constant, it can also be brought to completion. If you enter through Manjushri's gate, all conditioned things, earth, wood, tile, and stone assist you in arousing your function. If you enter through Guanyin's gate, all sounds, shrimps and earthworms, assist you in arousing your function. If you enter through Samantabhadra's gate, you arrive without moving a step. I use these three gates as expedient means to show you, like taking a single broken switch and stirring the great ocean waters, making those fish and dragons know that water is life. If you constantly know the root-source of movement and stillness, speech and silence, coming and going, then early on you will not pass by empty. This verse is where Xuansha worked for people. If one is a true adept, lid and box, arrow point, probing pole and shadowing grass, holding fast and letting go—look well at lifting the robe and at unrelated. See what principle this is. In the Records of the Historian, in the Treatise on Tortoise Divination, the Grand Historian said: When I went to Jiangnan and observed their practices, they said that a turtle at a thousand years then roams upon lotus leaves. This is unrelated. In hidden withdrawal it does no harm to play; in play it does no harm to withdraw and hide. Now in painting fish-and-weed scenes, the weeds are water plants; swaying with the waves, they naturally form patterns. Also, zao means water plants with markings. It is seen in the Analects: Mountain brackets and painted beam-heads. Do you want to know these two old men? When there is spirit, they add more spirit; where there is no elegance, there too they are elegant.

In the east one enters concentration, in the west one rises; even to the point that a male body enters concentration and a female body rises. Do you understand? The colors of the wild are no longer cut off by mountains; moonlight goes straight through and joins with the water. The baleful stars and broom stars, their omen is one and the same. Taking sound and form as shadows and echoes indicates their unreality. Shadow means mirror-images and moon in water; echo means sound transmitted in an empty valley. All these within the Way-mind are baleful stars. Ten thousand lands are like the ten thousand dharmas. The twelve fields are like the six faculties and six objects. The light of the three-thousand worlds illumines and shatters shadows and echoes. By removing shadows and echoes, light is released. Have you not seen Baizhang and Guling say: The numinous light shines alone, far transcending faculties and dusts. But if suddenly every faculty and every dust pervades the Dharma realm, then how is it then? You were about to call it a steamed bun, but instead it is a flat cake.

text_zh: 師云。紅絲脈斷。藥病俱亡。服藥忘了口來。診 脈忘了手來。所謂攢簇不得底病。華陀拱手。 扁鵲攢眉。道有通。身無影像。道無。遍界不 曾藏。齊朝曇鸞法師。得仙經十卷。後逢流支 三藏。問曰。佛法中有長生不死法。勝得此土 仙方否。三藏唾地曰。此土那有長生法。縱得 延年報盡還墜。即懷中探出無量壽觀經。授 與鸞曰。此大仙方。常得解脫。永出生死。楞嚴 十仙報盡。還來轉入諸趣。老子曰。死而不亡 者壽。東坡上佛印詩。長生未暇學。且學長不 死。全超威音之前。先天而未成。已成獨步劫 空之後。後天而既壞不壞。成平也。天蓋地擎。 運轉也。烏飛兔走。此喚作全體作用攝用歸 體。靜為天地本。動合聖賢心。還會這般說話 麼。撥開妙淨圓明眼。識取吉祥安樂人。
text_en: one forgets the hand. This is the sickness that cannot be pieced together. Hua Tuo folds his hands; Bian Que knits his brows. To say it is, it penetrates through, yet the body has no image. To say it is not, throughout the whole realm it is never hidden. In the Qi dynasty, Master Tanluan obtained ten scrolls of immortal scriptures. Later he met Tripitaka Bodhiruci and asked: In the Buddha Dharma, is there a method of long life and deathlessness better than the immortality arts of this land? The Tripitaka spat on the ground and said: How can there be a method of long life in this land? Even if one gains extended years, when the karmic reward is exhausted one still falls again. He then drew out the Contemplation Sutra of Infinite Life from his robe and gave it to Luan, saying: This is the great immortal formula. One always attains liberation and forever leaves birth and death. In the Shurangama, when the rewards of the ten immortals are exhausted, they return and enter the various destinies again. Laozi said: To die yet not perish is long life. Su Dongpo wrote in a poem to Foyin: I have no leisure yet to study long life; for now study long not-dying. Not dying wholly transcends before King Sound of Awe, prior to heaven and not yet formed; once formed, it walks alone after the kalpa is empty, after heaven, already ruined yet not ruined. In stillness it becomes level: heaven covers, earth supports. In movement it turns and revolves: the crow flies, the rabbit runs. This is called the functioning of the whole body, gathering function back to essence. Stillness is the root of heaven and earth; movement accords with the mind of sages and worthies. Do you understand this kind of talk or not? Open up the wondrous, pure, perfectly bright eye, and recognize the person of auspicious ease and joy.
