text_zh: 師云。婺州金華山俱胝禪師。初庵於天台。有 尼名實際。到來頂笠執錫。遶師三匝曰。道得 即拈下笠子。三問。胝並無對。際便去。胝曰。 日勢稍晚。且留一宿。際曰。道得即宿。胝又無 對。際去後。胝自歎曰。我雖處丈夫形。而無丈 夫之氣。擬棄庵諸方參學去。其夜山神告曰。 師不須離此山。將有大菩薩來為和尚說法 也。果旬日天龍和尚至。師罄誠迎禮。具陳前 事。天龍竪指示之。胝當下大悟。自此凡有僧 到。唯舉一指。無別提唱。所畜童子。於外被人 詰曰和尚說何法要。童子竪起一指。歸舉似 胝。胝以刀斷其指。童子叫呼走出。胝召一聲。 童子迴首。胝却竪起一指。童子忽然領悟。胝 將順世謂眾曰。吾得天龍一指頭禪。一生用不 盡。言訖示滅。萬松道。好與截却指頭。長慶代 云。美食不中飽人喫。萬松道。不貪香餌味。可 謂碧潭龍。玄沙云。我當時若見。與拗折指頭。 萬松道。不唯與童子雪冤。抑亦與後人出氣。 玄覺云。且道。玄沙恁麼道。意作麼生。萬松 道。果然疑著。雲居錫云。只如玄沙恁麼道。肯 伊不肯伊。若肯何言拗折指頭。若不肯俱胝 過在甚麼處。萬松道。過在肯不肯。先曹山云。 俱胝承當處莽鹵。只認得一機一境。一種是 拍手拊掌。是他南園奇怪。萬松道。水中擇乳 須是鵞王。玄覺又云。且道。俱胝還悟也未。若 悟為甚麼。說承當處莽鹵。若不悟又道用一 指頭禪不盡。且道。曹山意旨在甚麼處。萬松 道。曲高和寡。期遇知音。後來嘉山來禪師。在 鎮府西天寧。人問。鐵牛和尚塔何在。山以手 指之。忽然省發。乃成頌云。鐵牛鐵牛。更莫 別求。有人問我。竪起指頭。萬松道。雖是承當 莽鹵。要且不借傍來。不見。明招獨眼龍問國 泰深禪師。古人道。俱胝只念三行呪。便得名 超一切人。作麼生拈却三行呪。泰竪起一指。 招云。不因今日。爭識得這瓜州客。萬松道。假 令患狀殊。先須療其本。參同契。承言須會 宗。勿自立規矩。可謂夜深認得來時路。不待 天明便出關。佛國頌云。問答機緣豈易酬。無 錢難作好風流。心中有事說不得。只向忙中 竪指頭。若要作好風流說心中事。更參天童 和尚。頌云。
text_en: a nun named Shiji. She came wearing a bamboo hat and carrying a staff. She circled the master three times and said: If you can speak it, I will take off my hat. She asked three times, and Judi had no reply at all. Shiji then left. Judi said: It is getting late in the day; stay the night. Shiji said: If you can speak it, then I will stay. Judi again had no In reply. After Jì left, Juzhi sighed to himself, Though I have a man's form, I lack a man's spirit. He planned to leave the hermitage and go study in various places. That night the mountain spirit told him, Master, you need not leave this mountain. A great bodhisattva will come and preach the Dharma for you, indeed. Sure enough, after about ten days Master Tianlong arrived. Juzhi welcomed and bowed with utmost sincerity, and fully recounted the earlier events. Tianlong raised one finger to show him. Juzhi was greatly awakened on the spot. From then on, whenever a monk came, he only raised one finger, with no other instruction. A boy attendant he kept was outside and was asked by someone, What essential Dharma does your master teach? The boy raised one finger. Returning, he told this to Juzhi. Juzhi cut off his finger with a knife. The boy cried out and ran out. Juzhi called to him once. The boy turned his head. Juzhi then raised one finger. The boy suddenly understood. Juzhi when about to pass away said to the assembly, I obtained Tianlong's one-finger Zen; in a whole lifetime I never exhausted it. Having said this, he passed away. Wansong said, Better to cut off the finger. Changqing, speaking in his place, said, Fine food does not suit a full man. Wansong said, Not craving the taste of fragrant bait, this can be called a dragon in a deep pool. Xuansha said, If I had seen it at the time, I would have snapped that finger off. Wansong said, Not only would that redress the boy's grievance, it would also let later people vent their indignation. Xuanjue said, Tell me, when Xuansha spoke like this, what was his meaning? Wansong said, Sure enough, you are caught in doubt. Yunju Xi said, As for Xuansha speaking this way, did he approve of him or not? If he approved, why speak of snapping the finger? If he did not approve, then where was Juzhi's fault? Wansong said, The fault lies in approval and disapproval. Earlier Caoshan said, Juzhi was crude where he took it up. He only recognized one function and one condition. One kind is clapping hands and patting palms; that is his Nanyuan oddity. Wansong said, To separate milk from water one must be a king goose. Xuanjue again said, Tell me, was Juzhi awakened or not? If awakened, why say he was crude in taking it up? If not awakened, then why say he used one finger Zen without exhausting it? Tell me, where is Caoshan's intent? Wansong said, The tune is lofty and few can harmonize; it awaits one who knows the sound. Later Chan Master Jiashan Lai, at Xitianing in Zhenfu, was asked, Where is Master Tieniu's stupa? Lai pointed with his hand. On the spot he suddenly awakened, and composed a verse saying, Tieniu, Tieniu, seek no more elsewhere. If someone asks me, I raise a finger. Wansong said, Though this is a crude taking-up, still, at least it is not borrowed from the side. Have you not seen Mingzhao, the One-Eyed Dragon, ask Guotai Master Shen, The ancients said Juzhi merely recited a three-line spell, and thereby gained the reputation of surpassing everyone. How do you pick away the three-line spell? Tai raised one finger. Zhao said, If not for today, how would I know this traveler from Guazhou? Wansong said, Even if the symptoms differ, first one must treat the root. In the Cantongqi it says, Following words, one must understand the source; do not set up rules by yourself. This may be called, In the deep night he recognizes the road he came by; without waiting for dawn he leaves the pass. Foguo's verse says, How could the dynamic of question and answer be easily matched? Without money it is hard to cut a fine figure. When there is something in the heart that cannot be spoken, one only amid the bustle raises a finger. If you want to cut a fine figure and speak what is in the heart, then study Tiantong further, Master Tiantong. He versified:
Old man Juzhi's one-finger Zen, thirty years and still not worn out. Draw back the donkey's hoof To this day, hands are still raised helplessly

text_zh: 俱胝老子指頭禪縮却驢蹄　三十年來用不殘至今蹺手 亂下信有道人方外術這裏使不著　了無俗物眼前看 猶嫌少在所得甚簡畐塞乾坤　施設彌寬不消一揑　大千剎海 飲毛端不留涓滴鱗龍無限落誰手天童猶在　珍重任公 把釣竿不妨驚人手段師復竪起一指云看慚惶殺人
text_en: Strike wildly Truly there is a wayfarer's art beyond the world; before his eyes no vulgar thing remains. It cannot be used here Still complaining it is too little What is attained is very simple, yet its application grows ever vast; the seas of worlds in the great thousand Filling and blocking heaven and earth It does not take a single squeeze are drunk from the tip of a hair. Leaving not a trickle or drop Innumerable scaled dragons, into whose hands do they fall? Treasure well Master Ren's Tiantong is still here grasp of the fishing rod. No harm in a startling method The master again raised one finger and said, Look. Shame and alarm enough to kill a man
The master said, For ten thousand ages always empty, in one morning wind and moon; how could it be only thirty years without wearing

text_zh: 師云。萬古常空一朝風月。豈止三十年用不 殘。莊子大宗師篇。孔子曰。彼游方之外者也。 而丘游方之內者也。若無方外之術。爭得世 出世間全在一指頭上見徹根源。古詩道。眼 前無俗物。多病也身輕。天童近取諸身。唯用 一指。簡易之道。要而不繁。維摩毛吞大海名 小不思議經。華嚴。塵含法界名大不思議經。 楞嚴於一毛端。遍能含受十方國土。又云於 一毛端現寶王剎。坐微塵裏轉大法輪。莊子 任公子為大鉤巨緇。五十犗以為餌。蹲乎會 稽。投竿東海。旦旦而釣。期年不得魚。已而大 魚食之。牽巨鉤䤾沒而下。驚揚而奮鬐。白波 若山。海水震蕩。聲侔鬼神。燀赫千里。任公子 得若魚。離而腊之。自制浙河以東。蒼梧以北。 莫不厭若魚者。所謂。釣竿斫盡重栽竹。不計 功程得便休。後來接得斷指童子。國泰瑫別 峯相見。嘉山來誤入桃源。今日天童頌後。又 竪一指云。看。柏山大隱和尚道。大小天童隨 人脚跟走。五祖演和尚舉。僧問投子。如何是 十身調御子。下禪床立。還有僧問老僧。亦下 禪床立。為甚却依樣畫猫兒。待我計較成即 說向爾。是知。俱胝指頭。一迴飲水。一迴著 噎。教萬松別作箇甚麼向當。擲下拂子云。一 任諸方點檢。
text_en: out? In the Great Master chapter of Zhuangzi, Confucius said, He wanders beyond the bounds. I, Qiu, wander within the bounds. Without an art beyond the bounds, how could one see through the root of both worldly and world-transcending entirely upon one fingertip? An old poem says, Before the eyes there are no vulgar things; though often ill, the body is light. Tiantong takes what is near from the body, using only one finger. The way is simple and easy, essential and not complicated. In Vimalakirti, a hair swallowing the great ocean is called the small inconceivable scripture. In Huayan, a mote containing the Dharma realm is called the great inconceivable scripture. In the Surangama, on the tip of a single hair one can wholly contain the lands of the ten directions. It also says, On one hair-tip appear jeweled king lands; seated within a tiny mote one turns the great Dharma wheel. In Zhuangzi, Prince Ren made a huge hook and giant line, using fifty oxen as bait. He squatted at Kuaiji, cast his rod into the eastern sea, and fished day after day. For a full year he caught no fish. Then a giant fish swallowed it, dragging the huge hook down beneath the water. It thrashed and raised its fins; white waves rose like mountains. The sea shook and surged; the sound matched spirits and gods, blazing across a thousand li. Prince Ren caught that fish, cut it up and dried it. From east of the Zhe River to north of Cangwu, no one failed to be filled with that fish. As is said, When the fishing rods are chopped away, plant bamboo again; do not count the labor and stop once you gain it. Later he received the finger-cut boy. Guotai Tao and Biefeng met; Jiashan Lai mistakenly entered Peach Blossom Spring. Today, after Tiantong's verse, again he raised one finger and said, Look. Master Dayin of Baishan said, Big or small, Tiantong follows behind people's heels. Master Wuzu Yan cited: A monk asked Touzi, What is the Tamer with ten bodies? He got down from the Chan seat and stood. If a monk asks me, I too get down from the Chan seat and stand. Why then is it just copying the cat from the pattern? Wait till I reckon it out, then I will tell you. Thus we know, Juzhi's finger, one time drinks water, one time gets choked. What else can it make Wansong do in response? He threw down the whisk and said, One may let all quarters examine and judge.

text_zh: 85 國師塔樣
text_en: 85. The National Teacher's Stupa Pattern Instruction to the assembly: There is a hammer that shatters empty space, a technique that splits Mount Hua apart,

text_zh: 示眾云。有打破虛空底鉆鎚。擘開華嶽底手 段。始到元無縫罅處。不見瑕痕處。且誰是恁 麼人。
text_en: only then does one reach the place originally without seams or cracks, the place where no flaw is seen. But who is such a person?
Raised: Emperor Suzong asked National Teacher Zhong, After a hundred years, what will be needed? The National Teacher said, Make an unseamed stupa for this old monk. The emperor said, Right now

text_zh: 舉。肅宗帝問忠國師。百年後所須何物即今 也不少國師云。與老僧作箇無縫塔向甚處下手帝曰。 請師塔樣描不成畫不就國師良久云。會麼這裏不得會不會莫別求 帝云。不會却較些子國師云。吾有付法弟子耽源 却諳此事祖禰不了殃及兒孫後帝詔耽源問。此意如 何作家君王不忘遺囑源云。相之南譚之北天高地厚日左月右中 有黃金充一國畐塞虗空無影樹下合同舡密密金刀剪不 開瑠璃殿上無知識寂寂簾垂不露顏。
text_en: It is not little either Where do you set your hand to it Please, Master, the pattern for the stupa. The National Teacher was silent a long while, then said, Do you understand? Sketched, it fails; painted, it does not come out Here, whether you understand or not, do not seek elsewhere The emperor said, I do not understand. The National Teacher said, I have a Dharma-heir disciple, Danyuan, Still somewhat short who does understand this matter. Later the emperor summoned Danyuan and asked, What does this mean? If ancestors fail to settle it, disaster reaches children and grandchildren Yuan said, South of Xiang, north of Tan, in the middle A true sovereign does not forget the last charge Heaven high, earth deep, sun on the left, moon on the right there is gold filling a whole country; beneath the shadowless tree, a shared boat; atop the lapis hall, no knowing. Filling and blocking empty space So dense the golden knife cannot cut it Open Quietly the curtain hangs, not revealing the face
The master said, National Teacher Huizhong of Guangzhai Monastery in the western capital, having received the mind-seal, lived in the south

text_zh: 師云。西京光宅寺慧忠國師。自受心印。居南 陽白崖山黨子谷。四十餘年不下山門。道行 聞于帝里。唐肅宗上元二年。勅中使孫朝進。 齎詔徵赴京。待以師禮。初居千福寺西禪院。 及代宗臨御。復迎止光宅精藍。十有六載隨 機說法。大歷十年十二月九日。右脇長往。諡 大證禪師。佛果云。多有人道。國師無語便是 塔樣。若恁麼會。達磨一宗掃地而盡。啞子也 會禪。昔有二僧住庵。旬日不相見。上庵主問。 多日不見在甚麼處。下庵主曰。在庵裏造箇 無縫塔。上庵主曰。某甲也欲造箇。就師借取 樣子可否。下庵主曰。何不早道。恰被人借去 也。法眼云。且道。借伊樣不借伊樣。萬松道。 國師無語。下庵主為甚却支梧說道理。雪竇 云。肅宗不會則且致。耽源還會麼。只消一箇 請塔樣。盡西天此土諸位祖師。遭這一拶。不 免將南作北。有傍不肯底。出來我要問爾 那箇是無縫塔。萬松道。不是即道。吉州耽 源山真應禪師。受業于馬祖。久為國師侍 者。國師既化。帝詔源入內舉問前話。源亦 良久曰。聖上會麼。帝曰。不會。源述偈曰。相 之南譚之北。中有黃金充一國。無影樹下合 同舡。瑠璃殿上無知識。或云湘之南譚之北。 浮山遠錄公。作牛頭南馬頭北。但得旨忘筌。 無不可者。雪竇道不免將南作北。正謂此也。 僧問新羅大嶺。如何是一切處清淨。嶺云。截 瓊枝寸寸是寶。析栴檀片片皆香。丹霞淳和 尚頌云。乾坤盡是黃金國。萬有全彰淨妙身。 耽源黃金充一國。丹霞國亦是黃金。更較一 線道。無影樹下合同舡。周易略例云。同舟而 濟。則胡越何患乎異心。若漸卦三四。異體和 好物莫能間。順而相保似若同在一舟。上下 殊體。猶若胡越。利用禦寇。何患乎異心。此言 同身共命利害同也。法真一禪師問。是處是 慈氏無門無善財。為甚麼道瑠璃殿上無知 識。萬松道。坼殿了相見。然後看天童拈向爾 面前築著爾鼻孔。頌云。
text_en: at Dangzi Valley on White Cliff Mountain in Nanyang. For more than forty years he did not leave the mountain gate. His conduct in the Way became known in the imperial capital. In the second year of Shangyuan under Tang Suzong, an imperial eunuch, Sun Chaojin, was ordered to carry the edict and summon him to the capital, where he was treated with a master's honors. At first he stayed in the west Chan cloister of Qianfu Monastery. When Daizong came to the throne, he was again invited to reside at Guangzhai Monastery. For sixteen years he adapted to occasions and preached the Dharma. On the ninth day of the twelfth month in the tenth year of Dali, lying on his right side he passed away. He was posthumously titled Chan Master Great Realization. Foguo said, Many people say the National Teacher's silence itself was the stupa pattern. If you understand it that way, Bodhidharma's whole lineage is swept clean away. Then even a mute would understand Zen. Once two monks lived in hermitages. For ten days they did not see each other. The upper hermitage master asked, I have not seen you for many days; where have you been? The lower hermitage master said, In the hut making an unseamed stupa. The upper hermitage master said, I too want to make one. May I borrow your pattern, Master? The lower hermitage master said, Why did you not say so earlier? It has just been borrowed by someone already. Fayan said, Tell me, did he borrow his pattern or not? Wansong said, The National Teacher was silent; why then did the lower hermitage master hedge and explain with words? Xuedou said, Leave aside Suzong's not understanding. Did Danyuan understand or not? With only a single request for a stupa pattern, all the patriarchs of India and this land, when pressed by this squeeze, could not avoid turning south into north. If there is someone at the side who does not accept it, come forth, I want to ask you: which one is the unseamed stupa? Wansong said, If not this, then speak. Jizhou Danyuan Mountain's Chan Master Zhenying received instruction from Mazu and for a long time served as attendant to the National Teacher. After the National Teacher passed away, the emperor summoned Yuan into the palace and raised the former story. Yuan too was silent for a long while, then said, Does Your Majesty understand? The emperor said, I do not. Yuan recited a verse, Xiang to the south, Tan to the north; in the middle, gold filling a whole country. Beneath the shadowless tree, shared boat. On the lapis hall, no knowing. Some say, South of Xiang and north of Tan. Fushan Yuan, in his record, wrote, Ox-head south, Horse-head north. If one gets the meaning, one forgets the trap. There is nothing not allowable. Xuedou's saying they could not avoid turning south into north refers precisely to this. A monk asked Daeling of Silla, What is purity everywhere? Ling said, Cut jade branches and every inch is treasure; split sandalwood and every piece is fragrant. Danxia Chunhe versified, Heaven and earth are entirely a golden land; all things fully reveal the pure, wondrous body. Danyuan says gold fills a whole country; Danxia's land too is gold. Add one more line and say: beneath the shadowless tree, a shared boat. In the Brief Commentary on the Zhouyi it says, Sharing one boat and crossing over, then what fear is there that Hu and Yue will have different hearts? As for lines three and four of the Gradual hexagram, though different in form they harmonize, and no thing can come between them. Yielding and preserving one another is like being in one boat. Above and below are different bodies, like Hu and Yue; yet it is beneficial for resisting foes, so what fear is there of different hearts? This speaks of one body and shared life, with benefit and harm alike. Chan Master Fazhenyi asked, This very place is Maitreya; there is no gate and no Sudhana. Why then say on the lapis hall there is no know- ing? Wansong said, Split open the hall and meet, then watch Tiantong bring it right to your face and strike your nostrils. Verse:
Solitary, circling, round and full; where the power of sight is spent, it towers high. Not companion to the ten thousand dharmas Without lack, without surplus

text_zh: 孤迴迴不與萬法為侶　圓陀陀無缺無餘　眼力盡處高峩峩 斫額望不及月落潭空夜色重盡十方界如一𮢐墨　雲收山瘦 秋容多體露金風八卦位正天地合其德　五行氣和日月合其明 身先在裏見來麼到即不點　南陽父子兮却似知 有且信一半西竺佛祖兮無如奈何千聖從來立下風
text_en: Chop your forehead and still you cannot reach it by looking The moon sets, the pool is empty, the night colors deepen; clouds gather in, the mountains grow lean, The whole ten-direction world is like one stroke of ink rich with autumn's look. The body is exposed in the golden wind The eight trigrams are in proper place; the five phases' energies are in harmony. Heaven and earth join in its virtue Sun and moon join in its brightness Has the body gone ahead and already been there? The Nanyang father and son seem indeed to know Arrive and do not mark it there is. For now believe half of it As for the Buddhas and patriarchs of India, there is simply nothing they can do. A thousand sages have always stood downwind
The master said, Xuedou said, Layered and clear, the shadows round and round. That opening line is a fitting first phrase.

text_zh: 師云。雪竇道層落落影團團。此一句合頭語 也。天童道孤迴迴圓陀陀。萬劫繫驢橛也。眼 力盡處高峩峩。三世諸佛護持以為無見頂 相。雪竇頌天地同根萬物一體。南泉指花如 夢相似。亦云。見聞覺知非一一。山河不在鏡 中觀。霜天月落夜將半。誰共澄潭照影寒。試 將此頌。比天童月落潭空夜色重。古人大曬 有功夫。後來佛鑑一時注破。頌云。無縫塔兮 不是影。廓然一入真如境。爍迦羅眼電光流。 杳杳冥冥不見頂。此亦眼力盡處高峩峩。天 童頌針線貫通云。峩峩青山著秋瘦。毛髮凋 殘風骨舊。此亦雲收山瘦秋容多。可謂皮膚 脫落盡唯有一真實。到這裏八卦既位正。五 行亦氣和。運作修營無忌諱。何勞入市問孫 賓。身先在裏見來麼。天依懷禪師赴杉山請。 入院。上堂云。二十年樂慕此山。今日且喜。到 來因緣際會。山僧未到此山。身先到此山。洎 乎來到。杉山却在山僧身內。南陽父子兮却 似知有。不敢道是。只道却似箇知有底。爾道。 為甚不全許。恐辜負他國師父子。西竺佛祖 為甚也沒奈何。當道鑄成金堠子。正齋行下 鐵饅頭。
text_en: Tiantong says, Solitary, circling, round and full: a donkey-tethering stake for ten thousand kalpas. Where the power of sight is spent, it towers high: the Buddhas of the three times uphold this as the unseen crown-protuberance. Xuedou's verse on heaven and earth of one root and the myriad things one body, and Nansen pointing to a flower as like a dream, also says, Seeing, hearing, awareness, knowing are not one by one; mountains and rivers are not within a mirror to be viewed. In frosty skies the moon sets, the night is half gone; who shares the cold reflection in the clear pool? Try comparing this verse with Tiantong's moon set, pool empty, night colors deep. The ancients truly had deep work. Later Fojian once annotated it through, versifying: The unseamed stupa is not a shadow. Vastly entering the realm of thusness, the Sakra eye flashes like flowing lightning. Dim and dark, the summit cannot be seen. This too is where the power of sight is spent, towering high. Tian- tong, in a verse on needle and thread running through, says, Towering green mountains wear autumn leanness; hair and fur wither, the bones and frame grow old. This too is clouds gathered, mountains lean, rich autumn aspect. It can be called skin and flesh all fallen away, only the one reality remains. Here, the eight trigrams are rightly placed, and the five phases are also in harmony. In operation and construction there is no taboo. Why bother entering the market to ask Sun Bin? Has the body gone ahead and seen it there? Chan Master Tianyi Huai, going in response to an invitation to Shanshan, entered the monastery and in the hall said, For twenty years I have delighted in and admired this mountain. Today I am glad to have come through the meeting of causes and conditions. Before this mountain monk arrived at this mountain, my body had already arrived at this mountain. When I finally came, Shanshan was instead within this mountain monk's body. The Nanyang father and son indeed seem to know there is. I dare not say they are so; I only say they seem like those who know there is. Tell me, why not fully grant it? I fear slighting that National Teacher and his son. As for the Buddhas and patriarchs of India, why are they also helpless? Right in the road a golden milestone is cast; in proper order he sets down iron buns.

text_zh: 86 臨濟大悟
text_en: 86. Linji's Great Awakening Instruction to the assembly: Copper head, iron brow; heavenly eyes, dragon pupils; eagle beak, fish gills; bear heart,

text_zh: 示眾云。銅頭鐵額。天眼龍睛。雕觜魚顋。熊心 豹膽。金剛劍下是計不納。一籌不獲。為甚麼 如此。
text_en: leopard gall. Beneath the vajra sword no strategy is accepted, not a single tally is gained. Why is it like this?

Raised: Linji asked Huangbo, What is the true great meaning of the Buddha Dharma? Huangbo immediately struck him. This happened three times, and then he took leave of Huangbo and went to see Dayu. Killing people

text_zh: 舉。臨濟問黃蘗。如何是佛法的的大意殺人 可恕情理難容蘗便打棒棒見血如是三度乃辭蘗。見大愚 便重不便輕愚問。甚麼處來險照顧着濟云。黃蘗來杖瘡猶在 愚云。黃蘗有何言句這裏好報讐濟云。某甲三問 佛法的的大意。三度喫棒。不知有過無過 更少六十棒愚云。黃蘗恁麼。老婆為爾得徹困。更 來問有過無過再犯不容濟於言下大悟始知痛痒。
text_en: Forgivable perhaps, but hard for feeling and reason to accept Every blow draws blood Dayu asked, Where have you come from? Linji said, From Huangbo. Better heavy than light Dangerous, watch it carefully The staff wounds are still there Dayu said, What words did Huangbo speak? Linji said, I asked three times Here is a good place for revenge about the true great meaning of the Buddha Dharma, and three times I received blows. I do not know whether I was at fault or not. Dayu said, Huangbo is so grandmotherly, wearing himself out completely for your sake, and still Sixty blows fewer. you come asking whether there was fault or no fault. At these words Linji had a great awakening. A second offense will not be tolerated. Only then does one know pain and itch.
The teacher said: Chan Master Huizhao of Linji Monastery in Zhenzhou was named Yixuan, from Nanhua in Caozhou.

text_zh: 師云。鎮州臨濟院慧照禪師諱義玄。曹州南 華人。姓邢氏。初遍習經論。知非要捷。而造黃 蘗。隨眾三年並不參問。但秉節默處而已。首 座異其殊眾。勉勸參學。無盡燈辨誤。竊謂。濟 居三年。黃蘗豈不放人問事。既放之也。如濟 之器識。不能致一問端。須待首座教之。然 後能問乎。甞見楊無為作。濟贊。正法眼藏瞎 驢邊滅。黃蘗老婆大愚饒舌。又見。佛果作睦 州贊。辛辛辣辣。啀啀喍喍。穿濟北為大樹。推 雲門墮險崖。言如枯柴。理不可階。是之謂陣 蒲鞋。本錄悟後便云。元來佛法無多子。愚云。 這尿床鬼。適來問有過無過。而今又道佛法 無多子。是多少來。搊住云。道道。濟於大愚脇 下。築三拳。愚托開云。汝師黃蘗。非干我事。 濟返黃蘗。蘗問。來來去去有甚了期。濟云。只 為老婆心切。遂舉前話。蘗云。這大愚老漢。饒 舌待見。與打一頓。濟云。說甚待見。即今便 打。遂與黃蘗一掌。蘗吟吟笑云。這風顛漢。來 這裏捋虎鬚。濟便喝。蘗云。侍者引這風顛漢。 參堂去。溈山問仰山。臨濟得大愚力黃蘗力。 仰云。非但捋虎鬚。亦解坐虎頭。濟後示眾云。 我于先師處。三次問佛法大意。三次被打。如 蒿枝拂著相似。如今更思一頓。誰為下手。時 有僧出云。某甲下手。濟拈棒度與。僧擬接。濟 便打。雪竇云。臨濟放處較危。收來太速。天童 見他父子倜儻不群。黃蘗用處臨濟傳來。揀 緊切處頌出。頌云。
text_en: His surname was Xing. At first he studied sutras and treatises extensively, but knowing that this was not the essential shortcut, he went to Huangbo. He stayed with the assembly for three years and did not ask for interview at all, only keeping discipline and remaining silent. The head monk found him different from the rest and urged him to engage in practice and questioning. In Correcting Errors in the Endless Lamp, it is privately argued that Linji lived there three years; how could Huangbo not allow people to ask questions? Since he did allow it, with someone of Linji's capacity and understanding, could he really not manage even a single opening question, and have to wait for the head monk to teach him? Then only afterward be able to ask? I once saw Yang Wuwei compose a eulogy to Linji: The treasury of the true Dharma eye was extinguished at the blind donkey's side; Huangbo the old granny, Dayu the chatterbox. I also saw Foguo compose a eulogy to Muzhou: Pungent and sharp, gnashing and biting, he bored through north of the Ji as a great tree, and pushed Yunmen over a perilous cliff. Words like dry firewood, principle not to be climbed by steps: this is what is called battle-array straw sandals. In the original record, after awakening he immediately said, Originally Buddha Dharma is not much. Dayu said, You bed-wetting ghost! Just now you asked whether there was fault or not, and now you say Buddha Dharma is not much. How much is it then? He grabbed him and said, Speak, speak! Linji at Dayu's ribs punched him three times. Dayu pushed him away and said, Your teacher is Huangbo; this is none of my business. Linji returned to Huangbo. Huangbo asked, Coming and going, when will there be an end? Linji said, Only because of your granny heart being so earnest. Then he told the previous story. Huangbo said, That old fellow Dayu, too much loose tongue, wait till I see him and I'll give him a beating. Linji said, Why say wait till I see him? Right now I'll strike. He then gave Huangbo a slap. Huangbo chuckled and said, This madman comes here to stroke the tiger's whiskers. Linji then shouted. Huangbo said, Attendant, lead this madman to the monks' hall. Guishan asked Yangshan, Did Linji get it through Dayu's power or Huangbo's power? Yangshan said, Not only can he stroke the tiger's whiskers, he can also sit on the tiger's head. Later Linji addressed the assembly, saying: At my former teacher's place I asked three times about the great meaning of Buddha Dharma, and three times was beaten, as if brushed by a mugwort twig. Now I still want another beating. Who will lay on the blows? At the time a monk came forward and said, I will do it. Linji lifted the staff and handed it over. As the monk reached to take it, Linji immediately struck him. Xuedou said, Where Linji lets go is rather dangerous; when he gathers in, it is too quick. Tiantong saw that this father and son were bold and uncommon. He selected the crucial point of Huangbo's functioning as transmitted by Linji and brought it out in verse. The verse says:

A fledgling of the ninefold phoenix, a colt for a thousand li; the true wind passes through the bellows. The wings are already grown. The divine steed is also ready. One opening is empty and unobstructed.

text_zh: 九包之鶵羽翼既成　千里之駒神駿亦備　真風度籥一竅虛通 靈機發樞一撥便轉　劈面來時飛電急不容擬議　迷雲破 處太陽孤舊時光彩捋虎鬚萬松門下誰敢　見也無急著眼　箇 是雄雄大丈夫爭奈老婆心切
text_en: Subtle function releases the pivot; when it comes straight at the face, it is swift as flying lightning. When the clouds of delusion break, With one nudge it turns. No deliberation is allowed. there the solitary sun. The old-time brilliance. Stroking the tiger's whiskers—see! there is none Under Wansong, who dares to fix a hasty gaze? but a heroic great man. But the old granny's heart is too earnest.
The teacher said: This praises Linji. As Xie Chaozong truly had phoenix feathers, Huangbo in former years

text_zh: 師云。此讚臨濟。如謝超宗寔有鳳毛。黃蘗昔 年曾掌百丈。今日遭他臨濟毒手。真龍生龍 子。鳳長鳳雛。瑞應圖云。鳳有九包。一曰。歸 命。二曰。心合度。謂天度也。三曰。耳聽達。四 曰。舌曲申。五曰。彩光色。六曰。冠短州。當朱 色也。七曰。銳鉤。八曰。音激揚。九曰。腹戶。九 方堙為秦穆公相馬。果千里駒。此喻臨濟之 神俊一日千里也。纔悟便解真機大用。諸方 有一聯云。黃蘗腮邊轟一掌。大愚脇下築三 拳。良由真風度籥。故得靈機發樞。上句稟受 師承。下句自性宗通也。老子云。天地之間其 猶槖籥乎。槖無底囊也。亦皮鞴也。籥三孔笛 也。芭蕉徹云。譬如琴瑟箜篌雖有妙音。若無 妙指終不能發。本出楞嚴經。劈面來時飛電 急。言其峻機迅辯也。迷雲破處大陽孤。言其 悟明也。捋虎鬚。莊子云。孔子見盜跖退而曰。 丘所謂無病而自灸也。疾走撩虎頭。編虎鬚。 幾不免虎口哉。見也無。天童指似于人。令參 學人體取全機大用當仁不讓。喚作衲僧巴 鼻。無盡居士作續清涼傳。所請輒應後。見說 解脫禪師打文殊。不覺讚云。真大丈夫也。還 見臨濟悟處麼。羞殺河陽新婦子。驚甦木塔 老婆禪。
text_en: once served under Baizhang; today he met Linji's fierce hand. A true dragon gives birth to a dragon son; a phoenix raises a phoenix chick. The Auspicious Omens says: The phoenix has nine folds. First is called Returning to life. Second is called Heart in accord with measure, meaning heaven's measure. Third is called Ears hearing through. Fourth is called Tongue curved and extending. Fifth is called Brilliant colored light. Sixth is called Short-crested crown, corresponding to vermilion color. Seventh is called Sharp hook. Eighth is called Voice soaring and stirring. Ninth is called Belly door. Jiu Fangyin judged horses for Duke Mu of Qin and indeed found a thousand-li colt. This compares Linji's divine excellence, a thousand li in a single day. As soon as he awakened he understood the true function and great use. In various places there is a couplet that says: At Huangbo's cheek he thundered one slap; beneath Dayu's ribs he drove three punches. It is precisely because the true wind passed through the bellows that subtle function could release the pivot. The upper line speaks of receiving the teacher's transmission; the lower line is the lineage-through of one's own nature. Laozi says: Between heaven and earth, is it not like a bellows? The tuo is a bottomless sack, also a leather bellows. The yue is a three-holed flute. Master Bajiao Che said: It is like qin, se, and konghou—though they have marvelous sounds, if there is no marvelous touch, in the end they cannot be brought forth. This comes from the Shurangama Sutra. Coming straight at the face, like flying lightning, swift—this speaks of his severe function and quick eloquence. Where deluded clouds break, the great sun stands alone—this speaks of his awakened clarity. Stroking the tiger's whiskers: Zhuangzi says Confucius, after seeing Robber Zhi, withdrew and said, This is what I call cauterizing oneself with no illness—running quickly to tease a tiger's head and braid a tiger's whiskers. One can hardly avoid the tiger's jaws. See or not? Tiantong points this out to people, causing practitioners to embody the complete function and great use, not yielding when duty is theirs. This is called the patch-robed monk's nostrils. Layman Wujin, in his Continued Record of Qingliang, after saying that whatever was requested he responded to, recounts that Chan Master Jietuo struck Manjushri, and he could not help but praise him, saying, Truly a great man. Do you also see where Linji awakened? It shames to death the new bride of Heyang and startles awake the wooden-tower old-woman Zen.

text_zh: 87 疎山有無
text_en: 87. Shushan's Being and Nonbeing Instruction to the assembly: When a gate is about to close, one shove and it opens. When a boat is about to sink, one pole and it turns.

text_zh: 示眾云。門欲闔一拶便開。舡欲沈一篙便轉。 車箱入谷無歸路。箭筈通天有一門。且道。向 甚麼處去。
text_en: A cart axlebox entering a valley has no road back. An arrow socket piercing heaven has one gate. Tell me, where do you go?
Raised: When Shushan arrived at Guishan, he immediately asked, I have heard, Master, you say: With phrase, without phrase,

text_zh: 舉。疎山到溈山便問。承師有言。有句無句 如藤倚樹挂入唇齒忽然樹倒。藤枯句歸何處承言 者喪滯句者迷溈山呵呵大笑禹力不到處河聲流向西疎山云。某 甲四千里賣布單來。和尚何得相弄草鞋錢還來未 溈喚侍者取錢。還這上座不義之財於我如浮雲遂囑 云。向後有獨眼龍。為子點破去在更有四千里後 到明昭舉前話一客煩兩主昭云。溈山可謂頭正 尾正。只是不遇知音自是浦繩短非干古井深疎復問。樹 倒。藤枯句歸何處又恁麼來也昭云。更使溈山笑 轉新別人拳頭畫地疎於言下有省還了布單債乃云。溈山 元來笑裏有刀始覺破皮見血。
text_en: it is like a vine leaning on a tree. Suddenly the tree falls and the vine withers—where does the phrase return? Guishan laughed loudly. Shushan said, I Hang it on the lips and teeth. Receiving the words. The one who clings to words is stuck; the one who loses them is deluded. Where Yu’s strength cannot reach, the sound of the river flows westward. have come four thousand li, selling my cloth robe to get here. How can you, master, toy with me like this? Have you paid back the money for the straw sandals or not? Guishan called to the attendant, Fetch money and repay this senior monk. Then he charged him, saying, Ill-gotten wealth is to me like floating clouds. Later there will be a one-eyed dragon who will break this open for you. And there are another four thousand li. Later he went to Mingzhao and told the previous story. Zhao said, Guishan can be said to have the head right One guest troubles two hosts. and the tail right; it is only that he did not meet one who knew the tune. Shu again asked, The tree It is only that the rope is short; it has nothing to do with the old well being deep. falls, the vine withers—where does the phrase return? Zhao said, It only makes Guishan laugh Again it comes like this. all the more. At these words Shushan had an insight and then said, Guishan Another man’s fist draws on the ground. The bedding-debt has been repaid. all along had a knife in his laughter. Only then do you realize it has broken the skin and drawn blood.
The teacher said: Chan Master Guangren of Shushan in Fuzhou, when studying with Dongshan, asked, Concerning what has not yet been—

text_zh: 師云。撫州疎山光仁禪師。參洞山問。未有之 言。請師示誨。山曰。不諾。無人肯。疎云。還可 切也無。山曰。闍梨即今還切得麼。疎云。切不 得即無諱處。後在香嚴會下。僧問嚴。不慕諸 聖。不重己靈時如何。嚴云。萬機休罷。千聖不 携。疎在眾作嘔聲曰。是何言歟。嚴問。阿誰。 眾曰。師叔。嚴曰。汝不諾山僧耶。疎出眾曰。 是。嚴曰。汝莫道得麼。疎曰。道得。嚴曰。汝試 道看。疎曰。若教某道。須還師資禮始得。嚴乃 下座禮拜了。躡前語問之。疎曰。何不道。肯諾 不得全。嚴曰。肯又肯箇甚麼。諾又諾於阿誰。 疎曰。肯則肯他千聖。諾則諾于自己。嚴曰。 饒爾恁麼。也須三十年倒屙。設住山無柴燒。 住水無水喫。分明記取。後住疎山。果如嚴記。 二十七年病愈。自曰香嚴記我三十年倒屙 今欠三年。凡食後以手抉而吐之。以應嚴記。 疎後問鏡清道怤禪師。肯諾不得全。汝作麼 生會。怤曰。全歸肯諾。疎曰。不得全又作麼 生。怤曰。箇中無肯路。疎曰。方愜病僧意。溈 山懶安。禪門三懶之一也。亦曰長慶大安禪 師。示眾云。有句無句。如藤倚樹。疎不遠四千 里。賣布單去問。值溈泥壁次便問。有句無句 如藤倚樹。豈不是和尚語。溈曰。是。疎曰。忽 若樹倒藤枯時如何。溈放泥槃。大笑歸方丈。 疎隨後曰。某四千里賣布單。特為此來。和尚 何得相弄。溈喚侍者。討錢還伊布單令去。因 囑向後有獨眼龍。為汝點破去在。後果遇明 昭點破。疎山四千里賣布單。特為此話。今時 傍家行脚者。亦可本分事上留心。但隨方建 立遞相讚揚。不可如疎山向眾中作嘔聲。不 道伊別無長處。破羯磨。破轉法輪。破和合僧。 必招現報。香嚴受記。疏山抉吐應記。皆作後 人榜樣。疏山亦不可測地位中人也。疏尋常 接機。手握木蛇。僧問手中是甚麼物。疏提起 蛇曰。曹家女。雪峯入山。採得一枝木。其形似 蛇。背上題曰。本自天然不假雕琢。寄與溈山 大安。溈曰。本色住山人。且無刀斧痕。疎山 既因此話。見溈山。亦用木蛇。或親傳。或倣 像。不可知也。明昭又問疎。虎生七子。阿那 箇無尾。疏曰。第七箇無尾。雲門韶國師。皆 參疎山。矮師叔名遂冠古今。天童只將溈山 笑處。疎山覰破。明昭舉處。徑直頌出。頌云。
text_en: please, Master, give instruction. Dongshan said, No assent; no one affirms. Shu said, Is there still any intimate point or not? Dongshan said, Right now, Reverend, can you get the intimate point? Shu said, If one cannot get it, then there is nothing to hide. Later, in Xiangyan's assembly, a monk asked Xiangyan, Not admiring the sages and not valuing one's own spirit—what then? Xiangyan said, The ten thousand functions rest; the thousand sages do not carry it along. Shu, in the assembly, made a retching sound and said, What kind of words are these? Xiangyan asked, Who is that? The assembly said, Your uncle in the Dharma. Xiangyan said, Do you not assent to this mountain monk? Shu came forth and said, That is so. Xiangyan said, Can you say it? Shu said, I can. Xiangyan said, Try saying it. Shu said, If you want me to say it, you must first return the rites between teacher and disciple. Xiangyan then came down from the seat and bowed. Repeating his previous words, he asked him. Shu said, Why not say: Assent and affirmation cannot be complete. Xiangyan said, Assent—assent to what? Affirmation—affirmation to whom? Shu said, If assenting, one assents to the thousand sages; if affirming, one affirms to oneself. Xiangyan said, Even so, you still must spend thirty years shitting backward. If you live on a mountain, there will be no firewood to burn. If you live by water, there will be no water to drink. Remember this clearly. Later, when he lived on Shushan, it was indeed as Xiangyan predicted. After twenty-seven years his illness eased, and he said to himself, Xiangyan predicted thirty years of shitting backward for me; now I still owe three years. After every meal he used his hand to induce vomiting, to fulfill Xiangyan's prediction. Later Shu asked Chan Master Daofu of Jingqing, Assent and affirmation cannot be complete—how do you understand this? Fu said, Complete return is precisely assent and affirmation. Shu said, If it cannot be complete, then how is it? Fu said, In this there is no road of assent. Shu said, Now it finally suits this sick monk's meaning. Gui- shan Lanan was one of the Three Lazies of the Chan school, also called Chan Master Da'an of Changqing. He instructed the assembly, saying: With phrase, without phrase, it is like a vine leaning on a tree. Shu did not consider four thousand li too far, and sold his cloth robe to go ask. He happened upon Gui plastering a wall and asked: With phrase, without phrase, like a vine leaning on a tree—is this not your saying, master? Gui said, Yes. Shu said, Suppose the tree falls and the vine withers—what then? Gui set down the mud pan, laughed loudly, and returned to the abbot's room. Shu followed after him and said, I sold my cloth robe and came four thousand li especially for this. master, how can you toy with me? Gui called the attendant: Fetch money and repay him for his cloth robe, and send him off. Then he charged him, Later there will be a one-eyed dragon who will break it open for you. Later he indeed met Ming- zhao, who broke it open. Shushan sold his cloth robe and traveled four thousand li especially for this saying. People today who wander from house to house may also keep their mind on their proper matter. But they merely establish things according to circumstances and praise one another in turn. One must not, like Shushan, make retching sounds in the assembly. It is not that he had no other strong points, but this breaks karmic procedure, breaks the turning of the Dharma wheel, breaks the harmony of the sangha. It surely invites immediate retribution. Xiangyan gave a prediction; Shushan induced vomiting to answer it. Both became examples for later people. Shushan too was someone whose level cannot be fathomed. Shu ordinarily met people while holding a wooden snake in his hand. A monk asked, What is that thing in your hand? Shu lifted the snake and said, A girl of the Cao family. Xuefeng entered the mountains and found a branch of wood shaped like a snake. On its back he inscribed: Originally natural, not needing carving. He sent it to Guishan Da'an. Gui said, A true mountain dweller, and without marks of knife or axe. Shushan, having met Guishan because of this story, also used a wooden snake—whether personally transmitted or imitated, cannot be known. Mingzhao also asked Shu, A tiger bears seven cubs—which one has no tail? Shu said, The seventh has no tail. National Teacher Shao of Yunmen also studied with Shushan. The short Dharma-uncle's name thus crowned past and present. Tiantong only took Guishan's point of laughter, Shushan's seeing through it, and Mingzhao's raising of it, and directly brought it out in verse. The verse says:
Vine withered, tree fallen—he asks Guishan. A great hahahaha laugh—how could it be merely Walk to where the waters end; sit and watch when the clouds rise.

text_zh: 藤枯樹倒問溈山行到水窮處坐看雲起時　大笑呵呵豈等 閑險作相弄會笑裏有刀窺得破將謂別有　言思無路絕 機關四千里地賺我來
text_en: idle? It almost became a mutual fooling. There is a knife in the laughter—he peered and broke through it. Speech and thought have no road; the mechanism is cut off. I had thought there was something else. The hinge-mechanism is severed. Four thousand li, and he tricked me into coming.
The teacher said: The outsider took Ayou as auspicious. At the head of the scripture, the syllable a signifies

text_zh: 師云。外道立阿憂為吉。經頭以字是阿字言 無憂。字言有。故外道問佛。不問有言。不問無 言。此乃鯨吞海水盡也。世尊良久。此乃露出 珊瑚枝也。外道禮。讚世尊大慈開我迷雲令 我得入。香嚴瑞道。語是謗。寂是誑。語寂向上 有路在。大溈借此。以為示眾。疎山見道加藤 倚樹。便道樹倒藤枯句歸何處。怎生不教溈 山大笑。溈山言無展事。語不投機。疏山承言 者喪。滯句者迷。當時若問萬松。但云蒼天蒼 天。不見道春行冬令。
text_en: no; the syllable you signifies yes. Therefore the outsider asked the Buddha, not asking for a statement of yes, not asking for a statement of no. This is like a whale swallowing all the sea water dry. The World-Honored One remained silent a long time. This is like revealing a branch of coral. The outsider bowed and praised the World-Honored One's great compassion for opening my clouds of delusion and enabling me to enter. Xiangyan Rui said: Speech is slander, silence is deceit; above speech and silence there is a road. Great Gui borrowed this to instruct the assembly. As soon as Shushan heard him add, vine leaning on tree, he at once said, Tree falls, vine withers—where does the phrase return? How could this not make Gui- shan laugh loudly? Guishan's words gave no opening, and speech did not hit the pivot. Shushan, clinging to words, is lost; one stuck in phrases is deluded. If at that time you asked Wansong, I would only say, Blue heaven, blue heaven. Do you not see that spring is carrying out winter's order?

text_zh: 88 楞嚴不見
text_en: 88. Shurangama Not Seeing Instruction to the assembly: With seeing and not seeing, you light a lamp at noon. With no seeing and no not-seeing,

text_zh: 示眾云。有見有不見。日午點燈。無見無不見。 夜半潑墨。若信見聞如幻瞖。方知聲色若空 花。且道。教中還有衲僧說話麼。
text_en: you splash ink at midnight. If you trust that seeing and hearing are like illusory cataracts, then you will know sound and form are like empty flowers in space. But tell me, is there in the teachings any patch-robed monk's way of speaking?
Raised, from the Shurangama Sutra: When I do not see, why do you not see the place of my not-seeing?

text_zh: 舉楞嚴經云。吾不見時。何不見吾不見之 處是何心倖若見不見。自然非彼不見之相自知即得 若不見吾不見之地。自然非物。云何非汝 心忙手急推出擁入。
text_en: If you see the not-seeing, it is naturally not the mark of that not-seeing. What kind of lucky thought is that? Knowing for yourself is enough. If you do not see the ground of my not-seeing, it is naturally not a thing. How then is it not you? 。 Mind flurried, hands hurried, pushing out and crowding in.
The teacher said: Tiantong saw that Xuedou quoted the sutra in abridged form, yet still broadly raised the eye of the teachings. Though the raised passage

text_zh: 師云。天童見雪竇引經簡略。亦概舉教眼。舉 處雖略。頌處甚詳。楞嚴第二。先明非見之物 是前塵。次明非物之見是真性。今全舉次段。 正是此公案。經云。若見是物。則汝亦可見吾 之見。若同見者。名為見吾。吾不見時。何不見 吾不見之處。若見不見。自然非彼不見之相。 若不見吾不見之地。自然非物。云何非汝。長 水󱈜師注云。此文之意。展轉結歸。都有五重。 經文存三而隱二意。若具論者合云。若不見 吾不見之處。亦不見吾見處。既不見吾見處。 吾見自然非物。吾見若非是物。汝見亦非是 物。汝見既非是物。云何非汝真見。佛果舉。阿 難意。世界燈籠露柱。皆有名相。見精明元。喚 作甚麼物。願令我見。佛意我見香臺時。爾作 麼生。阿難云。我亦見香臺。即是見佛見處。佛 言。我見香臺則可知。我若不見香臺時。爾作 麼生。阿難云。我亦不見香臺。即是見佛不見。 佛言。汝云不見。自是汝知。他人不見處。爾如 何得知。古人到這裏。只可自知。與人說不得。 雪竇出教眼。單頌見佛。天童深得經意。頌出 真見。頌云。
text_en: is brief, the verse is very detailed. In the second fascicle of the Shurangama, it first clarifies that what is not the seeing, namely objects, are external dusts; next it clarifies that the seeing that is not a thing is true nature. Here the next section is quoted in full. This is exactly this koan. The sutra says: If seeing were a thing, then you too could see my seeing. If it is the same seeing, that is called seeing my seeing. When I do not see, why do you not see the place of my not-seeing? If you see the not-seeing, it is naturally not the mark of that not-seeing. If you do not see the ground of my not-seeing, it is naturally not a thing—how then is it not you? Chang- shui's commentary says: The meaning of this passage, turning and turning to its conclusion, has five levels in all. The sutra text preserves three and conceals two meanings. If discussed fully, it should say: If you do not see the place of my not-seeing, then you also do not see the place of my seeing. Since you do not see the place of my seeing, I see that what is naturally seen is not a thing. If what I see is not a thing, what you see is likewise not a thing. Since what you see is not a thing, how could it not be your true seeing? Foguo cites this: A- nanda’s idea was that the world, lanterns, and pillars all have names and forms; but the essence of seeing, luminous at root—what thing can that be called? Let me see it. The Buddha’s meaning was: when I see the incense stand, what do you make of it? Ananda said, I too see the incense stand; that is seeing where the Buddha sees. The Buddha said, when I see the incense stand, that can be known. If I do not see the incense stand, then what do you make of it? Ananda said, I also do not see the incense stand; that is seeing the Buddha’s not-seeing. The Buddha said, when you say not seeing, that is only what you yourself know. How can you know another person’s place of not-seeing? When the ancients got here, they could only know it themselves, not speak of it to others. Xuedou brought out the scriptural eye and only praised seeing the Buddha. Tiantong deeply grasped the sutra’s meaning and praised true seeing. The verse says:
Drain the blue sea dry, and the great void fills the patch-robed monk’s nostrils As before, white waves tower to the sky. Not a hair's breadth is seen.

The effort of mind is spent in vain. As soon as the jade loom turns once, face to face below—who recognizes him? The literary colors cross and spread, yet the meaning is distinct. What kind of face is this? Only then do you trust: this person is not fit for company. Demoted into the solitary hell.

text_zh: 師云。雪竇道。劫石固來猶可壞。滄溟深處立 須乾。然後太虛充滿。佛眼之嗣。竹庵珪和尚。 與伯父持一居士。俱喜楞嚴經。庵曰。若離前 塵。有分別性。正是生死根本。士駭曰。佛妄說 耶。庵曰。佛固不妄。且約只今居士對面徵詰 之心。果安在。士歎曰。佛說解第一空名師子 吼。汝行矣。無滯此。庵後上堂云。見見之時。 見非是見。見猶離見。見不能及。落花有意隨 流水。流水無情送落花。諸可還者自然非汝。 不汝還者非汝而誰。常恨春歸無覓處。不知 轉入此中來。喝一喝云。三十年後。莫道能仁 教壞人家男女。萬松只將前三句。注破公案。 據雪竇直頌見佛。佛果單提佛不見處只可 自知。天童頌瀝乾滄海畐塞太虛。竹庵直明 非物之見亦生死根本。此衲僧鼻孔長。皆出 教意外。別出一隻眼。古佛舌頭短。萬松道。古 佛就機隨他意。語俯為下機。故說半字。衲僧 一向全提正令。故有別傳之道。溫州瑞鹿寺。 上方遇安禪師。破句讀楞嚴經曰知見立。知 即無明本。知見無。見斯即涅槃。忽然頓省。人 曰。和尚道破句也。安曰是吾悟處。竟不改。時 號安楞嚴。萬松道。也是因邪打正。珠絲度九 曲。世傳。孔子厄於陳。穿九曲珠。遇桑間女子。 授之以訣。密矣思之。思之密矣。孔子遂曉以 絲繫蟻。引之以蜜而穿之。泗州普照宗和尚 作天童頌古拈古序云。屈曲相通。肖貫珠之 絲蟻。裴迴相附。猶布雨之雲龍。浮山九帶集。 有屈曲垂帶。大意明曲為今時事。玉機纔一 轉。如玉機一梭未成文彩。天童舉洞山初秋 夏末話了乃云。出門是草。涉芊芊莽莽之間。 葉落知秋。墮黯黯青青之處。到這裏。須體取 機雖轉紐。印未成文處始得。良久云。水明老 蚌懷胎後。雲重蒼龍退骨時。直下相逢誰識 渠。始信斯人不合伴。夾山云。坐斷主人翁。不 落第二見。須知有一人不合伴。萬松道。獨來 將謂無相識。鬧裏忽然逢故人。
text_en: dry it up—only then is the great void filled. Zhugan Gui, heir to Foyan, and the layman Chiyi, his elder uncle, both delighted in the Surangama Sutra. Zhu’an said: If apart from objects before you there is a discriminating nature, that is precisely the root of birth and death. The layman was startled and said: Does the Buddha falsely speak then? Zhu’an said: The Buddha surely does not speak falsely. But take this very moment, as I question you face to face— where exactly is that mind? The layman sighed and said: The Buddha said, one who understands emptiness first is called a lion’s roar. You may go now; do not linger here. Later Zhu’an ascended the hall and said: When seeing sees, seeing is not itself seeing. Seeing is still apart from seeing; seeing cannot reach it. Fallen flowers, with intent, follow the flowing stream; the flowing stream, without feeling, carries off the fallen flowers. Whatever can be returned is naturally not you. That which is not returned to you—if not you, then who? We always regret spring’s return with no place to seek it; not knowing it has turned and entered right here. He gave a shout and said: Thirty years from now, do not say the Benevolent One taught and ruined the sons and daughters of other households. Wansong only uses the first three lines to pierce the case with commentary. According to Xuedou, he directly praised seeing the Buddha. Foguo singled out the Buddha’s place of not-seeing as something only self-known. Tiantong praised draining the blue sea dry and cramming the great void full. Zhu’an directly made clear that the seeing of non-thing is also the root of birth and death. This patch-robed monk’s long nostrils all come forth beyond the scriptural meaning, revealing another eye. The ancient Buddha’s tongue is short. Wansong said: The ancient Buddha followed the occasion and accorded with their meaning; his words bent down for those of lesser capacity, so he spoke but half a word. The patch-robed monk always fully upholds the true command; therefore there is the Way of a separate transmission. At Ruilu Monastery in Wenzhou, Chan Master Yu’an of Shangfang punctuated the Surangama Sutra thus: When knowing and seeing are established, knowing is the root of ignorance. When knowing and seeing are absent, this seeing is nirvana. He suddenly awakened. People said, Master, you have broken the sentence wrongly. An said, This is where I awakened, and in the end he did not change it. At the time he was called An of the Surangama. Wansong said: This too is correcting the right by means of the crooked. A pearl-thread passes nine bends. It is said in the world that when Confucius was trapped in Chen and had to thread a nine-bend pearl, he met a girl among the mulberries who gave him the secret: Fine indeed—think on it; think on it finely. Confucius then understood and used a thread tied to an ant, luring it with honey to draw it through. Master Puzhao Zong of Sizhou wrote in his preface to Tiantong’s verses on the old cases: Crooked and winding, yet interconnected, like the thread and ant threading a pearl; circling and clinging to each other, like cloud and dragon spreading rain. In Fushan’s Nine-Belt Collection there is the winding hanging belt; the main idea is to show that the curved serves present occasions. As soon as the jade loom turns once, like a single shuttle of a jade loom before the pattern is formed. Tiantong cites Dongshan’s early-autumn, late-summer saying, and then says: To go out the gate is grass, treading amid dense and tangled growth. Leaves fall and you know autumn, dropping into dim green places. When you get here, you must realize the point where, though the pivot has turned, the seal has not yet formed a pattern. After a pause he said: When the old clam in bright water is pregnant, when heavy clouds gather and the blue dragon sheds its bones—meeting directly below, who recognizes him? Only then do you trust this person is not fit for company. Jiashan said: Sit decisively as the master; do not fall into the second view. You must know there is one person not fit for company. Wansong said: Coming alone, you would think there was no one acquainted—then in the bustle you suddenly meet an old friend.

text_zh: 89 洞山無草
text_en: 89. Dongshan’s No Grass Instruction to the assembly: If you move, you bury yourself a thousand fathoms deep. If you do not move, shoots spring up where you stand. You must

text_zh: 示眾云。動則埋身千丈。不動則當處生苗。直 須兩頭撒開。中間放下。更買草鞋行脚始得。
text_en: let go of both ends and set down the middle. Then buy straw sandals and go traveling—only then will it do.
Raised case: Dongshan addressed the assembly, saying: Brothers, at early autumn and summer’s end, some go east, some go west.

text_zh: 舉。洞山示眾云。秋初夏末兄弟。或東或西。 直須向萬里無寸草處去唆猫入枯井又云。只如 萬里無寸草處。作麼生去一言既發駟馬難追石霜云。 出門便是草自看脚下大陽云。直道。不出門亦是 草漫漫地沒爾廻避處。
text_en: You must go where for ten thousand miles there is not an inch of grass. Then he also said: But as for Urging a cat into a dry well. a place where for ten thousand miles there is not an inch of grass—how do you go there? Shishuang said: Once a word is spoken, four horses cannot catch it. As soon as you go out the gate, it is grass. Dayang said: Straight talk—if you do not go out the gate, it is also Look under your own feet. grass stretching everywhere. There is no place for you to dodge.
The teacher said: Shishuang encountered the Huichang persecution and, in lay clothing, stayed at Taojiafang in Liuyang, Changsha.

text_zh: 師云。石霜遇會昌之厄。以民服寓長沙瀏陽 陶家坊。大中初。一僧自洞山。夏滿而至。霜 問。近離何處。僧云。洞山。霜云。和尚有何言 句示徒。僧云。和尚近于解夏日。上堂謂眾曰。 兄弟秋初夏末。或東或西。直須向萬里無寸 草處去。良久云。只如萬里無寸草處。又作麼 生去。霜云。出門便是草。僧復舉似洞山。山曰。 此是一千五百人善知識語。且大唐國裏能 有幾人。既而囊錐始露。果熟香飄。眾命再緇。 住石霜道場。果符悟本之記。石霜因此公案。 道行天下。後來大陽延禪師云。如今直道。不 出門亦是草漫漫地。且道。合向甚麼處行履。 良久云。莫守寒巖異草青。坐著白雲宗不妙。 圓通善國師云。且道。諸人即今脚跟下一句。 作麼生道。若道萬里無寸草。許爾參見洞山。 若道出門便是草。許爾參見石霜。若道不出 門亦是草漫漫地。許爾參見大陽。若總道不 得。許爾參見延聖。何故唯有好風來席上。更 無閑語落人間。萬松道。若要三句總道得。更 須參見天童。頌云。
text_en: At the beginning of the Dazhong era, a monk came from Dongshan after completing the summer retreat. Shishuang asked, Where have you come from recently? The monk said, Dongshan. Shishuang said, What sayings does your master use to instruct disciples? The monk said, Near the day of ending the summer retreat, the master ascended the hall and told the assembly: Brothers, at early autumn and summer’s end, some go east, some go west. You must go to a place where for ten thousand miles there is not an inch of grass. After a pause he said, But as for a place where for ten thousand miles there is not an inch of grass, then how do you go there? Shishuang said, Step out the gate and it is grass. The monk then repeated this to Dongshan. Dongshan said: This is the speech of a good teacher of fifteen hundred people. In the great Tang realm, how many can there be like this? Later the awl in the bag at last showed its point; the fruit ripened and its fragrance spread. The community invited him again to wear robes. He took up residence at Shishuang’s monastery, truly matching Wuben’s prediction. Through this case, Shishuang’s Way spread under heaven. Later Chan Master Yan of Dayang said: Nowadays, speaking directly, if one does not go out the gate, it is also a place of endless grass. Tell me then, where should one practice and walk? After a pause he said: Do not keep to a cold cliff where strange grass grows green; sitting fixed in white clouds is not the school’s marvel. National Teacher Shanguo of Yuantong said: Tell me, right now, what is the phrase under your heels? How will you speak it? If you say, For ten thousand miles there is not an inch of grass, I permit you to have met Dongshan. If you say, Going out the gate is grass, I permit you to have met Shishuang. If you say, not going out the gate is also endless grass, I permit you to have met Dayang. If you cannot say any of them at all, I permit you to have met Yansheng. Why? Only a good breeze comes to the mat; no idle words fall among men. Wansong said: If you want to speak all three lines together, you must further meet Tiantong. The verse says:
Grass everywhere—inside the gate, outside the gate, you yourself must look; in the bramble- Straight down, no bottom; to the sides, no edge. Watch out or you'll trip.

In matters, one does not disdain detail. How many kinds are there? For now, go with the old tree in its winter leanness, Before the dead-tree cliff, the side paths are many. Just preserve today the resolve. then follow the spring wind into the burned scars. There will surely be a time that satisfies the heart.
The teacher said: Dayang said directly, Even not going out the gate is a place of endless grass. Tian-

text_zh: 師云。大陽道。直道。不出門亦是草漫漫地。天 童便道草漫漫。門裏門外君自看。恰似說話 不作意游戲其間。出門是草。人皆易知。亦易 迴互。不出門亦是草。人難知難轉身。所以道。 平地上死人無數。過得荊棘林。是好手。天童 道。荊棘林中下脚却易。平淨地上不出門庭。 夜明簾外轉身甚難。是須各自著眼。無人替 代。又云。幾何般。延聖四般。萬松五般。點檢 將來不出末後兩句。要識天童掌後處麼。虎 瘦雄心在。人貧志氣存。
text_en: tong then said, Grass everywhere, inside and outside the gate—look for yourself. It is just like speaking without contrivance, playing within it. Going out the gate is grass: everyone easily knows this, and it is easy to turn around there. Not going out the gate is also grass: people find it hard to know and hard to turn around. Therefore it is said: On level ground the dead are countless; one who gets through the bramble forest is a skillful hand. Tiantong says: In the bramble forest, setting down your foot is instead easy. On the flat clear ground, not going out the threshold, turning around outside the night-bright curtain is extremely hard. Each must use his own eyes; no one can do it in your place. He also says, How many kinds? Yansheng had four kinds; Wansong has five kinds. Checking them all over, they do not go beyond the final two lines. Do you want to know Tiantong’s place behind the palm? A tiger grows lean, but its heroic heart remains; a man may be poor, yet his resolve endures.

Yangshan then The one who comes whispering right and wrong rose, struck the gavel, and said: The Mahayana Dharma is apart from the four propositions, Closely observe the Dharma of the Dharma King; the Dharma King's Dharma is thus. text_zh: 師云。仰山七歲入定。見身與教主及迦葉二 十七祖等。同會精舍。其堂處空無柱石。地色 如瑠璃。覺已與諸祖。同是梵相披金襴。跣足 居第八位。一尊者年貌甚高。呼曰瞿曇。某今 當法事。仰便下座就揵椎白曰。大眾。淨心摩 訶衍法。離四句絕百非。言訖就座。及眾僧。悉 商量此釋義耳。仰又自說夢中往彌勒處。安 第三座。統要亦云第三座。與本錄同。有一尊 者白槌曰。今當第三座說法。山僧乃起白槌 云。摩訶衍法。離四句絕百非。諦聽諦聽。梵語 摩訶衍那。此云大乘。四句百非。馬祖藏頭白。 海頭黑。公案已剖判分明。此不復也。大溈秀 曰。依文解義則不無。忽然彌勒會中。有箇作 者。纔見伊道摩訶衍法。便云合取兩片皮。非 唯止絕仰山𥧌語。亦免使後人夢中說夢。萬 松道。大溈若解迴光返照。和萬松無地容身。 莫有夢中了了。醉裏醒醒底麼。頌云。
text_en: seven patriarchs assembled in a hall. The hall stood in space with no pillars or stones; the ground’s color was like lapis. On waking he and the patriarchs all had brahman-like marks, wore golden robes, and went barefoot, and he was in the eighth place. One venerable of very great age called out: Gautama, I now am to conduct the Dharma affair. Yang then left his seat, went to the striker, and announced: Great assembly, pure-mind Maha- yana Dharma is apart from the four propositions, beyond the hundred negations. Having spoken, he returned to his seat. And the monks all discussed only the meaning of this explanation. Yang also himself said that in the dream he went to Maitreya’s place and was placed in the third seat. Essentials of the Lineage also says third seat, the same as this record. One venerable struck and announced: Today the one in the third seat should preach the Dharma. The mountain monk then rose and announced with the gavel: The Mahayana Dharma is apart from the four propositions, beyond the hundred negations. Listen well, listen well. In Sanskrit, mahayana—here it means Great Vehicle. Four propositions and hundred negations: Mazu hid the head in white, Hai hid the head in black. The case has already been split open and judged clearly, so this will not be repeated. Dayi Xiu said: Explaining the meaning according to the words is not impossible. But suppose in Maitreya’s assembly there were someone who on hearing him say Mahayana Dharma immediately said, Shut those two flaps of skin. Then not only would he cut off Yangshan’s words, he would also save later people from telling dreams in a dream. Wan- song said: If Dayi knew how to turn the light around and reflect back, Wansong would have no place to hide. Is there anyone clear in a dream, awake within drunkenness? The verse says:
In a dream, clutching robe, he consults the elders; ranks of sages stand thick, seated to his right. The familiar mirror is hard to forget. A dog-pardon decree.

text_zh: 夢中擁衲參耆舊熟鏡難忘　列聖森森坐其右犬䘖赦書 諸侯避路當仁不讓揵椎鳴心不負人　說法無畏師子吼 面無慙色心安如海吞納百川　膽量如斗傍若無人　鮫目泪流 點點是血蚌腸珠剖赤心片片　譫語誰知泄我機手足俱露　龐 眉應笑揚家醜因誰致得離四句絕百非言猶在耳　馬師 父子病休醫走疼走痛神鬼難明
text_en: The feudal lords clear the road. When benevolence is called for, he yields to none: the striker sounds, he preaches the Dharma—fearless lion’s roar. The heart does not fail people. The face shows no shame. Mind at peace like the sea, courage as great as a dipper; from shark eyes tears flow. Swallowing and receiving a hundred rivers. As if no one were beside him. Dot by dot, it is blood. In the clam’s belly pearls are split open; who knows that babbling leaks out my secret? Pang’s Scarlet heart, piece by piece. Hands and feet are all exposed. brows should smile at exposing the family shame. Because of whom was this brought about? Beyond four propositions, cutting off a hundred negations—the Master Ma The words are still in the ears. father-and-son illness cannot be cured. Running with pain and ache, even spirits and ghosts can hardly make it out.
The teacher said: In the northeast there is a country always awake, without dreams. In the central region there is a country where dream and waking

text_zh: 師云。東北方有國。常覺無夢。中方有國。夢覺 常半。以夢中所作為虛。以覺來所作為實。西 南方有國。常夢五十日一覺。以覺者為虛以 夢中為實。此覺夢虛實未易知也。龍牙頌。在 夢那知。夢是虛。覺來方覺夢中無。迷時恰似 夢中士。悟後還同睡起夫。教中以夢。為獨頭 意識覽獨影境。仰山久無顛倒夢想。如何作 這去就。法華云。常作是好夢。金光明十地菩 薩。十種夢境。有夢益嘉。磁州大明詮大師。 好俳諧談笑。仁山恒和尚。囑定侍者。常拘檢 之。大師曰。人生一夢。快樂一世是好夢。拘檢 一世是惡夢。我寧作好夢。次日侍者抽單。仰 山雖夢中。猶與摩訶衍法游戲。亦聖眾之習 氣。揵椎非惟白椎。凡鐘魚警眾。總為揵椎。譯 為聲鳴。師子吼。證道經。師子吼無畏說。心安 如海。法華經。其心安如海。我聞疑網斷。蜀 志。尚書大將軍姜維。字伯約。世語斗膽。姜維 天童。無一字無來歷。任昉述異記。南海鮫人。 水居如魚。不廢機織。泣泪成珠。異聞續說。漢 武帝幸瓠子河。有人長尺餘。献洞穴珠一枚。 東方朔云。河底有穴。深數百丈。有赤㕩。腸生 此珠。徑寸明耀絕世。仰山只知泪出痛腸。不 覺舌在口外。酒陶真性。夢泄天機。四句百非 一時吐出。僧問馬師父子離四句絕百非。前 僧作西來意問頭。仰山下摩訶衍注脚。仰山。 亦馬祖之重孫。為甚麼藥。病不同。出身猶可 易。脫體道應難。
text_en: are always half and half, taking what is done in dreams as unreal and what is done when awake as real. In the south- west there is a country always dreaming, waking once in fifty days, taking waking as unreal and dreams as real. In this, the reality and unreality of waking and dreaming are not easily known. Longya’s verse says: In a dream, how can one know the dream is unreal? Only upon waking does one realize there was nothing in the dream. In delusion it is just like a man in a dream; after awakening it is like a man rising from sleep. In the teachings, dreams are taken as solitary consciousness cognizing a realm of solitary images. Yangshan had long been free of inverted dream-thoughts—how then did he make this coming and going? The Lotus says, one constantly has such good dreams. In the Golden Light, ten-stage bodhi- sattvas have ten kinds of dream states; some dreams are all the better. Great Master Daming Quan of Cizhou loved joking and laughter. Master Heng of Renshan instructed the attendant always to restrain and watch him. The great master said: Human life is one dream; a whole life of joy is a good dream. A whole life of restraint and policing is a bad dream. I would rather have a good dream. The next day the attendant withdrew. Though Yang- shan was in a dream, he still sported with the Mahayana Dharma; this too is the habitual energy of the holy assembly. The striker is not only the announcing gavel; all bells and fish-drums used to alert the assembly are all called jianzhui. It is translated as sounding voice. Lion’s roar: the Song of Enlightenment says, the lion’s roar is fearless preaching. Mind at peace like the sea: the Lotus Sutra says, his mind is at peace like the sea; when I heard, my net of doubt was cut. In the Records of Shu, the Minister and Great General Jiang Wei, style name Boyue, was called in common saying one with a dipper-gallbladder, Jiang Wei. In Tiantong, not a single word lacks a source. In Ren Fang’s Record of Strange Things: In the South Sea are shark-people, who dwell in water like fish yet do not cease weaving; when they weep, their tears become pearls. Continued Tales of Marvels says: In the Han, Emperor Wu visited the Huzi River; a person a little over a foot tall presented a single cave pearl. Dongfang Shuo said: at the bottom of the river there is a cavern, several hundred zhang deep. There is a red-intestined creature that produces this pearl. It is an inch across, its brightness surpassing the world. Yangshan only knew tears issue from pained bowels, and did not notice his tongue hanging outside his mouth. Wine molds the true nature; in a dream heaven's secret is spilled. The four propositions and hundred negations were all spat out at once. A monk had asked Mazu and his descendants, "Apart from the four propositions and cut off from the hundred negations," making the old "meaning of the Patriarch's coming from the West" question his opening. Yangshan then supplied a Mahayana footnote. Yangshan was also Mazu's great-grandson in the Dharma line. Why is the medicine one, yet the illness different? Getting out is still easy enough; to speak in a body-free way is hard.

text_zh: 91 南泉牡丹
text_en: 91 Nanquan's Peony Instruction to the assembly: Yangshan took what is in the dream as real; Nanquan pointed to the waking state as empty.

text_zh: 示眾云。仰山以夢中為實。南泉指覺處為虛。 若知覺夢元無。始信虛實絕待。且道。斯人具 甚麼眼。
text_en: If you know that waking and dreaming are originally nonexistent, then you begin to trust that emptiness and reality are beyond opposition. Tell me, what kind of eye does this person possess?
Raised case: Once, when Minister Lu Geng said to Nanquan, "Dharma Master Zhao is truly extraordinary.

text_zh: 舉。南泉因。陸亘大夫云。肇法師也甚奇特。 也是遼東白豕解道。天地同根萬物一體豎起兩指泉指庭 前牡丹云。大夫時人見此一株花。如夢相 似隔壁過狀。
text_en: He can explain, 'Heaven and earth have one root; the myriad things are one body.'" Nanquan pointed to the courtyard It is also the white pig of Liaodong. Raise two fingers. peony and said, "Minister, people nowadays see this single flower as if in a dream, just like that." Passing the complaint to the next wall.
The teacher said: Lu Geng of the Tang, style name Jingshan, was a man of Wujun. He served as Inspector of Xuanshe

text_zh: 師云。唐陸亘。字景山。吳郡人。官至宣歙觀察 使。加御史大夫。初問南泉。弟子瓶中養鵞。漸 大出瓶不得。如今不得損瓶。不得毀鵞。和尚 如何出得。南泉召曰。大夫。亘應諾。泉云。出 也。亘從此解悟。留心理性。游泳肇論。至涅槃 無名論第七妙存篇。玄道在于妙悟。妙悟在 于即真。即真則有無齊觀。齊觀則彼己莫二。 所以天地與我同根。萬物與我一體。同我則 非復有無。異我則乖于會通。所以不出不在。 而道存乎其間矣。亘舉此兩句以為奇特。殊 不知。正是說夢。雖然大小石頭和尚因。看肇 論。至通古第十七篇。夫至人空洞。無象而萬 物無非我造。會萬物為己者。其唯聖人乎。豁 然悟道。乃云。聖人無己。靡所不己。便作參同 契。佛果道。陸亘恁麼問。奇則甚奇。只是不出 教意。若道教意是極則。世尊何故更拈花。祖 師何故更西來。南泉答處。用衲僧巴鼻。與他 拈病。破他窠窟。遂指庭前花。召大夫云。時人 見此一株花。如夢相似。如引向萬丈懸崖上。 打一推令他命根斷。若只在平地上推到。彌 勒佛下生。也未會。在圓通善國師。竪起拂子 云。一切有為法如夢幻泡影。天童只就夢中。 變起華胥國土。頌云。
text_en: and was additionally made Censor-in-Chief. At first he asked Nanquan, "I keep a goose in a bottle. It gradually grows large and cannot get out. Now, without damaging the bottle and without harming the goose, Master, how can it be gotten out?" Nanquan called, "Minister!" Geng answered, "Yes?" Nanquan said, "Out it is." From this, Geng attained understanding. He then gave his mind to principle and nature, and immersed himself in Zhao's treatises. In the seventh chapter, "Marvelous Preservation," of the Nirvana No-Name Treatise, it says: The mysterious Way lies in marvelous awakening; marvelous awakening lies in immediacy to the real. If immediate to the real, then being and nonbeing are viewed equally; if viewed equally, then self and other are not two. Therefore heaven and earth and I share one root; the myriad things and I are one body. If they are the same as me, then there is no longer being or nonbeing. If they differ from me, they depart from interpenetration. Thus not outside and not inside, and the Way abides between them. Geng cited these two lines as something extraordinary, but he did not realize it was precisely talking in a dream. Even so, the great master Shitou once, upon reading Zhao's treatise, when he reached the seventeenth chapter "Comprehending Antiquity" and read, "The perfected person is empty and open, without form, and yet the myriad things are none but his making. He who can gather the myriad things as self, is that not the sage alone?" suddenly opened and awakened to the Way. Then he said, "The sage has no self, yet there is nothing that is not self," and thereupon composed the Cantongqi. Foguo said: Lu Geng's question is indeed very remarkable, but it still does not go beyond doctrinal meaning. If doctrinal meaning were the ultimate, why did the World-Honored One further hold up a flower? Why did the Patriarch still come from the West? Where Nanquan answered, he used a patchrobed monk's living grip to point out the illness and smash his nest. So he pointed to the flower in front of the courtyard and called to the minister, saying, "People nowadays see this single flower as if in a dream." It is like leading him to the edge of a ten-thousand-zhang cliff and giving one shove so that the root of his life is cut off. If you merely push him along level ground, even when Maitreya Buddha descends in the future, he still would not understand. National Teacher Shanguo of Yuantong raised his whisk and said, "All conditioned dharmas are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, and shadows." Tiantong just within the dream transformed and brought forth the realm of Huaxu. The verse says:
Illumining through the subtle and the apart, the root of creation; in endless comings and goings, its gate is seen. Walk to where the waters end.

text_zh: 照徹離微造化根行到水窮處　紛紛出沒見其門。 坐看雲起時游神劫外問何有心外無法　著眼身前知妙 存滿目青山虎嘯蕭蕭巖吹作乞火和煙得　龍吟冉冉洞 雲昏挑泉帶月歸南泉點破時人夢纔好睡語　要識堂堂 補處尊是處是慈氏
text_en: Sit and watch when the clouds rise. Roaming spirit beyond kalpas, ask what is there; set the eye before the body and know the marvelous Outside the mind there is no dharma. preservation. The eyes are full of green mountains. Tigers roar, soughing in the cliffs; it becomes dragon-chanting, drifting softly through the cave, Begging fire, one gets it along with smoke. while the clouds grow dim. Carrying spring water, he returns with the moon. Nanquan punctured the dream of people of the time; if you would know the stately Just fit for sleep-talk. Honored One of the place of succession, This very place is Maitreya.
The teacher said: In Master Zhao's Precious Treasury Treatise, in the chapter "Subtle in Departure, Wondrous in Essence," it says: In going out, subtle; in entering, apart.

text_zh: 師云。肇公寶藏論離微體妙品。其出微其入 離。知入離。外塵無所依。知出微。內心無所 為。內心無所為。諸見不能移。外塵無所依。萬 有不能羈。天童頌南泉照徹離微造化根。紛 紛出入見其門。見出微入離二門。只一門分 其內外。其實十方無壁落。四面亦無門。游神 劫外問何有。天地同根也。著眼身前。知妙存。 萬物一體也。根之與體。能生天地萬物。如龍 吟霧起。虎嘯風生。有感必應。所以庭前一株 花。遍見普天春花。萬松說箇夢。先有不睡底 人。次有睡。因睡不覺有夢。因夢見境。因境見 別有一身境中分別受用。若識得常不睡底。 人許多葛藤一筆句下。要知補處慈尊麼。此 時若不究根源。直待當來問彌勒。
text_en: Knowing entering-apart, outer dust has nowhere to rest. Knowing going-out-subtle, inner mind has nothing to do. If inner mind has nothing to do, all views cannot move it. If outer dust has nowhere to rest, the myriad things cannot bind it. Tiantong, in praising Nanquan, says, "Illumining through the subtle and the apart, the root of creation;" "in endless entering and leaving, its gate is seen." You see the two gates of going-out-subtle and entering-apart, yet it is only one gate divided into inner and outer. In truth, in the ten directions there are no walls, and on all four sides no gate either. "Roaming spirit beyond kalpas, ask what is there" means heaven and earth share one root. "Set the eye before the body, know marvelous preservation" means the myriad things are one body. Root and body can give rise to heaven, earth, and all things. Like dragons chanting and mist rising, tigers roaring and wind arising, when there is response there is surely resonance. Therefore one flower before the courtyard lets one see all spring flowers under heaven. Wansong speaks of a dream: first there is the one who does not sleep; next there is sleeping. Because of sleep, without awareness there is dreaming. Because of dreaming, one sees objects. Because of objects, one sees another body, distinguishing and experiencing within the scene. If you recognize the one who never sleeps, then all these tangles are cut off with one stroke and one phrase. Do you want to know the Compassionate Honored One of the place of succession? At this point, if you do not investigate the source, you can only wait for the future and ask Maitreya.

text_zh: 92 雲門一寶
text_en: 92 Yunmen's One Treasure Instruction to the assembly: Having attained the great samadhi of playful spiritual powers and understanding the dharani of beings' languages,

text_zh: 示眾云。得游戲神通大三昧。解眾生語言陀 羅尼。拽轉睦州秦時𨍏輅鑽。弄出雪峯南山 鱉鼻蛇。還識得此人麼。
text_en: he yanks around Muzhou's Qin-era axle-borer and brings out Xuefeng's South Mountain turtle-nosed snake. Do you still recognize this person?
Raised case: Great Master Yunmen said, "Within heaven and earth, within the cosmos, What about that which wraps heaven and earth?

text_zh: 舉。雲門大師云。乾坤之內包裹乾坤底聻宇宙之 間立成宇宙底聻中有一寶不信搜懷祕在形山形山是寶拈燈 籠向佛殿裏早是驢戲井將三門來燈籠上那堪井覰驢。
text_en: there is one treasure, hidden in the mountain of form." He held up a lantern What about that which sets up the universe at once? If you do not believe it, search your bosom. The formed mountain is a treasure. and said, "Bring the lantern into the Buddha Hall; bring the Three Gate onto the lantern." It is already a donkey playing with a well. How much worse when the well peers at the donkey.
The teacher said: Great Master Yunmen loved making such advances and withdrawals, in the height of noise and bustle

text_zh: 師云。雲門大師。愛作這箇去就。盛忙百鬧半 路抽身。一日示眾。舉肇公寶藏論。若全舉合 云。夫天地之內。宇宙之間。中有一寶。祕在形 山。識物虛照。內外空然。寂莫離見。其用玄 玄。雪竇拈云。乾坤之內。宇宙之間。中有一 寶。挂在壁上。達磨九年不敢正眼覻著。如今 衲僧要見。劈脊便棒。圓通國師道。不謬為德 山兒孫。本錄將三門。來燈籠上。作麼生。自代 云。逐物意移。又云。雷起雲興。佛果道。羅什 乃肇公受業師。瓦官寺佛馱跋陀羅。此云覺 賢。乃嗣法師。無盡燈。列于覺賢法嗣之列。覺 賢嗣西竺佛大先。佛大先與達磨。同參二十 七祖般若多羅。肇臨刑之日。乞七日假。造寶 藏論。雲門拈來示眾。不可與爾座主相似解 釋義理。只要爾下箇注脚。拈燈籠向佛殿 裏。常情可以測度。將三門來燈籠上。常情測 度得麼。本分宗師終不將實法繫綴人。所以 雪竇道。中有一寶。挂在壁上。若非天童借來 用。幾成滯貨。頌云。
text_en: suddenly pulling away midway. One day, instructing the assembly, he cited Master Zhao's Precious Treasury Treatise. If quoted in full, it should read: "Within heaven and earth, within the cosmos, there is one treasure hidden in the mountain of form. Knowing things, it illuminates emptily; inside and outside are vacant and serene. Silent and remote, beyond seeing, its function is mysteriously profound." Xuedou commented, saying, "Within heaven and earth, within the cosmos, there is one treasure hanging on the wall. Bodhidharma for nine years did not dare look at it straight on. Now if a patchrobed monk wants to see it, split his spine with a stick at once." National Teacher Yuantong said, "No wonder they are Deshan's descendants." The original record says, "Bring the Three Gate onto the lantern." How is it? He himself answered in place: "The meaning shifts following things." He also said, "Thunder rises and clouds surge." Foguo said: Kumarajiva was Master Zhao's teacher in learning. Buddhabhadra of Waguan Monastery, translated as Juexian, was his Dharma successor. In the Endless Lamp, Zhao is listed among Juexian's Dharma heirs. Juexian succeeded the Indian Buddha Daxian. Buddha Daxian and Bodhidharma studied together under the twenty- seventh patriarch Prajnatara. On the day Zhao faced execution, he begged a seven-day reprieve and composed the Precious Treasury Treatise. Yunmen lifted it up to instruct the assembly, but you must not, like scriptural lecturers, merely explain principles and meanings. He only wanted you to add a footnote. "Take the lantern into the Buddha Hall"— ordinary thinking can measure that. "Bring the Three Gate onto the lantern"—can ordinary thinking measure that? A true lineage master never ties a real Dharma onto people. Therefore Xuedou said, "There is one treasure hanging on the wall." If Tiantong had not borrowed it for use, it would almost have become stale stock. The verse says:
Gathering up and rolling away leftover thoughts, weary of the splendor of affairs, returning—where is life's Water deep, waves quiet; learning broad, the voice low.

text_zh: 收卷餘懷厭事華水深波浪靜學廣語聲低　歸來何處是生 涯老老大大住處也不知爛柯樵子疑無路日月不到處　挂樹壺 公妙有家別是一乾坤夜水金波浮桂影通上徹下　秋風 雪陣擁蘆花大小明白寒魚著底不吞餌徒勞下釣　興盡 清歌却轉槎又被風吹別調中
text_en: shore? Old and grown, yet still not knowing where one stands. The rotten-axe-handle woodcutter suspects there is no road; the pot-master hangs his gourd on the tree, A place where sun and moon do not reach. wondrously there is a home. It is another world altogether. On night waters golden waves float cassia shadows; in autumn wind It goes through above and below. snowlike gusts crowd the reed blossoms. Great and small are clear. In the cold, fish stay at the bottom and do not take the bait; when the mood is spent, Casting the line is labor in vain. a clear song turns the raft back. Again blown by the wind into another tune.
The teacher said: When waters return to the great sea, waves are quiet; when clouds reach Cangwu, the weather turns serene. Therefore

text_zh: 師云。水歸大海波濤靜。雲到蒼梧氣象閑。所 以道。相罵饒爾。接嘴相唾。饒爾潑水。此雲門 收卷餘懷。厭事華。華字二用。一則去華取實。 二則厭多事繁華。歸來何處是生涯。上句寶 藏論。下句雲門著語。向甚麼處摸𢱢。若乃停 機佇思。一念萬年。直饒爛却斧柯。也是遲棊 鈍行。前頌嚴陽見趙州語。已有爛柯樵子本 傳。前頌雪峯末後句。亦有挂樹壺公本傳費 長房。見壺公賣藥不二價。懸壺樹上。輒跳入 壺。長房樓上見之。知非常人。乃曰。掃除進餌 不謝。積久知篤信。語曰。日暮無人時來。語房 隨我跳入。房承其言。亦跳即入壺矣。見有樓 五色重門。左右侍者數十人。上句頌寶藏論。 下句頌雲門語。次兩句。上句頌明。下句頌白。 言論意雖明白。幾人薦得。雲門通其變。指出 一條活路。寒魚著底。不吞餌。此用舡子夜靜 水寒魚不食。金波桂。影滿舡明月也。金波桂 影。月之異名。天童道。清光照眼似迷家。趙州 道。老僧不在明白裏。所以興盡清歌。却轉槎 也。且道。向甚麼處去。夜深不向蘆灣宿。迴出 中間與兩頭。
text_en: it is said: In trading insults, I yield to you; in mouth-to-mouth spitting, I yield to you; in splashing water, I yield to you. This is Yunmen "gathering up leftover thoughts, weary of hua." The word hua is used two ways: first, cast off ornament and take the real; second, weary of busy, flourishing affairs. "Returning, where is life's shore?" The first line is from the Precious Treasury Treatise; the second is Yunmen's added phrase. Where will you grope for it? If you stop your activity and stand thinking, one thought becomes ten thousand years. Even if your axe handle rots away, it is still late chess and clumsy play. In an earlier verse on Yanyang meeting Zhaozhou there was already the original tale of the rotten-axe woodcutter. In an earlier verse on Xuefeng's final line there was also the original tale of the tree-hung pot-master. Fei Changfang saw Master Hu selling medicine at one fixed price. He hung his pot on a tree and would suddenly jump into the pot. Changfang saw this from an upper story and knew he was no ordinary man. So he said he would sweep and offer food without complaint. After a long time, Hu knew his faith was sincere and said, "Come when no one is around at dusk." He told Fang, "Follow me and jump in." Fang obeyed his words and also jumped in, and at once entered the pot. He saw there were towers, layered gates of five colors, and scores of attendants on both sides. The first line praises the Precious Treasury Treatise; the next line praises Yunmen's saying. In the following two lines, the first praises brightness and the second praises clarity. Though the words and meaning are bright and clear, how many can realize them? Yunmen penetrated the transformation and pointed out a living road. "Cold fish stay at the bottom and do not take the bait" uses Chuanzhi's line: when night is still, the water is cold and fish do not feed. "Golden waves, cassia shadows" means moonlight filling the boat. Golden waves and cassia shadows are alternate names for the moon. Tiantong said, "Clear light shines in the eyes, as if one has lost the way." Zhaozhou said, "This old monk is not in the bright and clear." Therefore when the mood is spent, with a clear song he turns the raft back. But tell me, where does he go? Deep at night he does not lodge in the reed cove; he turns out beyond the middle and the two ends.

Luzu said, "What about what does not go back and forth?" Nanquan said, "That too is the store." Luzu said, "What is the jewel?" What mortal hurry is there? Knowing the head of the road and the tail, telling what has gone and knowing what comes. One time alive, two times acted out. Get one and look for two. Nanquan called, "Master Zu!" Zu answered, "Yes?" Nanquan said, This old monk is not unwilling to bring it up. The venerable is not unwilling to bring it forth. "Go on. You do not understand my words." text_zh: 師云。終南山雲際師祖禪師。法嗣南泉。天 童誤為魯祖。就此辨之。學者應知。且池州 魯祖山寶雲禪師。法嗣馬祖。乃南泉兄也。 況師祖南泉。以名呼之。因此公案悟去。南 泉之子無疑也。初問南泉。摩尼珠人不識。 如來藏裏親收得。此語本出永嘉禪師證道 經。梵天琪和尚注云。梵語摩尼此云如意。 又云無垢光。亦曰增長。楞伽經云。寂滅者 名為一心。一心者名如來藏。具三種義。一隱 覆義。覆藏如來故。二含攝義。含攝一切眾 生國土故。三出生義。能生無漏因果人天道 行故。初約迷時。後約悟時。中間剋體。又勝 鬘。有二種如來藏。一空如來藏。脫離一切煩 惱。二不空如來藏。具過恒沙不思議佛法。終 南山雲際師祖禪師。初在南泉時。問摩尼珠 人不識。又問珠。泉云。去汝。不會我語。師祖 從此信入。圓通國師云。如今還有人信入麼。 若有罔象到時光燦爛。若無。离婁行處浪滔 天。佛果云。盡大地。是如來藏。向甚麼處著 珠。盡大地。是摩尼珠。喚甚麼作藏。雪竇別 云。嶮。百尺竿頭作伎倆。不是好手。這裏著 得箇眼。賓主互換便能深入虎穴。或不恁麼。 縱饒師祖悟去。也是龍頭蛇尾。要見頭尾完 全。須是天童和尚。頌云。
text_en: mistakenly took him for Luzu; let this be clarified here, and students should know it. As for Chizhou's Chan Master Baoyun of Luzu Mountain, he was a Dharma heir of Mazu and thus Nanquan's elder Dharma brother. Moreover, Shizu and Nanquan called each other by name. Because he awakened through this koan, he was surely Nanquan's son in Dharma, without doubt. He first asked Nanquan, "The mani jewel is not recognized by people. In the Tathagata-store it is personally possessed." This saying originally comes from Yongjia's Song of Enlightenment. Monk Fantianqi's commentary says: The Sanskrit mani here means "wish-fulfilling." It is also called "stainless light," and also "increase." The Lankavatara Sutra says: Tranquil extinction is called One Mind. One Mind is called the Tathagata-store. It has three meanings: first, concealment— it covers and stores the Tathagata; second, inclusion—it contains all sentient beings and lands; third, birthing—it can produce the undefiled causes and fruits, and the human and heavenly paths of practice. The first is in terms of delusion, the latter in terms of awakening, and the middle in terms of essence itself. Also, the Srimala text says: there are two kinds of Tathagata-store: the empty Tathagata-store, free from all afflictions, and the nonempty Tathagata-store, endowed with Buddha-dharmas inconceivable as sands of the Ganges. Shizu of Zhongnan Mountain at Yunjisi, when first with Nanquan, asked about the mani jewel not recognized by people, and then again asked about the jewel. Nanquan said, "Go on, you do not understand my words." Shizu from this trusted and entered. National Teacher Yuantong said, "Is there anyone nowadays who can trust and enter? If there is, then when Wangxiang arrives, the light blazes. If not, where Li Lou walks, waves surge to heaven." Foguo said: The whole earth is the Tathagata-store—where will you place the jewel? The whole earth is the mani jewel—what will you call the store? Xuedou separately said, "Steep! To perform tricks atop a hundred-foot pole is not a good hand. Here, if you set an eye in place, guest and host interchange and you can enter deep into the tiger's den. If not thus, even if Shizu awakened, it is still a dragon's head and snake's tail. To see head and tail complete, it must be Tiantong the monk. The verse says:
Distinguish right and wrong, discern gain and loss; the responsive mind points to them as if on the palm. There are sinews in the eyes. In seeing, it penetrates through; in use, it is clear.
