text_en: Coming and going, not coming and going, all of this is the hidden wheel. Altogether, it has nothing to do with him. Thus or not thus, both are acceptable. The king rewards it for merit. The honest do not take; the greedy are not given. The Yellow Emperor got it through Image-Net and the pivot turned. The mind's effort is already spent. At the hinge and pivot, skill can play its tricks. In a hundred things, none match you. A clear-eyed patchrobed monk is never reckless. In matters, one does not disdain detail.
The master said: Song of the Mind Pearl and Chant on Playing with the Pearl speak much of this pearl, calling it the wish-fulfilling jewel.

text_zh: 師云。心珠歌。玩珠吟。多說此珠。名如意寶。 少言如來藏。唯永嘉一宿覺。向如來藏裏親 收得。六般神用空不空。一顆圓光色非色。如 何是藏。如何是珠。往來者是。不往來者亦是。 這裏要爾別是非。明得喪也。應之于心。得之 于手。指諸掌。本出論語。南泉指藏。指珠如放 在汝掌中。指似與汝。既往來不往來。是藏。喚 應。喚不應。俱是珠。何疑。且道。珠中出藏。藏 中出珠。打作一團。分為兩段。法華經。佛告文 殊師利。如轉輪王見諸兵眾有大功者。心甚 歡喜。以此難信之珠。久在髻中。不妄與人。而 今與之。黃帝使象罔索珠。前頌首山三句中 已明。機輪轉處。智眼猶迷。若非無伎倆中能 作伎倆。不能道去汝不會我語。雲際這裏悟 去。洞山云。歡喜即不無。如糞掃堆頭。拾得一 顆明珠相似。萬松道。我不似洞山乞兒見小 利。歡喜則不歡喜。如來藏中擊碎一顆明珠 相似。
text_en: They speak little of the Tathagata-store; only Yongjia, the one-night awakened one, personally within the Tathagata-store received it. Six kinds of spiritual functioning, empty and not empty; one round light, color yet not color. What is the store? What is the pearl? What comes and goes is it; what does not come and go is also it. Here it is for you to distinguish right and wrong, to understand gain and loss. Respond to it in the mind, obtain it in the hand. Pointing to the palm comes originally from the Analects. Nanquan pointed to the store, pointed to the pearl as if placing it in your palm, pointing as if giving it to you. Since coming-going and not-coming-going are the store, call— respond; call and no response—both are the pearl. What doubt is there? But tell me: does the store come out of the pearl, or does the pearl come out of the store? Pound them into one lump, split them into two sections. In the Lotus Sutra, the Buddha told Manjushri: Just as a wheel-turning king, seeing among his troops those with great merit, is deeply delighted, he takes this hard-to-believe jewel, long kept in his topknot, and does not casually give it to others—but now gives it. The Yellow Emperor sent Xiangwang to seek the pearl; this was already clarified in the earlier verse on Shoushan's three phrases, where it was made clear: where the mechanism-wheel turns, even the eye of wisdom can still be confused. If one cannot, within no-trickery, work a trick, one cannot say, "Go on—you do not understand my words." Yunji awakened here. Dongshan said: Joy is not absent; it is like on a dung heap, picking up a bright pearl. Wansong said: I am not like Dongshan's beggar delighted at small gain; joy is then no joy, like smashing a bright pearl within the Tathagata-store. That is what it is like.

text_en: 94. Dongshan Unwell Addressing the assembly, he said: The lower does not discuss the higher; the humble does not move the honored. Though one may gather oneself and follow another,

text_zh: 示眾云。下不論上。卑不動尊。雖能攝已從他。 未可以輕勞重。四大不調時如何侍養。
text_en: one still must not lightly trouble what is weighty. When the four elements are out of harmony, how do you attend and serve?
Raised: Dongshan was unwell. A monk asked, "Whe master is sick, is there one who is not sick?"

text_zh: 舉。洞山不安。僧問。和尚病還有不病者麼。 一任分疏山云有強主張僧云。不病者還看和尚否世諦 流布山云。老僧看他有分本分相見僧云。和尚看他 時如何有甚麼眼相見山云。則不見有病只是不肯參假。
text_en: Shan said, "There is." The monk said, "Does the one not sick still look after master?" Shan said, "This old monk has a share in looking at him." The monk said, "When master looks at him, Let it be argued and explained as one pleases. Forcibly insist. Worldly truth. Spread and circulate. Meeting on one’s original ground. then how is it?" Shan said, "Then no sickness is seen." With what eyes do you meet? Simply refusing to inquire into the provisional.
The master said: The ancients, at the time of departure, played freely within the realms of old age, illness, and death. Among them Dong-

text_zh: 師云。古人臨行。老病死境界中游戲。就中洞 山奇怪。既云微疾。大眾看候。一僧問。和尚病 還有不病者麼。這僧言中有響。句裏呈機。也 要看病人具眼。山云。有。抓著癢處。病減十分。 僧云。不病者還看和尚否。倒行此令。要人知 不恁麼。山云。老僧看他有分。若以世情測度。 不病者合看病者。洞山却道。老僧看他有分。 豈是人情問候道理。這僧要徹底相見。更問。 和尚看他後如何。這裏要爾十二時中常須 奉重。夜眠早起。問候起居。始是知恩孝順底 人也。山云。老僧若看。即不見有病。此是平生 行履。臨行得力處也。山復問僧。離此殼漏子。 向甚麼處。與吾相見。僧無對。山有頌云。學者 雖多無一悟。過在尋他舌頭路。欲得忘形泯 蹤跡。努力慇懃空裏步。頌畢剃頭聲鍾。坐堂 辭眾告寂。眾號慟。山開目辨愚癡齋。更延七 日。再辭眾坐逝。大定繼燈錄。皇統間。咸平府 大覺寺法慶禪師。嗣佛國白禪師。甞掌書記。 初住泗州普照。後遷嵩少。破汴被虜。北方牧 牛。講僧識之。次居東京。因侍者讀洞山錄作 愚癡齋。者云。古人甚奇。覺云。吾化後汝可喚 之。若能迴來。是有道力也。後預知時至。乃作 頌云。今年五月初五。四大將離本主。白骨當 風揚却。免占檀那地土。衣物盡付侍者。齋僧 始聞初夜鐘聲坐逝。侍者曰昔約令喚。遂喚 三聲。覺應曰。作麼。者曰。和尚何裸跣而去。 覺曰。來時何有。者欲強穿衣。覺曰。休留與後 人。者曰。正恁麼時如何。覺曰。也只恁麼。復 書一偈云。七十三年如掣電。臨行為君通一 線。鐵牛𨁝跳過新羅。撞破虛空七八片。儼然 而化。壽七十三。皇統三年五月五日也。洞山 識不病底。大覺識不死底。所以二老來去自 由。天童拈云。得往得來。得來得往。我看他有 分。他看我不然。正恁麼時如何體悉。良久 云。宿霧尚深無見頂。春風常在不萌枝。天童 拈彰底事之全機。已如上說。頌見古人之剋 力。又作麼生。頌云。
text_en: shan is especially remarkable. Since it was said he was slightly ill and the assembly came to inquire after him, a monk asked, "When master is sick, is there still one not sick?" In this monk's words there is an echo; in the sentence a mechanism is presented. He also wanted to see whether the sick man had eyes. Shan said, "There is." He scratched the itch; the sickness lessened by ten parts. The monk said, "Does the one not sick still look after master?" Reversing the command like this, he wanted people to know it is not like that. Shan said, "This old monk has a share in looking at him." If judged by worldly feeling, the not-sick should look after the sick. But Dongshan instead says, "This old monk has a share in looking at him." How could this be ordinary social etiquette of asking after someone? This monk wanted a meeting through to the bottom, so he asked further: "After master looks at him, how is it?" Here it is for you, through all twelve hours, always to attend with reverence—sleep at night and rise early, ask after well-being and daily life—only then are you one who knows gratitude and is filial. Shan said, "If this old monk looks, then no sickness is seen." This is the place where in a lifetime of practice, one gains strength at the moment of departure. Shan again asked the monk, "Apart from this leaking shell, in what place will you meet me?" The monk had no reply. Shan had a verse saying: "Students, though many, not one awakens. The fault lies in seeking along another's tongue-road. If you wish to forget form and erase traces, strive diligently to walk in empty space." After the verse he had his head shaved, sounded the bell, sat in the hall, bade farewell to the assembly and announced his passing. The assembly wailed. Shan opened his eyes and reproved their foolishness, then extended another seven days, and again bade the assembly farewell and sat to pass away. In the Continuation of the Lamp of the Dading era: during the Huangtong period, in Xianping Prefecture, Chan master Faqing of Dajue Monastery, successor to Chan master Baifoguo, once served as chief scribe. He first lived at Puzhao in Sizhou, later moved to Songshao. When Bian was broken, he was captured and in the north herded cattle. A lecture monk recognized him. Later he lived in the Eastern Capital. Because an attendant read the Record of Dongshan and came to the "Foolishness Feast" passage, the attendant said, "The ancients were truly extraordinary." Jue said, "After I transform, you may call me. If I can return, that is the power of the Way." Later he knew beforehand his time had come, and made a verse, saying: "This year, on the fifth day of the fifth month, the four elements will leave their original master. My white bones, let the wind scatter them, sparing the donor's land from occupation." He gave all clothes and belongings to the attendant, fed the monks, and at the first watch bell sat and passed away. The attendant said, "Before, we agreed I should call you," and so called three times. Jue answered, "What is it?" The attendant said, "Why master go off naked and barefoot?" Jue said, "What was there when I came?" The attendant wanted to force clothes on him. Jue said, "Stop—leave them for those who come after." The attendant said, "At just such a time, how is it?" Jue said, "Just like this." Again he wrote a gatha saying: "Seventy-three years were like a flash of lightning. At departure, for you I open a single line: The iron ox leaps across Silla, smashing empty space into seven or eight pieces." Majestically he transformed. He lived seventy-three years. It was the fifth day of the fifth month, third year of Huangtong. Dongshan recognized what is not sick; Dajue recognized what does not die. Therefore these two elders came and went by their own freedom. Tiantong picked this up and said: "Able to go, able to come; able to come, able to go. I see him with a share; he sees me not so. At just such a time, how do you fully comprehend it?" After a long pause, he said: "The lingering mist is still deep, no summit in sight. The spring wind is always there, yet the branch does not bud." Tiantong's full mechanism in bringing out and revealing this matter has already been explained above. In the verse we see the ancients' hard-won strength. But how is it then? The verse says:
Cast off the stinking skin-bag; turn and take up the red lump of flesh right at the fore. Grass withered, the hawk's eyes are sharp. Snow gone, the horse's hooves are light.

text_zh: 卸却臭皮袋草枯鷹眼疾　拈轉赤肉團雪盡馬蹄輕　當頭 鼻孔正也須撥轉始得直下髑髏乾切忌見鬼　老醫不見從 來癖手到病除少子相看向近難渠無國土何處逢渠　野水瘦 時秋潦退龍行舊道白雲斷處舊山。寒是真難滅　須勦 絕。君子一言莫顢頇點燈喫飯　轉盡無功伊就位葉落歸根 孤標不與汝同盤來時無口

For the young one to look at him, drawing near is hard; the wild waters are thin He has no land or country; where will you meet him? when autumn floods recede. The dragon travels the old road. Where white clouds break, the old mountain—cold, it must be cut off This truth is hard to extinguish. completely. A gentleman's one word Do not be muddled. The master said: Master Shitou said, "If you would know the deathless man in the hut, how could he be apart from

text_zh: 師云。石頭和尚道。欲識庵中不死人。豈離而 今這皮袋。天童却道卸却這皮袋。洞山天童。 皆石頭下子孫。如此相違。如何和會。臨濟亦 道赤肉團上有無位真人。天童却教拈却赤 肉團。爾且道。無位真人。向甚處安身立命。佛 日和尚道。山僧未來時。燕京人鼻不正。山僧 特來扳正。萬松道。佛日鼻孔落在燕京人手 裏。僧問香嚴。如何是道。嚴曰。枯木裏龍吟。 僧曰。某不會。嚴曰。髑髏裏眼睛。後有僧問石 霜。如何是枯木裏龍吟。霜云。猶帶喜在。僧 曰。如何是髑髏裏眼睛。霜云。猶帶識在。又有 僧問曹山。山以偈示之曰。枯木龍吟真見道。 髑髏識盡眼初明。喜識盡時消息盡。當人那 辨濁中清。僧再問。如何是枯木裏龍吟。曹曰。 血脈不斷。僧曰。如何是髑髏裏眼睛。曹曰。乾 不盡。祖庭事苑。作乾盡。若據天童頌并序。赤 肉團獨露真常。髑髏眼瀝乾漏識。乾盡亦不 惡。世諺有云。老醫少卜。言醫老始明。卜少則 靈。所以洞山老作不見有病。少子相看向近 難者。擬親即疎。擬向即乖。寒松病枝。因病轉 奇。維摩瘦而不羸者。因病而為道日損。西京 奉聖。深禪師病起頌云。氣絕絕情緒。舉意無 意路。眴目尚無力。長年不出戶。芙蓉楷和尚 道。只此一頌。自然紹繼老僧。此水瘦潦退雲 斷。山寒也。須勦絕。莫顢頇。病要除根。醫須 勿藥。轉盡無功。伊就位。孤標不與汝同盤。還 知麼。麗水一星金。流沙混不得。
text_en: this present skin-bag?" Yet Tiantong says, "Cast off this skin-bag." Dongshan and Tiantong, both descendants of Shitou—thus they seem to oppose each other. How will you reconcile them? Linji also said, "On the red lump of flesh there is a true person of no rank." But Tiantong teaches to cast away the red lump of flesh. Tell me then: where does the true person of no rank settle body and establish life? Master Fori said, "Before this mountain monk came, the people of Yanjing had crooked noses. This mountain monk came specially to set them straight." Wansong said: Fori's nostrils fell into the hands of the people of Yanjing. A monk asked Xiangyan, "What is the Way?" Yan said, "A dragon's cry within a dead tree." The monk said, "I do not understand." Yan said, "Eyes in a skull." Later a monk asked Shishuang, "What is a dragon's cry within a dead tree?" Shuang said, "It still carries joy." The monk said, "What are eyes in a skull?" Shuang said, "It still carries consciousness." Again there was a monk who asked Caoshan. Shan answered with a verse: "The dragon's cry in the dead tree truly sees the Way. When consciousness in the skull is exhausted, then the eyes first become bright. When joy and consciousness are exhausted, all tidings are exhausted. How can the very person discern the clear within the turbid?" The monk asked again, "What is a dragon's cry within a dead tree?" Cao said, "The bloodline is unbroken." The monk said, "What are eyes in a skull?" Cao said, "Dry— not exhausted." In the Zuting Shiyuan it is written "dried up entirely." But according to Tiantong's verse and preface, the red lump of flesh stands alone revealing true constancy; the skull-eyes drain dry the leaking consciousness. "Dried up entirely" is also not bad. A worldly proverb says: "Old doctor, young diviner"—meaning medicine becomes clear only when old, while divination is efficacious when young. Therefore Dongshan, old, could make "seeing no sickness"; while for the young one looking on, drawing near is difficult. The moment you intend intimacy, you are estranged; the moment you intend approach, you go astray. The cold pine's diseased branch, through illness, turns wondrous. Vimalakirti was thin but not wasted, because through sickness he daily diminished for the Way. In Xijing, at Fengsheng, Chan master Shen, rising from illness, made a verse saying: "Breath cut off, emotions cut off; when intention is raised, there is no road of intent. Even blinking lacks strength. For years I do not leave the door." Master Furong Kai said: "With just this one verse, he naturally succeeds this old monk." These thin waters, receding floods, broken clouds, and cold mountain—these too must be cut off utterly. Do not be muddled. Illness must be uprooted; medicine must be no-medicine. Turn it all the way through with no merit, and he takes his place. The solitary standard does not share your tray. Do you still know? In Lishui, a single spark of gold cannot be mixed with drifting sand.

text_zh: 師云。臨濟有時。奪人不奪境。有時人境兩俱 奪。若遇其中人。便全體作用。此臨濟格調最 高處也。手上出來。手上打。眼上出來。眼上 打。四方八面來。旋風打。离婁黃帝時人。百里 見秋毫之末。棒頭有眼。明如日月。半點也不 容。不唯掃除狐兔。亦能變化魚龍。魚躍禹門 三級。雷電燒尾成龍。棒喝迅機神用如是。七 事隨身。有殺人刀活人劍。浮山圓鑒遠錄公。 出十六題。令投子青禪師頌。亦有殺人刀活 人劍。雪竇頌巴陵吹毛劍。要平不平。大巧若 拙。或指或掌。倚天照雪。宋玉大言賦。方地為 輿。圓天為蓋。彎弓射榑桑。長劍倚天外。僧 問臨濟。如何是吹毛劍。濟云。禍事禍事。不 見道。德山釅醋。曾喫知酸。臨際用出黃蘗。傳 來亦不弱。竹庵云。劈面三拳。攔腮七掌。盡大 地人。不識痛痒。只有一箇認痛。猶受醫在。不 見臨濟道。如蒿枝拂。相似。
text_en: If he meets the one in between, then the whole body acts in function. This is the highest point of Linji's style and measure. When it comes out through the hand, he strikes on the hand. When it comes out through the eye, he strikes on the eye. Coming from all four sides and eight directions, he strikes like a whirlwind. Li Lou was a man of the Yellow Emperor's time, seeing for a hundred li even the tip of an autumn hair. The staff-tip has eyes, bright as sun and moon, not allowing even half a speck. Not only does it sweep away foxes and rabbits, it can also transform fish and dragons. When the fish leaps the Yu Gate three tiers, thunder and lightning burn its tail and it becomes a dragon. The swift mechanism and miraculous function of staff and shout are like this. The seven things follow the body; there is the killing knife and life-giving sword. In Fushan Yuanyuan's Record, Master Yuanjian set out sixteen topics and had Chan master Touzi Qing verse them; there too are the killing knife and the life- giving sword. Xuedou, in his verse on Baling's hair-cutting sword, said: wanting levelness, yet not level; great skill seeming clumsy. Sometimes a finger, sometimes a palm; leaning on heaven, shining on snow. In Song Yu's Great Words Fu: "Square earth as the carriage, round heaven as the canopy. Bend the bow and shoot Fusang; the long sword leans beyond heaven." A monk asked Linji, "What is the hair-cutting sword?" Ji said, "Trouble! Trouble!" Do you not see it said: Deshan's vinegar is strong—once tasted, one knows its sourness. Linji's use came out of Huangbo; what was transmitted down is not weak either. Zhu'an said: Three punches to the face, seven slaps across the cheeks—throughout the whole earth people do not know pain or itch. Only one recognizes the pain, and he is still under treatment. Have you not seen Linji say: It is like brushing with a wormwood twig.

text_zh: 96 九峯不肯
text_en: 96. Jiufeng Refused Addressing the assembly, he said: Yunju did not rely on precept-pearls and relics. Jiufeng did not prize sitting and casting off.

text_zh: 示眾云。雲居不憑戒珠舍利。九峯不愛坐脫 立亡。牛頭不要百鳥㗸花。黃蘗不羨浮柸渡 水。且道。別有何長處。

Raised: Jiufeng served as attendant under Shishuang. After Shishuang passed away, the assembly wanted to invite

The teacher said, Chan Master Daoqian of Jiufeng in Yunzhou personally received Shishuang's Way and obtained

text_zh: 師云。筠州九峯道虔禪師。親傳石霜之道。得 殺活杖子。具衲僧巴鼻。首座擔板。只得一橛。 當時見道恁麼則未會先師意在。只道吾不 如汝。便教九峯無地容身傾心歸伏。不見道。 爭之不足。讓則有餘。今時參學人只道。古人 坐脫立亡。今人臨行手忙脚亂。又見毆陽文 忠公見嵩山老僧。道今人念念在亂。臨終安 得定。這迴一向尋速生速滅。覺範頌云。死時 應盡便應盡。坐脫立亡誇小兒。酪出乳中無 別法。死時何苦欲先知。二朝士問寶峯照和 尚。古人臨終去住自在。何道致之。峯云。先僧 將來。自縊死去。臨終眾僧。求峯遺訓。峯作惡 語數句而終。石霜首座。若到這箇地面。免被 九峯逼死。佛果示杲上人法語云。嗟。見一流 拍盲野狐種族。自不曾夢見祖師。却妄傳。達 磨以胎息傳人。謂之傳法救迷情。以至引從 上最年高宗師。如安國師趙州之類。皆行此 氣。及誇初祖隻履。普化空棺。皆謂此術有驗。 遂致渾身脫去。謂之形神俱妙。而人厚愛此 身。怕臘月三十日慞惶。競傳歸真之法。除夜 望影。喚主人公。以卜日月聽樓鼓。驗玉池。覘 眼光以為脫生死法。真誑諕閭閻。揑偽造窠。 貽高人嗤鄙。復有一等。假託初祖胎息說。趙 州十二時別歌。龐居士轉河車頌。遞互指授。 密傳行持。以圖長年及全身脫去。或希三五 百歲。殊不知。此真是妄想愛見。萬松道。今時 下視諸方者。多以臨行要人看。好癭上塗烟 𭴛。有甚可喜。石霜一生置枯木堂。安枯木眾。 往往常坐不臥。坐脫立亡者極多。獨九峯不 肯首座。今時好坐脫立亡底。何不參取九峯 不肯處。且道。九峯具甚麼作用。問取天童。 頌云。
text_en: the staff of killing and giving life; he had the vital nose of a patchrobed monk. The head monk was carrying a board on his shoulders, grasping only a single stump. At that time, when he saw him and said, If so, then you have not understood our late teacher's meaning, he should simply have said, I am not equal to you. Then Jiufeng would have had nowhere to hide and would have bowed in wholehearted submission. Have you not heard it said, Contesting is not enough; yielding leaves more than enough. People studying nowadays only say that the ancients could die seated or standing, while people now at the end are all hands and feet in confusion. Also, Ouyang Wenzhong saw an old monk on Mount Song and said, People now are in confusion in thought after thought; at death, how can they gain steadiness? This lot only seeks quick birth and quick death. Jiaofan wrote in verse, When it should end, just let it end; dying seated or standing is bragging for children. Curd comes from milk by no other method; there is no separate dharma. Why painfully want to know beforehand when you will die? Two court officials asked Baofeng Zhaohe the monk, The ancients were free in coming and going at death; by what Way did they achieve this? Baofeng said, Former monks brought this up and then hanged themselves. At his death, the monks asked Baofeng for final instruction. Baofeng uttered some harsh words and then died. If Shishuang's head monk had reached this ground, he would have avoided being driven to death by Jiufeng. Foguo, in instruction to the monk Gao, said, Alas, seeing one stream of blind-slapping wild fox breeds, who have never even dreamed of the patriarchs, yet falsely transmit that Bodhidharma passed on the embryo breathing method to people, calling it transmitting Dharma to save deluded feelings, and even cite the most senior ancient masters, such as National Teacher An and Zhaozhou, saying they all practiced this breathing. They boast of the First Patriarch's single sandal and Puhua's empty coffin, all claiming this technique has proof. Thus they arrive at casting off the whole body, calling it both form and spirit wondrous. Yet people dearly love this body, and fear panic on the thirtieth day of the twelfth month. They compete to transmit methods of returning to the real; on New Year's Eve they watch their shadow and call to the master within, to divine days and months, listen to the tower drum, test the jade pool, spy on the light in the eyes, taking this for a method to escape birth and death. Truly they deceive and frighten the common people, fabricating false nests. They leave worthy people with mockery and contempt. There is another sort, falsely relying on the First Patriarch's embryo breathing teaching, and on Zhaozhou's separate songs of the twelve hours, and Layman Pang's turning the river cart verse, passing them back and forth in instruction, secretly transmitting practice and discipline, seeking long life and complete bodily departure, some hoping for three or five hundred years. They do not realize this is truly delusive thought and attachment. Wansong said, Nowadays, those who look down on all quarters mostly want people watching at their last moment; smearing smoke on a swelling what is there to rejoice in? Shishuang spent his life establishing the Dead Wood Hall, settling a dead-wood assembly. They often always sat and did not lie down; many died seated or standing. Only Jiufeng did not approve of the head monk. Those nowadays who prize dying seated or standing, why not investigate Jiufeng's point of refusal? Tell me, what function did Jiufeng possess? Ask Tiantong. The verse says,
In Shishuang's lineage, personally transmitted to Jiufeng, he cast off at the incense smoke's rise. bees swarm and ants gather ice melts and tiles fall apart free in life and death

text_zh: 師云。天童仁義。先于貧處斷。世情偏向有錢 家。萬松道。門庭施設。不如九峯。入理深談。 猶較座元百步。勝默和尚作。祖庭詠史詩。元 座徒亡一炷煙。九峯不是抑高賢。若將一色 為承紹。辜負先師不借緣。石霜示眾有云。未 甞忘照。猶為外紹為臣種。亦曰借。若誕生。 絲毫不隔。如王子生下。則能紹大位。謂之內 紹。名王種。名句不借也。借則一色邊事耳。不 得已。應機利生為挾帶。點額飛龍。亦禹門化 魚之事。亦周易乾卦。九五飛龍在天。得位之 象。豈比月巢鶴夢。雪屋人迷者哉。還識石霜 傳九峯處麼。摘破香囊薰大國。撥開天竅吼 真風。
text_en: house. Wansong said, In gate-and-court devices, he is not equal to Jiufeng; in deep discourse entering principle, he is still a hundred paces beyond the seat-monk. Monk Shengmo composed a verse on patriarchal court history, The head monk died vainly in one stick of incense smoke; Jiufeng was not suppressing a worthy man. If one takes one color as succession, one betrays the late teacher's unborrowed condition. Shishuang once instructed the assembly, saying, If one has not yet forgotten illumination, that is still external succession, the seed of a minister; it is also called borrowing. If one is born forth, with not the slightest separation, like a prince newly born, then he can inherit the great seat. This is called inner succession, named the royal seed; named the phrase of no borrowing. Borrowing is merely the side of one color. If there is no choice, responding to conditions to benefit beings is a carried accompaniment. Dotting the forehead, the flying dragon, is also like fish transforming at Yu Gate into dragons. It is also the Qian hexagram in the Zhou Yi, Nine-Five, the flying dragon in the sky, the image of attaining position. How could it be compared to the moon-nest crane's dream or the snow-hut man's delusion? Do you yet recognize where Shishuang transmitted to Jiufeng? Tear open the incense pouch and scent the great nation; pry open the heavenly aperture and roar the true wind.

text_en: He truly had eyes. When the realm is at peace and the king lives long, not offending heavenly majesty, the sun and moon pause their brilliance, the four seasons are harmonious, and there is radiant transforming influence. When the king of men and the Dharma king meet, what should they discuss?

text_en: he became head monk under Sansheng. Later he met Dajue. At his opening Dharma hall he held up incense and said, This one stick of incense, by rights, is for elder brother Sansheng. Sansheng is too exacting for me. By rights it is for elder brother Dajue. Dajue is too distant for me. Better to offer it to Linji, our late teacher. A monk asked, When one comes from the four directions and eight sides, what then? Xinghua said, Strike the middle one. The monk bowed. Xinghua said, Great assembly, Xinghua yesterday went to a village feast. Halfway he met a sudden wind and violent rain, and took shelter in a spirit shrine to get through. In Later Tang, when Zhuangzong made an imperial tour to Hebei, a monk asked, When the royal itinerary is limited, what then? Xinghua said, Daily travel five hundred li. Returning to the temporary palace in Wei Prefecture, he summoned Xinghua. After granting him a seat and tea, he then asked, I have taken the Central Plain and obtained one treasure; no one has yet appraised it. Xinghua said, Let me briefly borrow Your Majesty's treasure to see. The emperor pulled the ends of his headcloth with both hands. Xinghua said, The ruler's treasure who dares appraise? The emperor was greatly pleased and bestowed a purple robe and a title. Xinghua accepted none of them. He also bestowed one imperial horse. Wansong said, First one must recognize the ruler, and also know where the Central Plain lies; only then ask where your treasure is. Xuanzue challenged, saying, Tell me, did Xinghua approve of Tongguang, or not? If he approved, Xinghua's eye was in what place? If he did not approve, where was Tongguang's fault? Wan song said, Subhuti did not understand the Diamond meaning, and questioned till doubt filled the world. Xuedou said, What the highest sovereign obtained can only be viewed from the side. If not for Xinghua as a master hand, it would often have been appraised at a high price. Wansong said, Just like coming without fasting. Cuiyan Zhi said, Xinghua's move at that time could be called dead drunk. How would you judge it now? Wansong said, Take a beating, then decide the case. Yunfeng Yue said, The true does not hide the false; the crooked does not conceal the straight. Those with eyes should discern it. Wansong said, Asked a blind fellow. Huang Longxin said, For one period Xinghua acted upon the occasion, but in the end he buried that one court emperor. At that time, if he had only told him, A pearl from clam and mussel, even if obtained, is of no use, then he would have given him another way to live thereafter and spared him mutual dull stumbling. And now if someone asks, how then would you appraise it? Wansong said, Seven times nine, six thirteen total. This whole gang of old fellows had none who dared set a price. Only Tian tong matched the thing and made a valuation, with no shortfall on either side. The verse says,

text_zh: 師云。同光年號也。如大中天子即宣宗也。後 唐莊宗。在位三年。癸未改同光元年。喚作中 原一寶。已是強名。畢竟喚作甚麼。大小天童 只道得箇君王底意語知音。看他莊宗行兵。 則從真定服中山。取漁陽兼魏愽。策馬渡河。 而梁氏失國。偏師西指。而劍閣不守。所以自 稱收得中原一寶。只是無人酬價。此以衲僧 分上未遇知音。不逢別者。終不開拳。興化傾 誠。不敢辜負天府大寶。葵藿向日而傾。衛其 足也。所以刖足鮑莊子不如葵也。掇出中原 無價寶。此頌引幞頭脚。輪王髻中珠不可輕 分付。古今天子對辯。未有如莊宗善用時機。 佛事人情一時周足。有官人謁歸宗。宗拈起 兩帽子脚。示之云。還會麼。官曰。不會。宗曰。 老僧病頭風。莫怪不卸帽子。官人無語。萬松 道。韓信功高誰與同。轉身拆却連雲棧。趙國 有和氏之璧。燕昭王築臺。置千金於上。延天 下之士。故名黃金臺。又頌云。中原之寶。一段 光明。輝天鑒地。南泉道。不作貴不作賤。爾作 麼生買。所以難定價也。金輪王王四天下。銀 輪三天下。銅二。鐵一。准上可知。金輪雖有七 寶。只能景耀四天下。不如中原一寶盡十方法 界。皆是一段光明。尀耐興化。容易便道。略借 陛下寶看。同光是一朝天子。作大檀越。布施 與他。可謂作家君王天然有在。萬松常笑。三 角示眾云。大凡說法須是應時及節。及至住 庵時。值賊執刀問。和尚有珍寶否。角云。僧家 之寶非君所宜。賊云。是甚麼寶。角便喝。賊不 領以刃加之。法雨頌云。結茅絕頂居三角。家 寶不能深蘊却。草次開囊欺鑒人。卞和刖足 胡為錯。錯遇桀紂兮施禮樂。不似興化莊宗 不傷和氣。僧問法雲圓通秀鐵壁。知師久蘊 囊中寶。今日當筵略借看。壁云。君子愛財。取 之有道。勿謂法雲拈不出。須知興化敢商量。
text_en: Tang Zhuangzong was on the throne three years. In the guǐwèi year he changed it to the first year of Tongguang. Calling it the Central Plain's one treasure is already a forced name. After all, what should it be called? Even so, Tiantong only managed to say, The ruler's meaning speaks to one who knows the tune. Look at Zhuangzong's campaigning: from Zhending he subdued Zhongshan, took Yuyang and Wei-Bo as well, rode across the river, and the Liang house lost the state. A detached force pointed west, and Jiange was not held. Therefore he himself called it obtaining one treasure of the Central Plain, only no one could appraise it. This is because on the side of patchrobed monks, if they do not meet one who knows the tune, if they do not encounter one who can discern, they never open the fist. Xinghua poured out sincerity and dared not betray the great treasure of the heavenly storehouse. Mallow and sunflower turn toward the sun and incline, guarding their feet. Therefore the foot-amputated Bian He was not equal to mallow. Lifting out the Central Plain's priceless treasure, this verse refers to pulling the headcloth ends. The wheel-turning king's topknot jewel cannot lightly be entrusted. Among emperors ancient and modern in direct exchange, none matched Zhuangzong in skillfully using the occasion. Buddhist matter and human feeling were both fully complete at once. An official visited Guizong. Guizong picked up the two ends of his cap and showed them, saying, Do you understand? The official said, I do not. Guizong said, This old monk suffers head wind, do not blame me for not taking off my cap. The official was speechless. Wansong said, Han Xin's merit was so high, who could compare? He turned and tore down the cloud-linked plank roads. The state of Zhao had He Shi's jade disk. King Zhao of Yan built a terrace and placed a thousand gold pieces upon it to invite worthy men from under heaven, so it was called the Golden Terrace. Again the verse says, The treasure of the Central Plain, one whole piece of brightness, shines on heaven and mirrors earth. Nanquan said, Do not make it noble, do not make it base. How do you buy it? Therefore it is hard to fix a price. The golden wheel king rules four quarters; the silver wheel, three; the bronze, two; the iron, one. Following this, you can know the rest. Though the golden wheel has seven treasures, it can only shine over four quarters. It does not equal the one treasure of the Central Plain that fills the ten-direction Dharma realm, all one whole piece of brightness. But that Xinghua, too easily he said, Let me briefly borrow Your Majesty's treasure to see. Tongguang was emperor of one dynasty, acting as a great donor, making an offering to him. He can be called a ruler of true caliber, naturally possessing it. Wansong often laughed at San jiao, who instructed the assembly saying, In general, expounding Dharma must match the time and season. But when he came to live in a hermitage, he met a bandit holding a knife who asked, Monk, do you have any treasure? Sanjiao said, A monk's treasure is not fitting for you. The bandit said, What treasure is it? Sanjiao then shouted. The bandit did not understand and struck him with the blade. Fayu wrote in verse, Sanjiao dwelt in a thatched hut on the peak; his family treasure he could not keep deeply concealed. In haste he opened the sack and misled the appraiser. Bian He lost his feet for no reason but error. To meet Jie and Zhou and offer rites and music is a mistake; unlike Xinghua and Zhuangzong, they did not injure harmony. A monk asked Xiutiebi of Fayun Yuantong, I know teacher has long stored the treasure in the sack. Today before the assembly, let me briefly borrow it to see. Bi said, A gentleman loves wealth, but takes it by the Way. Do not say Fayun cannot produce it; you must know Xinghua dared to negotiate.

In Zhou Qi's Record of Local Customs: ping and pin are names of water herbs; the larger is pin, the smaller is ping. text_zh: 師云。僧問忠國師。如何是佛法大意。師云。文 殊堂裏萬菩薩。僧云。學人不會。師云。大悲千 手眼。佛鑑頌。時年蔬菜賤。滿地蘿葡頭。一文 買一箇。得者飽齁齁。這裏便見天童與雲門 出一隻手。提折脚鐺子也。周易繫辭。君子之 道。或出或處。或默或語。二人同心。其利斷金。 同心之言。其臭如蘭。注云。金堅剛之物。而能 斷之。言利之甚也。毛詩邶柏舟云。我心匪石。 不可轉也。我心匪席。不可卷也。注石雖堅尚 可轉。席雖平尚可卷。言已心志堅平過于石 席。且道。忠國師。佛鑑。雲門。天童。恁麼氣急 作甚。赤心片片知人少。覿面堆堆覩者稀。
text_en: shri Hall are ten thousand bodhisattvas. The monk said, I do not understand. The teacher said, Great Compassion has a thousand hands and eyes. In Fogjian's verse: In these years vegetables are cheap; the ground is full of radish tops. For one coin you buy one, and whoever gets it is stuffed and snoring. Right here you can see Tiantong and Yunmen extending one hand together, lifting the broken-legged pot. In the Appended Phrases of the Zhou Yi: The way of the noble man, at times he goes forth, at times he stays; at times silent, at times speaking. When two are of one mind, their sharpness cuts metal. Words of those of one mind, their fragrance is like orchids. The note says: Metal is hard and firm, yet they can cut it; this speaks of extreme sharpness. In the Mao Odes, Bei, Bozhou: My heart is not stone, it cannot be turned. My heart is not a mat, it cannot be rolled. The note says: Though stone is hard it still can be turned; though a mat is flat it still can be rolled. This says one's resolve is firmer and flatter than stone or mat. Tell me then, National Teacher Zhong, Fogjian, Yunmen, Tiantong, why are they all so urgent and heated for? Red heart, piece by piece, few know it; piled up right before the face, few are those who see it.

text_zh: 師云。汾陽無德昭禪師。北地苦寒。因罷夜參。 梵僧乘雲而至勸。不可失時。此眾雖不多。六 人大器。道廕人天。陽明日上堂云。胡僧金錫 光。為法到汾陽。六人成大器。勸請為敷揚。時 大愚芝。慈明圓。瑯琊覺。法華舉。天勝泰。石 霜永等。皆在席下。滁州瑯琊山。開化廣照禪 師。諱慧覺。西洛人。父為衡陽太守。捐館。扶 襯歸洛。過澧州。登藥山古剎瞻禮。觀其游處。 宛若舊居。緣此出家。得法于汾陽。應緣滁水。 與雪竇明覺。同時唱道。天下指為二甘露門。 逮今淮南遺化如昔。湖南祇林和尚。纔見僧 來便云。魔來魔來。以木劍揮之。潛入方丈。如 是十二年。後置劍無言。有僧問。十二年前為 甚麼降魔。林云。賊不打貧兒家。僧云。十二年 後為甚麼不降魔。林云。賊不打貧兒家。此名 一劍下分身之意。首楞嚴第四。富樓那問。若 復世間一切根塵。陰處界等。皆如來藏。清淨 本然。云何忽生山河大地諸有為相。次第遷 流。終而復始。說者云。若解則已知。覺體本 妙。無明本空。山河大地。如空花相。若惑則能 所妄分。強覺俄起。三細為世。四輪成界。瑯琊 云。我則不然。清淨本然。云何忽生山河大地。 此喚騎賊馬赶賊。奪賊槍殺賊。薦福信云。先 行不到。末後太過。萬松道。徐六檐板。各見一 邊。要除見滲漏。須見天童始得。頌云。
text_en: a foreign monk rode in on clouds and urged him, Do not miss the time. Though this assembly is not many, six are great vessels; their Way will shade humans and gods. The next day Fenyang ascended the hall and said: The foreign monk's golden staff shone; for the Dharma he came to Fenyang. Six men will become great vessels; he urged and invited me to expound. At that time Dayu Zhi, Ciming Yuan, Langya Jue, Fahua Ju, Tiansheng Tai, and Shi- shuang Yong and others were all seated below. On Langya Mountain in Chuzhou, the Chan Master Guangzhao of Kaihua, whose taboo name was Huijue, was a man of Western Luo. His father was governor of Hengyang. When he died, they escorted the coffin back to Luo. Passing through Lizhou, he climbed the ancient monastery on Yaoshan to pay respects; seeing the places he had walked, it was just like an old home. Because of this he left home, received Dharma from Fenyang, and responded to conditions at Chuzhou. Together with Xuedou Mingjue, he proclaimed the Way at the same time; the world pointed to them as the two gates of sweet dew. Down to the present, the remaining influence in Huainan is as before. Master Zhilin of Hunan, whenever he merely saw a monk come, would at once say, A demon comes, a demon comes, and brandish a wooden sword at him, then slip into the abbot's room. Thus it went for twelve years. Later he put aside the sword and said nothing. A monk asked, Twelve years ago, why did you subdue demons? Lin said, Thieves do not rob a poor household. The monk said, After twelve years, why do you not subdue demons? Lin said, Thieves do not rob a poor household. This is called the meaning of one sword stroke dividing the body. In the fourth scroll of the Surangama, Purna asked: If all roots and dusts in the world, the aggregates, sense-fields, and realms, are all the Tathagata-store, originally pure, how then do mountains, rivers, and the great earth, all conditioned forms, suddenly arise, successively changing and flowing, ending and beginning again? Commentators say: If understood, then one knows the body of awakening is originally wondrous, ignorance is originally empty, and mountains and rivers and the great earth are like flowers in the sky. If deluded, then subject and object are falsely divided, forced awareness suddenly arises, the three subtle aspects become the world, the four wheels form the realm. Langya said, I am not like that: Purity is originally so; how then do mountains, rivers, and the great earth suddenly arise? This is called riding the thief's horse to chase the thief, seizing the thief's spear to kill the thief. Xin of Jianfu said, At first it does not go far enough; in the end it goes too far. Wansong said, Xu Liu on the eaves-board, each sees one side. If you want to remove the seepage in your seeing, you must see Tiantong. The verse says:

text_zh: 師云。見有不有。其有自朽。見怪不怪。其怪自 壞。摩訶衍論。十四祖龍樹祖師造也。乃云一 切諸法。一切因緣故應有。一切諸法。一切因 緣故不應有。此翻手覆手也。瑯琊上堂云。見 聞覺知。俱為生死之因。見聞覺知。俱為解脫 之本。譬如師子返擲。南北東西。且無定止。汝 等諸人若也不會。且莫辜負釋迦老子。吽。此 所以不落瞿曇後也。瞿曇梵語。具云喬答摩。 此云地勝。謂除天外在地人中。最殊勝故。方 今後五百歲。去聖時遙。人多懈怠。如何得不 落後去。裂破古今。
text_en: collapses. The Mahayana Treatise, composed by the Fourteenth Patriarch Nagarjuna, says: All dharmas, because of all causes and conditions, should be said to exist. All dharmas, because of all causes and conditions, should be said not to exist. This is turning the hand and overturning the hand. Langya, ascending the hall, said: Seeing, hearing, awareness, and knowing are all causes of birth and death. Seeing, hearing, awareness, and knowing are all the basis of liberation. It is like a lion wheeling and throwing itself, south, north, east, west, with no fixed stopping place. If you people do not understand, then do not betray old Shakyamuni. Hum! This is why he does not fall behind Gautama. Gautama is Sanskrit, fully spoken as Qiaodamo. Here it means Earth-Supreme, because apart from the heavens, among people on earth he is the most outstanding. Now in the later five hundred years, far removed in time from the sage, people are mostly lax. How can one avoid falling behind? Split apart past and present.
